question.zh: 在 n × n 点阵里，能放多少个点而没有任意三点共线？
question.en: How many points can an n × n grid hold with no three collinear?

summary.zh: 在整数点阵上复现经典的 3/2 渐近下界，再寻找能以固定比例超越它的无穷构型族。
summary.en: Recover the classical asymptotic density 3/2 on integer grids, then seek an infinite family with a fixed improvement.

gaps.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (counts : ℕ → ℕ), (∀ i < n, counts i ≤ 2) → Finset.sum (Finset.range n) counts ≤ 2 * n

plain_statement.zh: 若 n 行每行至多有两个选点，则选点总数至多为 2n。
plain_statement.en: If each of n rows contains at most two selected points, their total is at most 2n.

gaps.statement: ∀ (ax ay bx byCoord cx cy tx ty : ℤ), ((bx + tx) - (ax + tx)) * ((cy + ty) - (ay + ty)) - ((byCoord + ty) - (ay + ty)) * ((cx + tx) - (ax + tx)) = (bx - ax) * (cy - ay) - (byCoord - ay) * (cx - ax)

plain_statement.zh: 同时平移三个点，判定共线的整数行列式保持不变。
plain_statement.en: Translating all three points leaves their collinearity determinant unchanged.

plain_statement.zh: 如果 n × n 点阵的选点集中，每三个互异点的整数行列式都非零，那么选点数不超过 2n。
plain_statement.en: If every triple of distinct selected points in an n × n grid has a nonzero integer determinant, then there are at most 2n selected points.

brief.zh: 按第一坐标分组，先证明每组至多两个点，再把分组计数相加。
brief.en: Group by the first coordinate, show each fibre has at most two points, then sum the fibre sizes.

plain_statement.zh: 整数抛物线 y = x² 上，横坐标互异的三个点不共线。
plain_statement.en: Three points on y = x² with distinct integer x-coordinates are not collinear.

brief.zh: 把行列式分解成三个差的乘积。这个无界引理可用于检查抛物线构型。
brief.en: Factor the determinant into a product of three differences. This uniform identity can certify parabolic constructions.

gaps.statement: ∀ (p : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → ∀ (a b c : ZMod p), a ≠ b → a ≠ c → b ≠ c → (b - a) * (c ^ 2 - a ^ 2) ≠ (b ^ 2 - a ^ 2) * (c - a)

plain_statement.zh: 在素数模 p 的有限域上，抛物线 y = x² 上横坐标互异的三点行列式非零。
plain_statement.en: Over the field of prime order p, three points on y = x² with distinct first coordinates have nonzero determinant.

brief.zh: 将素数假设注册为 Fact，再使用有限域中非零因子的乘积仍非零。
brief.en: Use the primality hypothesis as a Fact so that the product of nonzero factors stays nonzero.

gaps.statement: let valid := fun (n : ℕ) (S : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)) => (∀ z ∈ S, z.1 < n ∧ z.2 < n) ∧ (∀ a ∈ S, ∀ b ∈ S, ∀ c ∈ S, a ≠ b → a ≠ c → b ≠ c → ((b.1 : ℤ) - (a.1 : ℤ)) * ((c.2 : ℤ) - (a.2 : ℤ)) ≠ ((b.2 : ℤ) - (a.2 : ℤ)) * ((c.1 : ℤ) - (a.1 : ℤ))); ∀ p : ℕ, Nat.Prime p → let S := (Finset.range p).image (fun x => (x, x^2 % p)); valid p S ∧ S.card = p

plain_statement.zh: 对每个素数 p，点 (x, x² mod p) 在 p 阶点阵中给出 p 个无三点共线的点。
plain_statement.en: For each prime p, the points (x, x² mod p) give p valid grid points.

brief.zh: 用第一坐标证明单射。若整数行列式为零，模 p 后会和已核验的有限域抛物线引理矛盾。
brief.en: Count by the first coordinate and reduce a hypothetical zero determinant modulo p.

gaps.statement: ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (k x y z : ZMod p), k ≠ 0 → x ≠ 0 → y ≠ 0 → z ≠ 0 → x ≠ y → x ≠ z → y ≠ z → (y-x)*(k/z-k/x) ≠ (z-x)*(k/y-k/x)

plain_statement.zh: 在素域上，xy=k 且 k≠0 的双曲线上，横坐标两两不同的三点不共线。
plain_statement.en: Three distinct points on xy=k over a prime field are noncollinear when k is nonzero.

brief.zh: 清除三个非零分母并分解为坐标差的乘积。这会排除提升构造中余类相异的三点。
brief.en: Clear the three denominators and factor into coordinate differences to rule out triples in distinct residue classes.

gaps.statement: let valid := fun (n : ℕ) (S : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)) => (∀ z ∈ S, z.1 < n ∧ z.2 < n) ∧ (∀ a ∈ S, ∀ b ∈ S, ∀ c ∈ S, a ≠ b → a ≠ c → b ≠ c → ((b.1 : ℤ) - (a.1 : ℤ)) * ((c.2 : ℤ) - (a.2 : ℤ)) ≠ ((b.2 : ℤ) - (a.2 : ℤ)) * ((c.1 : ℤ) - (a.1 : ℤ))); ∀ p : ℕ, Nat.Prime p → 2 < p → ∃ S : Finset (ℕ × ℕ), valid (2*p) S ∧ 3*(p-1) ≤ S.card

plain_statement.zh: 对每个奇素数 p，在 2p 阶点阵中构造至少 3(p−1) 个无三点共线的点。
plain_statement.en: Construct at least 3(p−1) valid points on the grid of side 2p for every odd prime p.

brief.zh: 从模双曲线的四个平移副本中选点。须另证同余类重复时也不会出现整数共线。
brief.en: Select points from four translated copies of the modular hyperbola and handle repeated residues over the integers.

gaps.statement: let valid := fun (n : ℕ) (S : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)) => (∀ z ∈ S, z.1 < n ∧ z.2 < n) ∧ (∀ a ∈ S, ∀ b ∈ S, ∀ c ∈ S, a ≠ b → a ≠ c → b ≠ c → ((b.1 : ℤ) - (a.1 : ℤ)) * ((c.2 : ℤ) - (a.2 : ℤ)) ≠ ((b.2 : ℤ) - (a.2 : ℤ)) * ((c.1 : ℤ) - (a.1 : ℤ))); (∀ p : ℕ, Nat.Prime p → 2 < p → ∃ S : Finset (ℕ × ℕ), valid (2*p) S ∧ 3*(p-1) ≤ S.card) → ∀ e : ℝ, 0 < e → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n → ∃ S : Finset (ℕ × ℕ), valid n S ∧ (3/2-e)*(n:ℝ) ≤ (S.card:ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 若每个奇素数尺度都有上述构造，则对每个 ε>0，所有充分大的 n 都能放下至少 (3/2−ε)n 个点。
plain_statement.en: Deduce the eventual (3/2−ε)n lower bound from the odd-prime-scale construction for every ε>0.

brief.zh: 用素数分布在 n/2 以下选一个足够近的 p，再把整个小点阵嵌入大点阵。
brief.en: Choose a prime just below n/2 using prime distribution and embed its entire grid.

gaps.statement: let valid := fun (n : ℕ) (S : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)) => (∀ z ∈ S, z.1 < n ∧ z.2 < n) ∧ (∀ a ∈ S, ∀ b ∈ S, ∀ c ∈ S, a ≠ b → a ≠ c → b ≠ c → ((b.1 : ℤ) - (a.1 : ℤ)) * ((c.2 : ℤ) - (a.2 : ℤ)) ≠ ((b.2 : ℤ) - (a.2 : ℤ)) * ((c.1 : ℤ) - (a.1 : ℤ))); ∀ (n : ℕ) (S : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)), valid n S → S.card = 2*n → ∀ i < n, (S.filter (fun z => z.1 = i)).card = 2 ∧ (S.filter (fun z => z.2 = i)).card = 2

plain_statement.zh: 若恰好放下 2n 个点，则每行恰有两点，每列也恰有两点。
plain_statement.en: In a valid placement of 2n points each row and each column contains exactly two.

brief.zh: 分别对行、列求和；任一行或列少一点都会与总数冲突。
brief.en: Sum the row and column bounds separately and use equality in each sum.

gaps.statement: let valid := fun (n : ℕ) (S : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)) => (∀ z ∈ S, z.1 < n ∧ z.2 < n) ∧ (∀ a ∈ S, ∀ b ∈ S, ∀ c ∈ S, a ≠ b → a ≠ c → b ≠ c → ((b.1 : ℤ) - (a.1 : ℤ)) * ((c.2 : ℤ) - (a.2 : ℤ)) ≠ ((b.2 : ℤ) - (a.2 : ℤ)) * ((c.1 : ℤ) - (a.1 : ℤ))); ∃ d : ℝ, 0 < d ∧ ∀ B : ℕ, ∃ n : ℕ, B < n ∧ ∃ S : Finset (ℕ × ℕ), valid n S ∧ (3/2+d)*(n:ℝ) ≤ (S.card:ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 找到固定 δ>0，在无界的一族边长上构造至少 (3/2+δ)n 个无三点共线的点。
plain_statement.en: Beat density 3/2 by one fixed positive margin along an unbounded family of grids.

brief.zh: 开放目标。先算出候选族的点数，再按三点来自哪些子集逐类排除零行列式。
brief.en: Open target. Count an explicit family, then rule out every type of zero determinant across its constituent subsets.

gaps.statement: let det := fun (a b c : ℤ × ℤ) => (b.1-a.1)*(c.2-a.2)-(b.2-a.2)*(c.1-a.1); let safe := fun (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)) => ∀ a ∈ S, ∀ b ∈ S, ∀ c ∈ S, a ≠ b → a ≠ c → b ≠ c → det a b c ≠ 0; let mixed := fun (A B : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)) => ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ A, a ≠ b → ∀ c ∈ B, det a b c ≠ 0; ∀ (A U : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)), Disjoint A U → safe A → safe U → (safe (A ∪ U) ↔ mixed A U ∧ mixed U A)

plain_statement.zh: 两组点各自合法且互不相交。其并集合法，当且仅当任一组内两点的连线都避开另一组。
plain_statement.en: Two disjoint valid sets have a valid union exactly when each set avoids all secants of the other.

brief.zh: 对三点按来自两组的个数分类，交换行列式参数只会改变符号。此处 A 取删点后的旧集，U 取拟加入的新集。
brief.en: Classify triples by membership and use alternation of the determinant. Take A to be the retained old points and U the proposed new set.

plain_statement.zh: 在边长 2p 的经典构型中新增 u 点、删除 r 点。若净增至少 ηp 且 ηp≥6，最终密度至少为 3/2+η/4。
plain_statement.en: A net gain of at least ηp over 3(p−1) points gives density at least 3/2+η/4 once ηp≥6.

brief.zh: 先用集合基数证明 m+r=b+u，再使用本算术引理。减掉经典构造的常数缺口 3 后，仍留出固定余量。
brief.en: Prove the cardinality identity for the actual exchange first. Absorb the baseline loss of three and retain a fixed margin.

gaps.statement: ∀ x y u v t:ℤ, x*(v+t*u)-(y+t*x)*u=x*v-y*u

plain_statement.zh: 整数剪切保持共线行列式
plain_statement.en: Shears preserve the collinearity determinant

brief.zh: 通过坐标差的行列式校验三点，再用行容量审查接近上界的构型。
brief.en: Use the determinant to certify collinearity and row capacity to check near-extremizers.

gaps.statement: ∀ x y u v:ℤ, y*u-x*v= -(x*v-y*u)

plain_statement.zh: 交换坐标只改变方向符号
plain_statement.en: Axis swap reverses determinant sign

brief.zh: 通过坐标差的行列式校验三点，再用行容量审查接近上界的构型。
brief.en: Use the determinant to certify collinearity and row capacity to check near-extremizers.

plain_statement.zh: 达到 2n 时每行恰有两点
plain_statement.en: Saturation forces two points in every row

brief.zh: 通过坐标差的行列式校验三点，再用行容量审查接近上界的构型。
brief.en: Use the determinant to certify collinearity and row capacity to check near-extremizers.

gaps.statement: ∀ (n:ℕ) (r:Fin n→ℕ), (∀ i,r i≤2) → ((Finset.univ:Finset (Fin n)).filter (fun i => r i<2)).card+(∑ i,r i)≤2*n

plain_statement.zh: 欠饱和行数受总缺口控制
plain_statement.en: Bound unsaturated rows by the total deficit

brief.zh: 通过坐标差的行列式校验三点，再用行容量审查接近上界的构型。
brief.en: Use the determinant to certify collinearity and row capacity to check near-extremizers.

gaps.statement: let d := fun (a b c : ℤ × ℤ) => (b.1-a.1)*(c.2-a.2)-(b.2-a.2)*(c.1-a.1); let ok := fun (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)) => ∀ a∈S, ∀ b∈S, ∀ c∈S, a≠b → b≠c → a≠c → d a b c≠0; ∀ (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)) (x : ℤ × ℤ), x∉S → (ok (insert x S) ↔ ok S ∧ ∀ a∈S, ∀ b∈S,a≠b → d a b x≠0)

plain_statement.zh: 单点增广的充要判据
plain_statement.en: Exact criterion for inserting one site

brief.zh: 区分三元组是否包含 x，并处理行列式置换。
brief.en: Split triples on membership of x and permute the determinant.

gaps.statement: let d := fun (a b c : ℤ × ℤ) => (b.1-a.1)*(c.2-a.2)-(b.2-a.2)*(c.1-a.1); let ok := fun (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)) => ∀ a∈S, ∀ b∈S, ∀ c∈S, a≠b → b≠c → a≠c → d a b c≠0; ∀ (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)) (r x y : ℤ × ℤ), let T := S.erase r; ok S → x≠y → (∀ a∈T,∀ b∈T,a≠b → d a b x≠0 ∧ d a b y≠0) → (∀ a∈T,d x y a≠0) → ok (insert x (insert y T))

plain_statement.zh: 删一点加两点的合法性证书
plain_statement.en: Certificate for replacing one site by two

brief.zh: 检查旧旧新和旧新新两种割线。
brief.en: Check old–old–new and old–new–new triples separately.

gaps.statement: let d := fun (a b c : ℤ × ℤ) => (b.1-a.1)*(c.2-a.2)-(b.2-a.2)*(c.1-a.1); let ok := fun (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)) => ∀ a∈S, ∀ b∈S, ∀ c∈S, a≠b → b≠c → a≠c → d a b c≠0; ∀ (a b : ℤ × ℤ) (y x u : ℤ), a.2≠b.2 → d a b (x,y)=0 → d a b (u,y)=0 → x=u

plain_statement.zh: 非水平割线在一行至多排除一格
plain_statement.en: A nonhorizontal secant forbids at most one site per row

brief.zh: 将两个行列式相减，再消去非零纵坐标差。
brief.en: Subtract determinants and cancel the nonzero vertical difference.

gaps.statement: let d := fun (a b c : ℤ × ℤ) => (b.1-a.1)*(c.2-a.2)-(b.2-a.2)*(c.1-a.1); let ok := fun (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)) => ∀ a∈S, ∀ b∈S, ∀ c∈S, a≠b → b≠c → a≠c → d a b c≠0; ∀ a b t : ℤ, d (a,a^2) (b,b^2) (t,t^2)=(b-a)*(t-a)*(t-b)

plain_statement.zh: 抛物线候选代入割线的整式
plain_statement.en: Secant obstruction on parabola candidates

brief.zh: 将行列式分解，供同余和提升构造共用。
brief.en: Factor the determinant for later reduction and lifting.

gaps.statement: let d := fun (a b c : ℤ × ℤ) => (b.1-a.1)*(c.2-a.2)-(b.2-a.2)*(c.1-a.1); let ok := fun (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)) => ∀ a∈S, ∀ b∈S, ∀ c∈S, a≠b → b≠c → a≠c → d a b c≠0; ∀ (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)) (y : ℤ) (X : Finset ℤ), ok S → (∀ a∈S,a.2≠y) → S.card*(S.card-1)/2<X.card → ∃ x∈X,ok (insert (x,y) S)

plain_statement.zh: 无水平点对时的空行增广保证
plain_statement.en: Free site in an empty row with a secant budget

brief.zh: 按无序点对计数；水平割线与空行没有交点。
brief.en: Count unordered pairs. Horizontal secants miss the empty row.

gaps.statement: ∀ (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (hp : Nat.Prime p), p ≠ 2 → (let det3 : ℤ × ℤ → ℤ × ℤ → ℤ × ℤ → ℤ := fun P Q R => (Q.1 - P.1) * (R.2 - P.2) - (Q.2 - P.2) * (R.1 - P.1); let cap : ZMod p → ZMod p → ZMod p × ZMod p := fun t x => (x + t, x⁻¹); let lift : ZMod p → ZMod p → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℤ × ℤ := fun t x i j => (((cap t x).1.val : ℤ) + (i.val : ℤ) * (p : ℤ), ((cap t x).2.val : ℤ) + (j.val : ℤ) * (p : ℤ)); let Mask : Type := ZMod p → Finset (Fin 2 × Fin 2); let points : ZMod p → Mask → Finset (ℤ × ℤ) := fun t R => (Finset.univ.filter (fun x : ZMod p => x ≠ 0)).biUnion (fun x => (R x).image (fun ij => lift t x ij.1 ij.2)); let NoThreeCollinear : Finset (ℤ × ℤ) → Prop := fun S => ∀ a ∈ S, ∀ b ∈ S, ∀ c ∈ S, a ≠ b → a ≠ c → b ≠ c → det3 a b c ≠ 0; ∃ t : ZMod p, ∃ R : Mask, NoThreeCollinear (points t R) ∧ (∑ x ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun x : ZMod p => x ≠ 0), (R x).card) = 3 * (p - 1))

plain_statement.zh: 对 HJSW 2-周期折叠族（平移 + 每纤维删角 mask）：存在平移与 mask，使 2p 网格上的 lift 点集无三点共线且恰有 3(p−1) 个点，与上界定理共同给出该族的精确最优值。
plain_statement.en: For the HJSW 2-periodic fold family (translation plus a per-fibre deleted-corner mask): some translation and mask place exactly 3(p−1) lift points on the 2p grid with no three collinear, matching the sharp upper bound.

brief.zh: 等号侧。先取 HJSW 的平移 t=(p−1)/2 与删角规则，再用已有的 lift 单射性与三纤维行列式引理排除所有共线三元组，最后核对点数恒等式。
brief.en: Attainment side. Use the HJSW translation t=(p−1)/2 with the deleted-corner rule, exclude all collinear triples via the existing lift injectivity and three-fibre determinant lemmas, then check the point-count identity.

gaps.statement:
∀ (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (hp : Nat.Prime p), p ≠ 2 →
  (let det3 : ℤ × ℤ → ℤ × ℤ → ℤ × ℤ → ℤ :=
     fun P Q R => (Q.1 - P.1) * (R.2 - P.2) - (Q.2 - P.2) * (R.1 - P.1)
   let cap : ZMod p → ZMod p → ZMod p × ZMod p := fun t x => (x + t, x⁻¹)
   let lift : ZMod p → ZMod p → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℤ × ℤ :=
     fun t x i j =>
       (((cap t x).1.val : ℤ) + (i.val : ℤ) * (p : ℤ),
        ((cap t x).2.val : ℤ) + (j.val : ℤ) * (p : ℤ))
   let Mask : Type := ZMod p → Finset (Fin 2 × Fin 2)
   let points : ZMod p → Mask → Finset (ℤ × ℤ) :=
     fun t R =>
       (Finset.univ.filter (fun x : ZMod p => x ≠ 0)).biUnion
         (fun x => (R x).image (fun ij => lift t x ij.1 ij.2))
   let NoThreeCollinear : Finset (ℤ × ℤ) → Prop :=
     fun S => ∀ a ∈ S, ∀ b ∈ S, ∀ c ∈ S, a ≠ b → a ≠ c → b ≠ c → det3 a b c ≠ 0
   ∀ (t : ZMod p) (R : Mask), NoThreeCollinear (points t R) →
     (∑ x ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun x : ZMod p => x ≠ 0), (R x).card) ≤ 3 * (p - 1))

plain_statement.zh: 对任意奇素数 p、任意平移 t 与任意每剩余 mask：若平移双曲线 cap 的 2-周期提升点无三点共线，则总点数不超过 3(p−1)。即 HJSW 的 3(p−1) 是该折叠族的上界，该族无净增。
plain_statement.en: For every odd prime p, every shift t and every mask: if the 2-period lift of the shifted hyperbola cap has no three collinear points, the total number of points is at most 3(p−1). Thus HJSW's 3(p−1) is an upper bound within this fold family, which admits no net gain.

brief.zh: 平移双曲线 cap 的 2-周期折叠族的 3(p−1) 最优性（对一切奇素数 p）。先用行列式展开与模 p 条件把纤维对约束刻画为 xx'≡±1，再证边对 S=6、约束图是 C2/C4 之并，最后用独立集/邻域计数得 Σ≤3(p−1)。
brief.en: Optimality of 3(p−1) for the 2-period fold family of the shifted hyperbola cap (all odd primes). Fibre-pair constraints are characterised by xx'≡±1 via a determinant expansion; edge pairs have S=6; the constraint graph is a union of C2/C4; an independent-set/neighbour count gives Σ≤3(p−1).

plain_statement.zh: 两个提升点相差 p(u,v) 时，第三点与它们共线当且仅当 u(t−y)=v(s−x)。
plain_statement.en: For a pair separated by p(u,v), a third point (s,t) lies on its line exactly when u(t−y)=v(s−x).

brief.zh: 在两周期窗口中，互异同余点的方向只有水平、垂直、斜率 ±1 四类。对选取掩码逐类核查整条直线上的点数。
brief.en: Cancel p. Distinct representatives of one residue in a two-period square yield only horizontal, vertical and the two diagonal directions. Check entire lines against the selection rule.

zh: 确定问题与计数上界
用整数行列式定义合法性。每行、每列至多两点，求和得 M(n)≤2n。取等时每行每列恰有两点，可用来校验满额样例。
en: Define the problem and count by rows
Use the integer determinant. Count by rows and columns to obtain M(n)≤2n. Saturation in both coordinates checks extremal examples.

tasks.en: Rows and columns at saturation

zh: 复现两条有限域构造
抛物线给出大小为 p 的完整样例。双曲线割线引理是较高密度构造的起点，两题可同时做。
en: Formalize two modular constructions
Lift the parabola for a complete size-p example. Independently prove the secant lemma needed for the denser hyperbola construction.

tasks.zh: 把模抛物线放回点阵
tasks.en: Lift the modular parabola

tasks.zh: 双曲线的割线
tasks.en: Secants of the hyperbola

zh: 核对两周期提升中的全部三点
取奇素数 p。先写出四份代表元的选取规则并数出 3(p−1) 点。三个余类互异用双曲线割线引理；只要两个余类相同，就检查该点对所在的四类方向。
en: Check every triple in the two-period lift
For odd prime p specify a selection among four lifts and count 3(p−1) points. Use the conic for three distinct residues and the four direction checks whenever a residue repeats.

tasks.zh: 两周期点阵构造
tasks.en: The two-period construction

tasks.zh: 对 HJSW 2-周期折叠族（平移 + 每纤维删角 mask）：存在平移与 mask，使 2p 网格上的 lift 点集无三点共线且恰有 3(p−1) 个点，与上界定理共同给出该族的精确最优值。
tasks.en: For the HJSW 2-periodic fold family (translation plus a per-fibre deleted-corner mask): some translation and mask place exactly 3(p−1) lift points on the 2p grid with no three collinear, matching the sharp upper bound.

tasks.zh: 对任意奇素数 p、任意平移 t 与任意每剩余 mask：若平移双曲线 cap 的 2-周期提升点无三点共线，则总点数不超过 3(p−1)。即 HJSW 的 3(p−1) 是该折叠族的上界，该族无净增。
tasks.en: For every odd prime p, every shift t and every mask: if the 2-period lift of the shifted hyperbola cap has no three collinear points, the total number of points is at most 3(p−1). Thus HJSW's 3(p−1) is an upper bound within this fold family, which admits no net gain.

tasks.zh: 两个提升点相差 p(u,v) 时，第三点与它们共线当且仅当 u(t−y)=v(s−x)。
tasks.en: For a pair separated by p(u,v), a third point (s,t) lies on its line exactly when u(t−y)=v(s−x).

zh: 复现所有充分大边长的基线
取不超过 n/2 的最大素数 p，用素数定理给出 2p/n→1。嵌入后得到 M(n)≥(3/2−o(1))n。这一步可与提升证明独立准备。
en: Transfer the baseline to general sides
Choose the largest prime p≤n/2. The prime number theorem gives 2p/n→1. Embed the smaller square to recover the eventual baseline.

tasks.zh: 从素数边长推到一般边长
tasks.en: Pass from prime scales to all grids

zh: 试验新点并计算必须删除的旧点
固定经典点集 B，试取另一模双曲线上的合法子集 U，与 B 不交。先删除落在 U 的割线上的旧点；在剩余旧点上，两点连线穿过 U 就连边。任一顶点覆盖给出可行的额外删除集。保存参数、点表及删除证书。
en: Test additions and price the deletions

Fix a classical set B and test a disjoint valid subset U from a different modular hyperbola. Delete old points on secants of U, then join surviving old pairs whose line hits U. A vertex cover specifies the remaining deletions. Record parameters, coordinates and a deletion certificate.

tasks.zh: 证明两类混合三点判据
tasks.en: Prove the mixed-secant criterion

zh: 证明无穷族有固定净增益
开放步骤。给出同一条选点、删点规则，在无穷多个素数上证明 |U|−|D|≥ηp，η>0 固定。配合预算引理得 δ=η/4。若一个模板中匹配下界已耗尽新增点数，记录障碍后更换模板。其他构造可直接提交总目标。
en: Prove a uniform net gain

Open step. Give a uniform rule with |U|−|D|≥ηp for infinitely many primes and one η>0. The budget gives δ=η/4. If a matching lower bound exhausts the additions for a template, record the obstruction and change the template. Other families can address the endpoint directly.

tasks.zh: 把净增点数换成固定比例
tasks.en: Convert a net gain into a fixed margin

tasks.zh: 突破 3/2 密度
tasks.en: Beat density 3/2

zh: 格点行容量与斜线证书
通过坐标差的行列式校验三点，再用行容量审查接近上界的构型。
en: Row capacity and slope certificates
Use the determinant to certify collinearity and row capacity to check near-extremizers.

tasks.zh: 整数剪切保持共线行列式
tasks.en: Shears preserve the collinearity determinant

tasks.zh: 交换坐标只改变方向符号
tasks.en: Axis swap reverses determinant sign

tasks.zh: 达到 2n 时每行恰有两点
tasks.en: Saturation forces two points in every row

tasks.zh: 欠饱和行数受总缺口控制
tasks.en: Bound unsaturated rows by the total deficit

zh: 逐点增广与割线冲突
从现有无三点共线构型出发，用割线筛除非法候选，寻找净增益。
en: Augment configurations using secant conflicts
Extend a valid configuration by certifying candidate sites against its secants.

tasks.zh: 单点增广的充要判据
tasks.en: Exact criterion for inserting one site

tasks.zh: 删一点加两点的合法性证书
tasks.en: Certificate for replacing one site by two

tasks.zh: 非水平割线在一行至多排除一格
tasks.en: A nonhorizontal secant forbids at most one site per row

tasks.zh: 抛物线候选代入割线的整式
tasks.en: Secant obstruction on parabola candidates

tasks.zh: 无水平点对时的空行增广保证
tasks.en: Free site in an empty row with a secant budget

zh: 按原始方向计量禁用三点构型
把起点条件化为两个独立坐标的范围，给构型搜索提供冲突计数。
en: Count forbidden triples by primitive direction
Separate the starting coordinates to count equally spaced forbidden triples.

background.zh: Lee 的固定偶差结果带有一致比值假设。此台把差二的单侧余量、素数幂污染及 Levent Alpöge 工程可提供的单变量输入逐项冻结。
background.en: Lee treats fixed even differences under a uniform ratios conjecture. This desk isolates a one-sided margin at gap two, the proper-power error and the one-variable inputs from Levent Alpöge’s project.

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然推广 · TP-0063 · 控制短窗中两个近平衡素因子造成的加权污染
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH methods and extensions · TP-0063 · Bound the weighted contribution of semiprimes with balanced factors in the window

brief.zh: 按较小因子 r 分组。由实际窗与 r 的范围把 s 放入常数个二进窗。TP-0062 给每个 r 的上界，再用 Chebyshev 的素数计数界求和。此项仅兑现差二粗筛中近平衡的不同素数乘积预算。
brief.en: Group by the smaller factor r. The window and the bounds on r put s in a bounded number of dyadic intervals. Apply TP-0062 and then the Chebyshev bound for the number of prime r. This controls the part of the rough gap-two sieve with two balanced distinct factors.

gaps.statement: ∀ (r ℓ : ℕ), r.Prime → 2 < r → ℓ.Prime → ((Finset.range ℓ).filter (fun a => a % ℓ = 0 ∨ (r*a) % ℓ = 2 % ℓ)).card = if ℓ = 2 ∨ ℓ = r then 1 else 2

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然推广 · TP-0061 · 计算余因子素数 r 下两条线性式的局部坏类
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH methods and extensions · TP-0061 · Count the forbidden classes for the two linear forms with prime cofactor r

brief.zh: 两条线性式为 s 和 rs−2。模 2 时两根合并，模 r 时第二式为非零常数，其余素数各去两个不同类。使用同余式避免在 s=0 时发生 Nat 截断。
brief.en: The forms are s and rs−2. Their roots coincide modulo 2. Modulo r the second form is a nonzero constant. Every other prime removes two distinct classes. Use modular equality to handle s=0 without truncated subtraction.

gaps.statement: ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (Y r : ℕ), 3 ≤ Y → r.Prime → 2 < r → ((((Finset.Ioc Y (2*Y)).filter (fun s => s.Prime ∧ (r*s-2).Prime)).card:ℕ):ℝ) ≤ C*(Y:ℝ)/(Real.log Y)^2

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然推广 · TP-0062 · 给固定素数余因子的双线性式筛出统一上界
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH methods and extensions · TP-0062 · Give a uniform upper sieve bound for the two forms with a fixed prime cofactor

brief.zh: 已知的二维 Selberg 上界筛移植。对每个固定 r 在长度 Y 的窗使用 TP-0061，异常 Euler 因子的相对放大至多 2。CRT 余项逐坏类最多一项，常数须对奇素数 r 一致。选低次幂筛界后两个实际素数值皆大于筛界。
brief.en: Formalize a two-dimensional Selberg upper sieve in an interval of length Y. TP-0061 shows that the exceptional Euler factor changes the constant by at most 2. Count each CRT class with error at most one. The constant is uniform in the odd prime r, and both prime values exceed a small power of Y.

gaps.statement: (∀ (q : ℕ) [NeZero q] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (s : ℂ), 0 < s.re → s.re < 1 → DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ s = 0 → s.re = 1/2) → (let w := fun (X : ℕ) => (Finset.range (2*X+1)).filter (fun n => X < n ∧ 50*n < 51*X); let A := fun (X d : ℕ) => ((w X).filter (fun p => p.Prime ∧ d ∣ p+2)).sum (fun p => Real.log p); let D := fun (X : ℕ) => Nat.floor (Real.sqrt X/(Real.log (2+(X:ℝ)))^5); ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ X : ℕ, 3 ≤ X → (((Finset.Icc 1 (D X)).filter Odd).sum (fun d => Real.log d * |A X d-(X:ℝ)/(50*Nat.totient d)|))/(X:ℝ) ≤ C/(Real.log (2+(X:ℝ)))^2)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然推广 · TP-0059 · 将 GRH 进程误差绝对求和到近平方根截点
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH methods and extensions · TP-0059 · Sum the absolute GRH progression errors to a cutoff below the square root

brief.zh: 逐模使用 TP-0030。d≤D≤X 时有 log d·log²(2dX)≪log³(2+X)，乘上 D/√X 后得到逆平方对数预算。
brief.en: Apply TP-0030 separately to each modulus. For d≤D≤X, the three log factors cost O(log³(2+X)). Multiplying by D/√X gives an inverse-square-log error.

gaps.statement: RiemannHypothesis → (∀ (q : ℕ) [NeZero q] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (s : ℂ), 0 < s.re → s.re < 1 → DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ s = 0 → s.re = 1/2) → (let w := fun (X : ℕ) => (Finset.range (2*X+1)).filter (fun n => X < n ∧ 50*n < 51*X); let D := fun (X : ℕ) => Nat.floor (Real.sqrt X/(Real.log (2+(X:ℝ)))^5); let A := fun (X : ℕ) => Nat.floor ((X:ℝ)^(1/3:ℝ)); let c := fun (d : ℕ) => -(ArithmeticFunction.moebius d : ℝ)*Real.log d; let strip := fun (X : ℕ) => (((w X).filter Nat.Prime).sum (fun p => Real.log p * (((p+2).divisors.filter (fun d => A X < d ∧ d ≤ D X)).sum c)))/(X:ℝ); Filter.Tendsto strip Filter.atTop (nhds 0))

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然推广 · TP-0060 · 在同一窄窗把立方根到近平方根的带符号除数和压到零
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH methods and extensions · TP-0060 · Show that the signed divisor strip from the cube root to the new cutoff tends to zero

brief.zh: 两个截点都趋于无穷，最终 D≥A。TP-0034 的两个截断主项同收敛到 2C₂/50，TP-0059 控制实际进程误差。由此把 TP-0038 的剩余分析移到 d>D，保留其原尺度和余量。
brief.en: Both cutoffs tend to infinity and D≥A eventually. TP-0034 gives the same 2C₂/50 limit at each cutoff. TP-0059 controls the actual progression errors. This moves the analysis in TP-0038 to d>D at the original scale and margin.

gaps.statement: ∃ c : ℝ, 0<c ∧ ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ X : ℕ, N≤X → c*X ≤ ∑ p ∈ (Finset.Ioo X (2*X)).filter (fun p => 50*p<51*X ∧ p.Prime ∧ Nat.nthRoot 5 X ≤ (p+2).minFac), Real.log p * Real.log (p+2)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 方法与自然推广 · 五次根筛点的首端素数质量
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH methods and extensions · Lower-bound prime mass after the fifth-root sieve

brief.zh: 在所有充分大的 $X$ 证明 $A_X(z_0)\ge c_0X$，给出与 $X$ 无关的 $c_0>0$。对带 $\log p$ 的序列 $p+2$ 用一维下筛，奇素数局部密度 $1/(\ell-1)$，2 处不筛。Bombieri–Vinogradov 在 $D=X^{1/2}/\log^A X$ 提供加权算术级数的余项，$\log D/\log z_0\to5/2>2$。补乘窗内 $\log(p+2)$。这给中段两个损失共用的起始质量。
brief.en: Apply a dimension-one lower sieve to p+2 with prime progression errors at Bombieri–Vinogradov level.

gaps.statement: ∃ C : ℝ, 0<C ∧ ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ X : ℕ, N≤X → (∑ p ∈ (Finset.Ioo X (2*X)).filter (fun p => 50*p<51*X ∧ p.Prime ∧ Nat.nthRoot 5 X ≤ (p+2).minFac ∧ (p+2).minFac < 2*Nat.nthRoot 5 X), Real.log p * Real.log (p+2)) ≤ C*X/Real.log X

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 方法与自然推广 · 首次命中五次根边带的权上界
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH methods and extensions · Bound the first hits in the doubled fifth-root band

brief.zh: 证明 $H_X[z_0,2z_0)\ll X/\log X$。对素数 $r=\operatorname{minFac}(p+2)$ 写 $p=rs-2$。$s$ 可以合成，但没有小于 $r$ 的素因子。对 $s(rs-2)$ 上筛到 $X^{1/30}$，用 `cofactor-sieve-root-count`，得到每个 $r$ 至多 $O(X/(r\log^2 X))$ 个候选。$r$ 大于该筛点，余项对 $r$ 一致。再用 $\sum_{z_0\le r<2z_0,\ r\ {\rm prime}}1/r\ll1/\log X$。
brief.en: Switch to p=rs−2 and use an upper sieve for the two forms s and rs−2.

gaps.statement: let Λ := ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt; ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ Y : ℕ, 2 ≤ Y → (@Finset.filter ℕ (fun n => ∃ p k : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ 3 ≤ k ∧ n = p^k) (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _) (Finset.range (Y+1))).sum (fun n => Λ n) ≤ C*(Y:ℝ)^(1/3:ℝ)*Real.log (2+(Y:ℝ))

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然推广 · TP-0056 · 给三次及以上真素数幂分配三次根预算
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH methods and extensions · TP-0056 · Bound the log mass of prime powers of exponent at least three

brief.zh: 按指数层求和，底数均不超过 Y^(1/3)，指数层数至多 log Y/log 2。跨指数重复出现时保留上界方向。
brief.en: Sum over the exponents. The bases are at most Y^(1/3) and there are at most log Y/log 2 exponent levels. Repeated images only increase the upper bound.

gaps.statement: ∀ p r s : ℕ, p.Prime → r.Prime → 1<s → p+2=r*s → r<s.minFac → (¬ Nat.Prime s) → ∃ ℓ m : ℕ, ℓ.Prime ∧ r<ℓ ∧ ℓ ≤ m ∧ ℓ ≤ Nat.minFac m ∧ s = ℓ * m ∧ r^3<p+2

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 方法与自然推广 · 中段 Buchstab 换元的整数范围
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH methods and extensions · Recover the middle-band Buchstab cofactor range

brief.zh: 对 S06 以外的每个 $p$ 写 $p+2=rs$。若 $s$ 合成，取 $\ell=\operatorname{minFac}(s)$，则 $r<\ell\le m$，$s=\ell m$，$\operatorname{minFac}(m)\ge\ell$。给出 $X<r\ell m-2<51X/50$ 的精确整数端点，并证明 $r^3<51X/50+2$。若 $s$ 素，则 $r<s$ 且 $p=rs-2$ 素。两族与 S06 互斥并穷尽中段。
brief.en: Choose the next least prime factor once repetitions of the first factor have been removed.

gaps.statement: ∀ X r : ℕ, 1<r → ((Finset.Icc X (2*X)).filter fun p => p.Prime ∧ r^2 ∣ p+2).card ≤ X/r^2+1

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 方法与自然推广 · 重复最小素因子的整除上界
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH methods and extensions · Count the repeated least-factor divisibility loss

brief.zh: 对 $2z_0\le r<z_*$，只计最小素因子为 $r$ 且 $r^2\mid p+2$ 的项。逐 $r$ 的整除计数至多 $2X/r^2+1$，故这些项的总权 $\ll(X/z_0+\sqrt X)\log^2(2+X)$。
brief.en: For fixed r bound the number of candidates by the number of multiples of r² in the containing interval.

gaps.statement: ∀ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C → ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ (t : ℝ) (L : ℕ) (m : ℤ → ℝ), (∀ j : ℤ, 0 ≤ m j ∧ m j ≤ C*Real.log (2+|(Int.floor t : ℝ)+(j:ℝ)|)) → (∑' j : ℤ, if L ≤ j.natAbs then m j/(1+(j.natAbs:ℝ))^6 else 0) ≤ K*Real.log (2+|t|+(L:ℝ))/(1+(L:ℝ))^5

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然推广 · TP-0070 · 按重数控制以任意 t 为中心的截断零点尾
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH methods and extensions · TP-0070 · Bound the zero tail with multiplicity uniformly about a moving height

brief.zh: 给以 floor t 为原点、有正负向的单位窗分配重数。用 log(2+|t|+L+k)≤log(2+|t|+L)+log(1+k/(1+L))，或分二进壳求和。TP-0022 给单侧模型。新界保留 t 及 L 的依赖，供 TP-0026 的移动截尾。
brief.en: Use unit windows in both directions about floor t. Separate the log at scale 1+L, or sum over dyadic shells. TP-0022 gives the one-sided model. Keep the dependence on t and L to bound the moving truncation in TP-0026.

gaps.statement: ∃ C : ℝ, 0<C ∧ ∀ U : ℕ, 3≤U → (((Finset.Ioc U (2*U)).filter fun r => r.Prime ∧ (r^2-2).Prime).card : ℝ) ≤ C*U/(Real.log U)^2

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 方法与自然推广 · 素数平方减二的上筛
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH methods and extensions · Upper-sieve primes whose square minus two is prime

brief.zh: 证明存在统一 $C$，使每个整数 $U\ge3$ 都有 $\#\{U<r\le2U:r,\ r^2-2\text{ 均素}\}\le CU/\log^2 U$。对 W02 的多项式筛到 $z=U^{1/20}$，可取余项水平 $D=U^{1/2}$。逐模误差用 $\sum_{d\le D}\mu^2(d)3^{\omega(d)}\nu(d)\ll D\log^8(2D)$ 支付，主项用 W03。两素数都大于筛点。与上一批两条线性式的上筛分开验收。
brief.en: Use the dimension-two local sieve factors for r(r²−2) and sum the squarefree modulus errors.

gaps.statement: (∀ (q : ℕ) [NeZero q] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (s : ℂ), 0 < s.re → s.re < 1 → DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ s = 0 → s.re = 1/2) → (let w := fun (X : ℕ) => (Finset.range (2*X+1)).filter (fun n => X < n ∧ 50*n < 51*X); let S := fun (X q : ℕ) => ((w X).filter (fun p => p.Prime ∧ Nat.Coprime (p+2) q)).sum (fun p => Real.log p); let V := fun (q : ℕ) => q.primeFactors.prod (fun r => 1-1/((r:ℝ)-1)); ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (X q : ℕ), 2 ≤ X → q ≤ X → Odd q → Squarefree q → |S X q-(X:ℝ)/50*V q| ≤ C*(q.divisors.card:ℝ)*Real.sqrt X*(Real.log (2*(q:ℝ)*X))^2)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然推广 · TP-0065 · 计算同窗真素数乘差二轮筛的主项与误差
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH methods and extensions · TP-0065 · Compute the main term and error for a gap-two wheel on actual primes in the window

brief.zh: 只在第二端施加 q 的互素遮罩。用 Möbius 容斥，TP-0030 给每个 d∣q 的实际 −2 类进程误差。有限乘积的局部因子是 1−1/(r−1)，保留 q=1 和绝对误差。可给 Θ 测试的真素数端一阶归一化。
brief.en: Apply the coprimality mask only to the translated endpoint. Use Möbius inclusion and exclusion with the actual −2 progression bound TP-0030 for each d∣q. The finite product has factors 1−1/(r−1), including the empty product at q=1. This gives a first-moment normalization on the prime side of the theta test.

gaps.statement: ∀ ℓ : ℕ, ℓ.Prime → ((Finset.range ℓ).filter fun a => (a=0 ∨ a^2%ℓ=2%ℓ)).card = if ℓ=2 then 1 else 1+((Finset.range ℓ).filter fun a => a^2%ℓ=2%ℓ).card

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 方法与自然推广 · 二次平方邻居筛的局部根数
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH methods and extensions · Count forbidden residue classes in the quadratic square-neighbor sieve

brief.zh:
记 $
u(d)=\#\{r mod d:d\mid r(r^2-2)\}$。证明 $
u(2)=1$，奇素数 $\ell$ 有 $
u(\ell)=2+( rac2\ell)$，平方自由 $d$ 上可乘。任意连续 $U$ 个整数中命中此模数的个数与 $U
u(d)/d$ 相差至多 $
u(d)$。
brief.en: Separate a=0 and a²=2. Treat the modulus two separately.

gaps.statement: let w := fun (X : ℕ) => (Finset.range (2*X+1)).filter (fun n => X < n ∧ 50*n < 51*X); let z := fun (X : ℕ) => Nat.sqrt X / 2; ∀ (X p : ℕ), 4096 ≤ X → p ∈ w X → z X ≤ (p+2).minFac → (p+2).Prime ∨ (∃ r s : ℕ, r.Prime ∧ s.Prime ∧ z X ≤ r ∧ r ≤ s ∧ r ≤ Nat.sqrt (2*X+2) ∧ p+2=r*s)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然推广 · TP-0067 · 给近平方根筛余值确定精确的素因子形状
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH methods and extensions · TP-0067 · Classify the factors of survivors near the square-root cutoff

brief.zh: 先证 z≥32 且 z³>2X+2。若 p+2 含三个带重数的素因子，其乘积至少 z³。按最小素因子写剩下两因子的情形，保留平方分支。
brief.en: First prove z≥32 and z³>2X+2. Three prime factors counted with multiplicity would force a product of at least z³. The conclusion keeps the prime-square branch, then separates distinct two-prime products.

gaps.statement: let w := fun (X : ℕ) => (Finset.range (2*X+1)).filter (fun n => X < n ∧ 50*n < 51*X); let z := fun (X : ℕ) => Nat.sqrt X / 2; let R := fun (X : ℕ) => ((w X).filter (fun p => p.Prime ∧ z X ≤ (p+2).minFac)); let T := fun (X : ℕ) => ((w X).filter (fun p => p.Prime ∧ (p+2).Prime)); let Q := fun (X : ℕ) => ((w X).filter (fun p => p.Prime ∧ (Nat.sqrt (p+2)).Prime ∧ p+2=(Nat.sqrt (p+2))^2)); let S := fun (X : ℕ) => @Finset.filter ℕ (fun p => p.Prime ∧ ∃ r s : ℕ, r.Prime ∧ s.Prime ∧ r < s ∧ Nat.sqrt X/2 ≤ r ∧ r ≤ Nat.sqrt (2*X+2) ∧ p+2=r*s) (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _) (w X); let L := fun (p : ℕ) => Real.log p * Real.log (p+2); ∀ (X : ℕ) (M E F : ℝ), 4096 ≤ X → M ≤ (R X).sum L → (Q X).sum L ≤ E → (S X).sum L ≤ F → M-E-F ≤ (T X).sum L

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然推广 · TP-0069 · 由同一短窗的粗筛下界与两项污染预算提取真素数质量
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH methods and extensions · TP-0069 · Extract prime-pair mass from the rough count and both loss bounds in the same window

brief.zh: 用 TP-0067 把粗筛和逐项覆盖到真素数、平方和两个不同素数。用 TP-0063、0068 的量纲同为对数权乘积。若 M−E−F>0，同一 X 有一对。用于 TP-0052R，仍需实际粗筛下界。
brief.en: Use TP-0067 to cover each rough survivor by a prime, a square or two distinct primes. TP-0063 and TP-0068 give bounds with the same log-product weights. A positive remainder supplies a pair at that X. TP-0052R still needs a lower bound on the actual rough count.

gaps.statement: let w := fun (X : ℕ) => (Finset.range (2*X+1)).filter (fun n => X < n ∧ 50*n < 51*X); let Λ := ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt; let E := fun (X : ℕ) => ((w X).filter (fun n => ¬ (n.Prime ∧ (n+2).Prime))).sum (fun n => Λ n * Λ (n+2)) / (X:ℝ); ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ X : ℕ, 2 ≤ X → E X ≤ C*Real.log (2+(X:ℝ))^3/Real.sqrt X

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然推广 · TP-0057 · 在旧窄窗将高次幂污染压到 log X/√X
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH methods and extensions · TP-0057 · Reduce proper-power contamination in the original window to log X/√X

brief.zh: 将每一端的坏项由单端 Λ 质量控制，另一端至多贡献一个对数因子。平方根计数和三重对数预算合成 log³ X/√X。用于 TP-0003 的提取及 TP-0015 的双矩转移。
brief.en: Bound bad terms using the Λ mass at either endpoint and at most one logarithmic factor at the other endpoint. Combine the square-root count with a log-cubed budget. This supports the extraction and moment transfer in TP-0003 and TP-0015.

gaps.statement: ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime], 2 < p → ∀ (χ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p), (∑ x : ZMod p, χ x * ψ (x+2)) = χ (-2) * ψ 2 * (∑ y : ZMod p, χ y * ψ (1-y)) ∧ (χ ≠ 1 → (∑ x : ZMod p, χ x * (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ p) (x+2)) = -χ (-2))

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然推广 · TP-0064 · 计算奇素模下差二混合特征的 Jacobi 相位和主特征列
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH methods and extensions · TP-0064 · Compute the Jacobi phase and the principal column for gap-two mixed characters

brief.zh: 用单位换元 x=−2y 保留 χ(−2)ψ(2)。第二式拿掉 x=−2 的一项并用非主特征和为零。给指定平移局部试验核对实际混合系数。
brief.en: Change variables by the unit x=−2y, keeping χ(−2)ψ(2). For the second identity, delete x=−2 and use the vanishing sum of a nonprincipal character. This gives mixed coefficients for the local test at the prescribed shift.

gaps.statement: let w := fun (X : ℕ) => (Finset.range (2*X+1)).filter (fun n => X < n ∧ 50*n < 51*X); let Q := fun (X : ℕ) => ((w X).filter (fun p => p.Prime ∧ (Nat.sqrt (p+2)).Prime ∧ p+2=(Nat.sqrt (p+2))^2)); let L := fun (p : ℕ) => Real.log p * Real.log (p+2); ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ X : ℕ, 2 ≤ X → (Q X).sum L ≤ C*Real.sqrt X*Real.log (2+(X:ℝ))

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然推广 · TP-0068 · 消去短窗中 p+2 为素数平方的加权贡献
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH methods and extensions · TP-0068 · Bound the weighted contribution when p+2 is a prime square in the window

brief.zh: 将 p+2=r² 的权写为 2·log p·log r。p↦p+2 无重数，套 TP-0055 给所有平方底数的对数权总量。
brief.en: Write the weight for p+2=r² as 2·log p·log r. The map p↦p+2 is injective. Use TP-0055 for the total log weight of prime bases.

gaps.statement: let Λ := ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt; ∀ Y : ℕ, ((Finset.range (Y+1)).filter (fun n => (Nat.sqrt n).Prime ∧ n = (Nat.sqrt n)^2)).sum (fun n => Λ n) ≤ Real.log 4 * Real.sqrt Y

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然推广 · TP-0055 · 给真素数平方的对数权分配平方根预算
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH methods and extensions · TP-0055 · Bound the log mass of prime squares by a square-root budget

brief.zh: 平方位置按底素数唯一重排。Λ(p²)=log p，再用 Chebyshev.theta 的上界。该预算保留了一重对数权，供差二短窗的污染估计。

brief.zh: 对 $n\ge10$ 且 $\Lambda(n)\Lambda(n+2)>0$ 的坏项，证明至少一端是指数 $\ge3$ 的素数幂，或 $n=r^2-2$ 与 $r$ 均为素数。若左端为素数平方且底数 $r>3$，则 $3\mid r^2+2$，右端有权只能是 $3^k$，且 $k\ge3$。枚举小底数。
brief.en: Reduce a prime square plus two modulo three and check the exceptional small bases.

gaps.statement: let w := fun (X : ℕ) => (Finset.range (2*X+1)).filter (fun n => X < n ∧ 50*n < 51*X); ∀ (q X : ℕ), 0 < q → 200*(q+1) ≤ X → (∃ a : ℕ, a < q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ Nat.Coprime (a+2) q) → (∃ f g : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ n, (f n=0 ∨ f n=1) ∧ (g n=0 ∨ g n=1) ∧ (¬ (n ∈ w X ∧ Nat.Coprime n q) → f n=0 ∧ g n=0)) ∧ (∀ a : ℕ, a < q → ((w X).filter (fun n => n%q=a)).sum f = ((w X).filter (fun n => n%q=a)).sum g) ∧ (w X).sum (fun n => f n * f (n+2))=1 ∧ (w X).sum (fun n => g n * g (n+2))=0)

brief.en: Use the sieve for square neighbors and the count of proper prime powers with exponent at least three.

gaps.statement: let w := fun (X : ℕ) => (Finset.range (2*X+1)).filter (fun n => X < n ∧ 50*n < 51*X); ∀ (X : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ) (A : ℝ), 2 ≤ X → 0 ≤ A → (∀ n : ℕ, n ≤ 2*X+2 → 0 ≤ f n ∧ f n ≤ A) → 0 ≤ (w X).sum (fun n => f n * f (n+2)) - ((w X).filter (fun n => n+2 ∈ w X)).sum (fun n => f n * f (n+2)) ∧ (w X).sum (fun n => f n * f (n+2)) - ((w X).filter (fun n => n+2 ∈ w X)).sum (fun n => f n * f (n+2)) ≤ 2*A^2

brief.zh: 待证。Polymath8b 定理 3.2(xii) 在广义 Elliott–Halberstam 假设下证明同一结论。这里保留所有可容许三元组并去掉该假设。可先查 Theorem 3.2 如何把分布误差与筛权分离，再寻找仅需三元组的带符号相关余量。对 {0,2,6} 特化得到无穷多对距离不超过 6。
brief.en: Open. Polymath8b Theorem 3.2(xii) assumes generalized Elliott–Halberstam. Retain all admissible triples and remove that hypothesis. Study the separation of distribution error and sieve weights, then seek a signed correlation margin adapted to three shifts. The triple {0,2,6} gives arbitrarily large pairs at distance at most six.

plain_statement.zh: 无条件把无限复现的素数间隔压到 4 以内

brief.zh: 待证。对每个下界 B 找到两个大于 B 且距离至多 4 的素数，等价于 H₁≤4。Polymath8b 定理 1.4 在 GEH 下给出 6。可研究实际素数权的差二、差四相关合计能否在无界尺度压过素数幂污染；纯筛上界不能提供这里的正性。结果会把无限复现的候选间隔缩到 2、4。
brief.en: Open. A prime pair within four beyond every bound is equivalent to H₁ ≤ 4. Polymath8b Theorem 1.4 gives six under GEH. Seek an actual gap-two plus gap-four correlation surplus on unbounded scales after prime-power contamination. This leaves two and four as the possible recurring gaps at this scale.

question.zh: 容纳 n 个可旋转的单位正方形，最小外框边长是多少？
question.en: What is the smallest square that can contain n freely rotated unit squares?

summary.zh: 分别证明一个边长放得下、任何更小边长放不下。先在五块上复现最优值，再研究十一块的上下界。
summary.en: Certify feasible side lengths and prove impossibility below them. Recover the five-square optimum before narrowing the eleven-square bounds.

gaps.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (s : ℝ), 0 ≤ s → (n : ℝ) ≤ s ^ 2 → Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) ≤ s

plain_statement.zh: 给定非负边长 s，由 n ≤ s² 推出面积给出的边长下界 √n ≤ s。
plain_statement.en: For a nonnegative side s, the area inequality n ≤ s² gives the side lower bound √n ≤ s.

plain_statement.zh: 由 a² + b² = 1 定义的二维旋转保持向量长度。
plain_statement.en: A planar rotation with a² + b² = 1 preserves squared vector length.

plain_statement.zh: 同一平面旋转作用于两点，保持它们的平方距离。
plain_statement.en: Applying one planar rotation to two points preserves their squared distance.

brief.zh: 可以用差向量表述，核验旋转单位正方形的任意两顶点之间的距离。
brief.en: Apply the rotation to a difference vector. This certifies distances between any two vertices of a rotated unit square.

gaps.statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ), n ≤ k ^ 2 → ∃ centers : Fin n → ℕ × ℕ, Function.Injective centers ∧ ∀ i, (centers i).1 < k ∧ (centers i).2 < k

plain_statement.zh: 若 n ≤ k²，就能为 n 个正方形分配 k × k 整数网格中互异的单元编号。
plain_statement.en: If n ≤ k², n squares can be assigned distinct cell indices in a k × k integer grid.

brief.zh: 用商与余数构造单元编号，单独处理 k = 0。后续可用单元编号构造轴对齐装填。
brief.en: Construct the cell indices using quotient and remainder, including k = 0. The indices can then be used in an axis-aligned construction.

plain_statement.zh: 以 (x, y) 为中心的旋转单位正方形位于边长 s 的轴对齐外框内，当且仅当中心到四条边的距离都至少为 (|a| + |b|)/2。
plain_statement.en: A rotated unit square centred at (x, y) lies inside [0,s] × [0,s] exactly when each of the four coordinate margins is at least (|a| + |b|)/2.

brief.zh: 用绝对值不等式证明充分性，再按旋转系数符号选取顶点证明必要性。
brief.en: Prove sufficiency with absolute-value inequalities and necessity by choosing vertices according to the coefficient signs.

gaps.statement: let inside := fun (x y a b X Y : ℝ) => |a*(X-x)+b*(Y-y)| < 1/2 ∧ |(-b)*(X-x)+a*(Y-y)| < 1/2; let radius := fun (a b u v : ℝ) => (|u*a+v*b| + |v*a-u*b|)/2; ∀ x y a b u v X Y : ℝ, a^2+b^2=1 → (u ≠ 0 ∨ v ≠ 0) → inside x y a b X Y → |u*(X-x)+v*(Y-y)| < radius a b u v

plain_statement.zh: 任意非零方向上，单位正方形内部点到中心的投影距离严格小于该方向的投影半宽。
plain_statement.en: In any nonzero direction the projection of an interior point lies strictly within the square’s projection radius.

brief.zh: 把方向向量写在正方形自身的两条坐标轴上。严格不等号允许不同正方形的边缘接触。
brief.en: Resolve the direction along the two rotated axes. Strict inequalities allow contact at a boundary.

gaps.statement: let inside := fun (x y a b X Y : ℝ) => |a*(X-x)+b*(Y-y)| < 1/2 ∧ |(-b)*(X-x)+a*(Y-y)| < 1/2; let radius := fun (a b u v : ℝ) => (|u*a+v*b| + |v*a-u*b|)/2; ∀ x y a b z w c d u v : ℝ, a^2+b^2=1 → c^2+d^2=1 → (u ≠ 0 ∨ v ≠ 0) → radius a b u v + radius c d u v ≤ |u*(z-x)+v*(w-y)| → ∀ X Y : ℝ, inside x y a b X Y → ¬ inside z w c d X Y

plain_statement.zh: 若某个非零方向上的中心投影距离至少等于两个半宽之和，则两块单位正方形的内部不相交。
plain_statement.en: A nonzero direction that separates the projected centers by at least the sum of the radii certifies disjoint interiors.

brief.zh: 为每一对方块提供一个分离方向。共用投影引理即可核验不同装填构造。
brief.en: Supply a separating direction for each pair and reuse the projection calculation across layouts.

gaps.statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (A : Fin n → Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (z : Fin k → ℝ × ℝ), (∀ i j, i ≠ j → Disjoint (A i) (A j)) → (∀ i, ∃ j, z j ∈ A i) → n ≤ k

plain_statement.zh: 若 n 个两两不交的内部区域都含有给定 k 个点中的一个，则 n≤k。
plain_statement.en: If each of n pairwise disjoint interiors contains one of k given points, then n≤k.

brief.zh: 为每块选一个命中点，证明所选编号互异。应用时还须证明穿刺点覆盖所有位置和角度。
brief.en: Choose a point for each interior and prove the index map injective. A geometric application also needs an all-orientations covering proof.

gaps.statement: let inside := fun (x y a b X Y : ℝ) => |a*(X-x)+b*(Y-y)| < 1/2 ∧ |(-b)*(X-x)+a*(Y-y)| < 1/2; let fits := fun (n : ℕ) (s : ℝ) => 0 ≤ s ∧ ∃ x y a b : Fin n → ℝ, (∀ i, a i ^ 2 + b i ^ 2 = 1 ∧ |a i| + |b i| ≤ 2*x i ∧ |a i| + |b i| ≤ 2*(s-x i) ∧ |a i| + |b i| ≤ 2*y i ∧ |a i| + |b i| ≤ 2*(s-y i)) ∧ (∀ i j, i ≠ j → ∀ X Y : ℝ, inside (x i) (y i) (a i) (b i) X Y → ¬ inside (x j) (y j) (a j) (b j) X Y); ∀ (n : ℕ) (s : ℝ), fits n s → (n : ℝ) ≤ s^2

plain_statement.zh: 在真实的自由旋转、内部不交装填中，n 个单位正方形必须满足 n≤s²。
plain_statement.en: Any packing of n freely rotated unit squares with disjoint interiors satisfies n≤s².

brief.zh: 证明旋转保持单位方块的面积，对内部求和，再用容器面积控制总和。
brief.en: Prove rotation preserves area, sum over disjoint interiors and bound the union by the container.

gaps.statement: let inside := fun (x y a b X Y : ℝ) => |a*(X-x)+b*(Y-y)| < 1/2 ∧ |(-b)*(X-x)+a*(Y-y)| < 1/2; let fits := fun (n : ℕ) (s : ℝ) => 0 ≤ s ∧ ∃ x y a b : Fin n → ℝ, (∀ i, a i ^ 2 + b i ^ 2 = 1 ∧ |a i| + |b i| ≤ 2*x i ∧ |a i| + |b i| ≤ 2*(s-x i) ∧ |a i| + |b i| ≤ 2*y i ∧ |a i| + |b i| ≤ 2*(s-y i)) ∧ (∀ i j, i ≠ j → ∀ X Y : ℝ, inside (x i) (y i) (a i) (b i) X Y → ¬ inside (x j) (y j) (a j) (b j) X Y); fits 5 (2 + Real.sqrt 2 / 2)

plain_statement.zh: 给出五个单位正方形装入边长 2+√2/2 的容器的精确坐标和旋转。
plain_statement.en: Give exact coordinates and rotations for five squares in a container of side 2+√2/2.

brief.zh: 四个角各放一块，中间一块转 45°。逐对给出分离方向，并核对外边界。
brief.en: Place four squares in the corners and a 45° square at the center. Certify separation and containment.

gaps.statement: let inside := fun (x y a b X Y : ℝ) => |a*(X-x)+b*(Y-y)| < 1/2 ∧ |(-b)*(X-x)+a*(Y-y)| < 1/2; let fits := fun (n : ℕ) (s : ℝ) => 0 ≤ s ∧ ∃ x y a b : Fin n → ℝ, (∀ i, a i ^ 2 + b i ^ 2 = 1 ∧ |a i| + |b i| ≤ 2*x i ∧ |a i| + |b i| ≤ 2*(s-x i) ∧ |a i| + |b i| ≤ 2*y i ∧ |a i| + |b i| ≤ 2*(s-y i)) ∧ (∀ i j, i ≠ j → ∀ X Y : ℝ, inside (x i) (y i) (a i) (b i) X Y → ¬ inside (x j) (y j) (a j) (b j) X Y); ∀ s : ℝ, fits 5 s → 2 + Real.sqrt 2 / 2 ≤ s

plain_statement.zh: 证明任意角度装填五个单位正方形时，容器边长至少为 2+√2/2。
plain_statement.en: Prove that every unrestricted packing of five unit squares needs side at least 2+√2/2.

brief.zh: 复现 Friedman 给出的几何下界，覆盖全部中心位置和方向，与五块构造合起来得到精确值。
brief.en: Formalize the all-orientations lower bound in Friedman and pair it with the five-square witness.

gaps.statement: let inside := fun (x y a b X Y : ℝ) => |a*(X-x)+b*(Y-y)| < 1/2 ∧ |(-b)*(X-x)+a*(Y-y)| < 1/2; let fits := fun (n : ℕ) (s : ℝ) => 0 ≤ s ∧ ∃ x y a b : Fin n → ℝ, (∀ i, a i ^ 2 + b i ^ 2 = 1 ∧ |a i| + |b i| ≤ 2*x i ∧ |a i| + |b i| ≤ 2*(s-x i) ∧ |a i| + |b i| ≤ 2*y i ∧ |a i| + |b i| ≤ 2*(s-y i)) ∧ (∀ i j, i ≠ j → ∀ X Y : ℝ, inside (x i) (y i) (a i) (b i) X Y → ¬ inside (x j) (y j) (a j) (b j) X Y); ∀ s : ℝ, fits 11 s → 2 + 2*Real.sqrt (4/5) ≤ s

plain_statement.zh: 复现 Stromquist 的十一块下界，允许每块自由旋转。
plain_statement.en: Recover Stromquist’s lower bound 2+2√(4/5) for eleven squares with unrestricted rotations.

brief.en: Formalize the geometric covering cases in the paper and feed them into the same piercing count.

gaps.statement: let inside := fun (x y a b X Y : ℝ) => |a*(X-x)+b*(Y-y)| < 1/2 ∧ |(-b)*(X-x)+a*(Y-y)| < 1/2; let fits := fun (n : ℕ) (s : ℝ) => 0 ≤ s ∧ ∃ x y a b : Fin n → ℝ, (∀ i, a i ^ 2 + b i ^ 2 = 1 ∧ |a i| + |b i| ≤ 2*x i ∧ |a i| + |b i| ≤ 2*(s-x i) ∧ |a i| + |b i| ≤ 2*y i ∧ |a i| + |b i| ≤ 2*(s-y i)) ∧ (∀ i j, i ≠ j → ∀ X Y : ℝ, inside (x i) (y i) (a i) (b i) X Y → ¬ inside (x j) (y j) (a j) (b j) X Y); fits 11 (97/25)

plain_statement.zh: 给出边长 97/25 的十一块精确装填证书，允许各块取不同方向。

brief.zh: 从已发表构型取坐标和方向，保留边长余量，用精确算术证明逐对分离。97/25 是复现门槛。

gaps.statement: ∀ A B u v:ℝ, abs u < 1/2 → abs v < 1/2 → 0 < abs A + abs B → abs (A*u+B*v) < (abs A + abs B)/2

plain_statement.zh: 内点投影受支撑半径约束

brief.zh: 对两个局部坐标逐项估计；至少一个系数非零。

gaps.statement: ∀ a b r s x:ℝ,r+s≤b-a → |x-a|<r → ¬ |x-b|<s

gaps.statement: let rad := fun (a b c s : ℝ) => (|a*c+b*s|+|b*c-a*s|)/2; ∀ a b c s k l x y u v i j m n : ℝ, |i|<1/2 → |j|<1/2 → |m|<1/2 → |n|<1/2 → 0<rad a b c s → 0<rad a b k l → rad a b c s+rad a b k l≤a*(u-x)+b*(v-y) → (x+c*i-s*j,y+s*i+c*j)≠(u+k*m-l*n,v+l*m+k*n)

plain_statement.zh: 任意正分母下旋转坐标的精确取值界
plain_statement.en: Sharp one-axis extrema with a common denominator

brief.zh: 取一对相反的角点证明必要性；线性形式的绝对值界证明充分性。 对应父题：L-square-packing-cert-17-9。
brief.en: Use opposite corners for necessity, and bound the linear form for sufficiency. Parent: L-square-packing-cert-17-9.

plain_statement.zh: 由两条坐标轴合成全部有理朝向证书
plain_statement.en: Two-axis certificate for every nonnegative rational rotation

brief.zh: 交换坐标与符号复用单轴引理；代入各题的整数系数即可。 对应父题：L-square-packing-cert-17-9。
brief.en: Reuse the single-axis result after a coordinate sign change and specialize the three coefficients. Parent: L-square-packing-cert-17-9.

plain_statement.zh: 否定对任意见证点的 0 至 45 度缩减。
plain_statement.en: Refute the 0–45 degree reduction for arbitrary weighted sites.

brief.zh: 取中心 (2,2)、旋转参数 (12/13, −5/13) 的正方形。用其第一局部坐标选取有理格点并赋权。逐个核对所有 0 至 45 度的可行放置均命中一个权重点，而给定正方形的总权重为零。
brief.en: Use a square centered at (2,2) with rotation parameters (12/13, −5/13). Choose weighted rational grid sites using its first local coordinate. Verify that each feasible placement with angle from 0 to 45 degrees hits a weighted site and the given square has total charge zero.

plain_statement.zh: 把单块的权重核验缩减到 0 至 45 度。
plain_statement.en: Reduce single-square charge verification to orientations between 0 and 45 degrees.

brief.zh: 改变正方形局部坐标的符号或顺序，保持每个见证点的内部归属。
brief.en: Use sign changes and swaps of the local coordinates to preserve each site's interior membership.

plain_statement.zh: 给定中心和方向的误差预算，把基准姿态的严格击中推广到整个姿态单元。
plain_statement.en: Transfer a strict hit from a reference pose to a cell with bounded center and orientation errors.

brief.zh: 拆开方向变化与中心变化，在两个局部坐标分别用三角不等式。误差余量可用于数值生成的覆盖证书。
brief.en: Separate orientation and position errors and bound both local coordinates by the triangle inequality.

gaps.statement: let inside := fun (x y a b X Y : ℝ) => |a*(X-x)+b*(Y-y)| < 1/2 ∧ |(-b)*(X-x)+a*(Y-y)| < 1/2; let fits := fun (n : ℕ) (s : ℝ) => 0 ≤ s ∧ ∃ x y a b : Fin n → ℝ, (∀ i, a i ^ 2 + b i ^ 2 = 1 ∧ |a i| + |b i| ≤ 2*x i ∧ |a i| + |b i| ≤ 2*(s-x i) ∧ |a i| + |b i| ≤ 2*y i ∧ |a i| + |b i| ≤ 2*(s-y i)) ∧ (∀ i j, i ≠ j → ∀ X Y : ℝ, inside (x i) (y i) (a i) (b i) X Y → ¬ inside (x j) (y j) (a j) (b j) X Y); ¬ fits 17 (4661/1000)

plain_statement.zh: 证明边长 4.661 的正方形无法容纳 17 个可自由旋转的单位正方形。
plain_statement.en: Rule out an unrestricted seventeen-square packing at side 4.661.

brief.zh: 用击中点证书与权重预算，或给出独立的全角度排除。对更小边长可沿用同一装填到 4.661 的外框。
brief.en: Use the weighted certificate and budget, or give an independent all-angle exclusion. A smaller packing would also fit at side 4.661.

gaps.statement: let inside := fun (x y a b X Y : ℝ) => |a*(X-x)+b*(Y-y)| < 1/2 ∧ |(-b)*(X-x)+a*(Y-y)| < 1/2; let fits := fun (n : ℕ) (s : ℝ) => 0 ≤ s ∧ ∃ x y a b : Fin n → ℝ, (∀ i, a i ^ 2 + b i ^ 2 = 1 ∧ |a i| + |b i| ≤ 2*x i ∧ |a i| + |b i| ≤ 2*(s-x i) ∧ |a i| + |b i| ≤ 2*y i ∧ |a i| + |b i| ≤ 2*(s-y i)) ∧ (∀ i j, i ≠ j → ∀ X Y : ℝ, inside (x i) (y i) (a i) (b i) X Y → ¬ inside (x j) (y j) (a j) (b j) X Y); fits 17 (9351/2000)

plain_statement.zh: 在边长 4.6755 的正方形中放入 17 个可独立旋转的单位正方形，允许边界接触，内部互不重叠。
plain_statement.en: Pack 17 independently rotatable unit squares in a square of side 4.6755, allowing boundary contact and forbidding overlap of interiors.

brief.zh: 公开基准为 Bidwell 的约 4.6755300936。尝试改变接触关系或旋转分组，再搜索中心坐标与角度。用有理半角参数及分离轴证明候选布局的边界与不相交约束。也请核对同一模型下公开的最优性主张。
brief.en: The documented Bidwell layout has side about 4.6755300936. Explore different contact patterns or orientation groups, then search over centers and angles. Verify the candidate with rational half-angle parameters and separating axes. Review published optimality claims under the same packing model.

gaps.statement: ∀ (n k q : ℕ) (S : Fin n → Finset (Fin k)) (w : Fin k → ℕ), (∀ i j, i ≠ j → Disjoint (S i) (S j)) → (∀ i, q ≤ ∑ j ∈ S i, w j) → n*q ≤ ∑ j, w j

plain_statement.zh: 证明互不相交的击中点集合满足总权重预算。
plain_statement.en: Prove the total weight budget for disjoint sets of hit sites.

brief.zh: 用双重求和或不交并，把每块需要的权重相加。
brief.en: Sum the required per-square weights using a disjoint union.

gaps.statement: (let inside := fun (x y a b X Y : ℝ) => |a*(X-x)+b*(Y-y)| < 1/2 ∧ |(-b)*(X-x)+a*(Y-y)| < 1/2; ∃ (k : ℕ) (X Y : Fin k → ℚ) (w : Fin k → ℕ) (q : ℕ), 0 < q ∧ (∑ j, w j) < 17*q ∧ ∀ x y a b : ℝ, (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 = 1 ∧ |a| + |b| ≤ 2*x ∧ |a| + |b| ≤ 2*((4661/1000:ℝ)-x) ∧ |a| + |b| ≤ 2*y ∧ |a| + |b| ≤ 2*((4661/1000:ℝ)-y)) → q ≤ (∑ j : Fin k, (if inside x y a b (X j) (Y j) then w j else 0))) → (let inside := fun (x y a b X Y : ℝ) => |a*(X-x)+b*(Y-y)| < 1/2 ∧ |(-b)*(X-x)+a*(Y-y)| < 1/2; let fits := fun (n : ℕ) (s : ℝ) => 0 ≤ s ∧ ∃ x y a b : Fin n → ℝ, (∀ i, a i ^ 2 + b i ^ 2 = 1 ∧ |a i| + |b i| ≤ 2*x i ∧ |a i| + |b i| ≤ 2*(s-x i) ∧ |a i| + |b i| ≤ 2*y i ∧ |a i| + |b i| ≤ 2*(s-y i)) ∧ (∀ i j, i ≠ j → ∀ X Y : ℝ, inside (x i) (y i) (a i) (b i) X Y → ¬ inside (x j) (y j) (a j) (b j) X Y); ¬ fits 17 (4661/1000))

plain_statement.zh: 把加权击中点证书组合成 17 块装不下的结论。
plain_statement.en: Turn a weighted piercing certificate into impossibility for seventeen squares.

brief.zh: 用每块严格内部互不相交，保证每个见证点的权重至多计入一次。
brief.en: Disjoint interiors ensure each site's weight is charged at most once.

plain_statement.zh: 证伪边长 4.661 的单点加权击中证书
plain_statement.en: Refute weighted point piercing at side 4.661

brief.zh: 用 70 个对称轨道生成 560 个带权合法方块，逐盒核对任一点的总荷载上界。若方块总权重严格超过该上界的 17 倍，对点与方块的双重求和即推出矛盾。
brief.en: Use 70 symmetry orbits of admissible weighted squares. Check the point depth on each box and double-count incidence when the total square weight exceeds 17 times the depth bound.

plain_statement.zh: 为边长 4.661 构造加权击中点证书。
plain_statement.en: Construct a weighted piercing certificate at side 4.661.

brief.zh: 先复现 R071 的覆盖思路，再搜索新权重和点位。容量不够时记录失败模型。单层加权点只是充分条件，可能需要更强的混合证书。
brief.en: Start with the R071 covering approach and search for new sites and weights. Record obstructions if point weights alone are insufficient.

zh: 定义可复核的装填
任何构型都要说明每块放在哪、转了多少、怎样保证内部不重叠。投影提供上界证书，面积和穿刺点提供下界工具。
en: Certify a packing
Give centers and rotations. Projection certifies feasible layouts, while area and piercing points support lower bounds.

tasks.zh: 旋转正方形的投影半宽
tasks.en: Projection radius

tasks.zh: 用投影核验两个方块分离
tasks.en: Certify separation

tasks.zh: 从几何装填推出面积界
tasks.en: Derive the area bound

tasks.zh: 用穿刺点给出下界
tasks.en: Count piercing points

zh: 在五块上合拢上下界
两组可独立工作，一组给精确坐标，另一组排除更小边长。两份核验指向同一个已知最优值。
en: Close the five-square case
Two independent tasks meet at the known optimum. Supply exact coordinates and exclude every smaller container.

tasks.zh: 五块的精确构造
tasks.en: Construct the five-square layout

tasks.zh: 五块的最优性下界
tasks.en: Prove five-square optimality

zh: 缩小十一块的区间
先核验论文给出的通用下界与一个边长 3.88 的可行上界。上界靠构型，下界必须覆盖所有自由旋转的摆法。
en: Narrow the eleven-square interval
Recover the published unrestricted lower bound and certify a feasible upper bound of 3.88. A sharper lower bound must cover every orientation.

tasks.zh: 十一块的通用下界
tasks.en: The eleven-square lower bound

tasks.zh: 十一块的上界证书
tasks.en: An eleven-square upper certificate

zh: 分离轴与边界余量
从中心到一致分离轴的投影界出发，量化旋转和证书误差。
en: Separation axes and boundary slack
Use center projections and budget orientation and certificate errors.

tasks.zh: 单位方块投影宽度的平方上界
tasks.en: Squared upper bound for the projected width

tasks.zh: 任意朝向的投影宽度至少为一
tasks.en: Orientation-independent width floor

tasks.zh: 端点扰动后保留分离
tasks.en: Separation survives bounded projection errors

tasks.zh: 中心和半径给出精确边界余量
tasks.en: Exact containment test for a centered interval

zh: 用有理参数和分离轴认证旋转构型
把候选构型变成精确坐标与投影不等式，供五块和十一块装填上界使用。
en: Certify rotated layouts with rational parameters and separating axes
Convert candidate layouts into exact coordinates and projection inequalities for the five- and eleven-square upper certificates.

tasks.zh: 有理斜率参数产生精确单位朝向
tasks.en: Exact rational parameterization of a unit orientation

tasks.zh: 从朝向恢复半角参数
tasks.en: Recover a half-angle parameter from the orientation

question.zh: 有无穷多个自然数 n 使 n² + 1 为素数吗？
question.en: Are there infinitely many natural numbers n for which n² + 1 is prime?

summary.zh: 从外部大素因子指数 1.323 出发，用局部根计数和有限 Fourier 分解研究 1.32301 的中段节省。另一条路线从二次 Mangoldt 正质量通往无穷多素数值。
summary.en: Starting from the external large-factor exponent 1.323, use local roots and finite Fourier analysis to seek a saving for 1.32301. A second route targets infinitely many prime values through quadratic Mangoldt mass.

gaps.statement: ∀ n : ℕ, Odd n → 2 ∣ n ^ 2 + 1

plain_statement.zh: 如果 n 是奇数，则 n² + 1 能被 2 整除。
plain_statement.en: If n is odd, then n² + 1 is divisible by two.

plain_statement.zh: 若 p 同时整除 n 和 n² + 1，则 p = 1。
plain_statement.en: A common divisor of n and n² + 1 must equal one.

gaps.statement: ∀ (n p : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → p ∣ n ^ 2 + 1 → p = 2 ∨ p % 4 = 1

plain_statement.zh: n² + 1 的素因子要么为 2，要么模 4 余 1。
plain_statement.en: Every prime divisor of n² + 1 is either 2 or congruent to 1 modulo 4.

brief.zh: 对奇素数，研究 n 在模 p 的乘法群中的阶，再把局部约束接到筛法输入。
brief.en: For odd p, study the multiplicative order of n modulo p to obtain a local sieve constraint.

gaps.statement: ∀ (p : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → ∀ (a b : ZMod p), a ^ 2 + 1 = 0 → b ^ 2 + 1 = 0 → a = b ∨ a = -b

plain_statement.zh: 模素数 p 时，若 a、b 都是 x² + 1 的根，则它们相同或互为相反数。
plain_statement.en: Modulo a prime p, two roots of x² + 1 are equal or negatives of each other.

brief.zh: 将两式相减，用平方差分解及有限域的无零因子性质。
brief.en: Subtract the equations, factor the difference of squares, and use the absence of zero divisors.

plain_statement.zh: 参数 a、b 模 m 同余时，a² + 1 和 b² + 1 也模 m 同余。
plain_statement.en: If a and b represent the same residue modulo m, then a² + 1 and b² + 1 do as well.

brief.zh: 用同余关系的乘法和加法相容性，把整除检查转为剩余类检查。
brief.en: Use compatibility of congruence with multiplication and addition to reduce divisibility to residue classes.

plain_statement.en: Show that x > 2^13230 and 0 ≤ n ≤ 2x imply n^1.323 < x^1.3231.

brief.zh: 把上游的实数幂比较写成本站可核验的独立引理；区间内存在大素因子仍须另证。
brief.en: Port the real-power comparison to the project checker. Existence of a large prime factor in the interval is a separate task.

plain_statement.zh: 固定原证书的核心上界，把区间指数提到 1.3241 时，算出预算低于 1 所需的额外节省量。
plain_statement.en: With the certified core envelope fixed, find the extra saving needed to keep the budget below one at block exponent 1.3241.

brief.zh: 用有理数证明阈值恰为 44655088261 / 9000000000000。能否从新的 Buchstab 分解获得足够节省，另需分析证明。
brief.en: Prove the exact threshold 44655088261 / 9000000000000 by rational arithmetic. Obtaining that saving from a new Buchstab decomposition requires a separate analytic argument.

gaps.statement: (∀ X : ℕ, ∃ x n p : ℕ, X < x ∧ x ≤ n ∧ n ≤ 2 * x ∧ Nat.Prime p ∧ p ∣ n ^ 2 + 1 ∧ x ^ 13231 < p ^ 10000) → ∀ B : ℕ, ∃ n p : ℕ, B < n ∧ Nat.Prime p ∧ p ∣ n ^ 2 + 1 ∧ n ^ 1323 < p ^ 1000

plain_statement.zh: 假设存在无界多个区间 [x, 2x]，其中有 n 使 n² + 1 有素因子 p > x^1.3231。推出对任意界 B，均有 n > B 满足 p > n^1.323。
plain_statement.en: Assuming arbitrarily large blocks [x, 2x] contain n with a prime divisor p of n² + 1 above x^1.3231, deduce the pointwise 1.323 result.

brief.zh: 先取 x 大于给定的 B 和尺度转换阈值，再用 n ≤ 2x。证明对象是蕴含式，区间估计须独立建立。
brief.en: Choose x above both B and the scale-conversion threshold, then use n ≤ 2x. The block estimate is a hypothesis of this implication.

gaps.statement: ∀ X : ℕ, ∃ x n p : ℕ, X < x ∧ x ≤ n ∧ n ≤ 2 * x ∧ Nat.Prime p ∧ p ∣ n ^ 2 + 1 ∧ x ^ 13231 < p ^ 10000

plain_statement.zh: 在任意给定界 X 以上找出区间 [x, 2x] 及其中的 n，使 n² + 1 有素因子 p > x^1.3231。
plain_statement.en: Above every bound X, find a block [x, 2x] and an n in it such that n² + 1 has a prime divisor p > x^1.3231.

brief.zh: 审查 Type I/II 估计的适用范围、Buchstab 切换及连续积分误差，从严格余量推出素因子的存在。这里比较的是区间左端点 x。
brief.en: Check the Type I/II ranges, the Buchstab switching terms and the integral error. Use a strict saving to obtain a prime-divisor witness at block scale x.

gaps.statement: (∀ B : ℕ, ∃ n p : ℕ, B < n ∧ Nat.Prime p ∧ p ∣ n ^ 2 + 1 ∧ n ^ 2 < p ^ 1) ↔ (∀ B : ℕ, ∃ n : ℕ, B < n ∧ Nat.Prime (n ^ 2 + 1))

plain_statement.zh: 证明指数 2 的严格大素因子命题等价于存在无穷多个 n 使 n² + 1 为素数。
plain_statement.en: Prove that the strict exponent-two prime-factor statement is equivalent to infinitely many prime values of n² + 1.

brief.zh: 利用整除给出的 p ≤ n² + 1；一旦 n² < p，就有 p = n² + 1。反向直接用 n² + 1 作见证。
brief.en: Divisibility gives p ≤ n² + 1. The strict bound n² < p forces equality. Conversely choose p = n² + 1.

gaps.statement: ∀ B : ℕ, ∃ n p : ℕ, B < n ∧ Nat.Prime p ∧ p ∣ n ^ 2 + 1 ∧ n ^ 1323 < p ^ 1000

plain_statement.zh: 对任意界 B，存在 n > B，使 n² + 1 有素因子 p > n^1.323。
plain_statement.en: For every bound B there is an n > B such that n² + 1 has a prime divisor p > n^1.323.

brief.zh: 整合区间筛法、证书与尺度转换，补齐无限性推导，提交无附加假设的定理。
brief.en: Combine the analytic block estimate, certificate and scale conversion into a theorem without hypotheses.

plain_statement.zh: 对无穷多个 n，找到整除 n² + 1 且大于 n^1.32301 的素数。
plain_statement.en: For infinitely many n, find a prime divisor of n² + 1 exceeding n^1.32301.

brief.zh: 尝试比论文基线提高 0.00001。先追踪区间尺度换算的余量，再核验产生无穷多见证的解析步骤。
brief.en: Seek a gain of 0.00001 over the manuscript baseline. Track the slack in the block-to-integer conversion and justify the analytic step producing unbounded witnesses.

gaps.statement: ∀ B : ℕ, ∃ n p : ℕ, B < n ∧ Nat.Prime p ∧ p ∣ n ^ 2 + 1 ∧ n ^ 331 < p ^ 250

plain_statement.zh: 对任意界 B，存在 n > B，使 n² + 1 有素因子 p > n^1.324。
plain_statement.en: For every bound B there is an n > B such that n² + 1 has a prime divisor p > n^1.324.

brief.zh: 改进筛法节省或解析上界，再证明无穷多个见证。1.324 是新目标。
brief.en: Improve the sieve saving or analytic envelope, then prove unbounded witnesses at the proposed target 1.324.

gaps.statement: ∀ B : ℕ, ∃ n p : ℕ, B < n ∧ Nat.Prime p ∧ p ∣ n ^ 2 + 1 ∧ n ^ 2 < p ^ 1

plain_statement.zh: 对任意界 B，存在 n > B，使 n² + 1 有素因子 p > n^2。
plain_statement.en: For every bound B there is an n > B such that n² + 1 has a prime divisor p > n^2.

brief.zh: 需在同一固定指数 2 下证明严格不等式；仅证明任意小于 2 的指数不能代替这个端点。
brief.en: Establish the strict inequality at the fixed exponent 2. Results at smaller exponents alone leave this endpoint open.

gaps.statement: let roots := fun (q : ℕ) => ((Finset.range q).filter (fun r => q ∣ r^2+1)).card; ∀ p k : ℕ, Nat.Prime p → p ≠ 2 → 0 < k → roots (p^k) ≤ 2

plain_statement.zh: 对每个奇素数 p 及 k≥1，模 pᵏ 的方程 r²+1≡0 至多有两个根。
plain_statement.en: For every odd prime p and positive k there are at most two roots of r²+1 modulo pᵏ.

brief.zh: 先模 p 分类。用 2r 可逆证明每个根到下一层至多有一个提升。
brief.en: Classify the roots mod p, then use the invertibility of 2r to prove uniqueness of lifting.

gaps.statement: let roots := fun (q : ℕ) => ((Finset.range q).filter (fun r => q ∣ r^2+1)).card; ∀ x q : ℕ, 0 < q → ((Finset.Ioc x (2*x)).filter (fun n => q ∣ n^2+1)).card ≤ (x/q+1)*roots q

plain_statement.zh: 对 q>0，在 x<n≤2x 中，满足 q 整除 n²+1 的个数至多为 (⌊x/q⌋+1) 乘以模 q 的根数。
plain_statement.en: Bound the number of n in (x,2x] with q dividing n²+1 by (⌊x/q⌋+1) times the number of roots mod q.

brief.zh: 按余数分组，每个完整周期贡献一次，剩下的不满周期贡献至多一次。
brief.en: Partition by remainder, count full periods and bound the incomplete period.

gaps.statement: let w := fun (n p : ℕ) => (((n^2+1).factorization p : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log (p:ℝ); ∀ x : ℕ, Finset.sum (Finset.Ioc x (2*x)) (fun n => Finset.sum (n^2+1).primeFactors (w n)) = Finset.sum (Finset.Ioc x (2*x)) (fun n => Real.log ((n:ℝ)^2+1))

plain_statement.zh: 在 (x,2x] 上按素因子及其重数求和，恰好还原所有 log(n²+1) 之和。
plain_statement.en: The sum of prime logarithms weighted by their multiplicities equals the sum of log(n²+1) on (x,2x].

brief.zh: 先对单个正整数使用唯一分解和对数乘法，再在区间上求和。
brief.en: Apply unique factorization and the logarithm of a product term by term, then sum.

gaps.statement: ∀ x : ℕ, 2 ≤ x → 2*(x:ℝ)*Real.log (x:ℝ) < Finset.sum (Finset.Ioc x (2*x)) (fun n => Real.log ((n:ℝ)^2+1))

plain_statement.zh: 对 x≥2，区间 (x,2x] 内的 log(n²+1) 之和严格大于 2x log x。
plain_statement.en: For x≥2 the sum of log(n²+1) over (x,2x] exceeds 2x log x.

brief.zh: 区间恰有 x 项，逐项用 n>x 和对数单调性比较。
brief.en: Count the x terms and apply strict monotonicity of the logarithm to each.

gaps.statement: let w := fun (n p : ℕ) => (((n^2+1).factorization p : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log (p:ℝ); let small := fun (x : ℕ) => Finset.sum (Finset.Ioc x (2*x)) (fun n => Finset.sum ((n^2+1).primeFactors.filter (fun p => p ≤ x)) (w n)); ∀ e : ℝ, 0 < e → ∃ X : ℕ, ∀ x : ℕ, X ≤ x → small x ≤ (1+e)*(x:ℝ)*Real.log (x:ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 对每个 ε>0，充分大 x 的区间里，p≤x 的素因子按重数计入的对数总量至多为 (1+ε)x log x。
plain_statement.en: For every ε>0 the weighted contribution of primes up to x is eventually at most (1+ε)x log x.

brief.zh: 结合模素数幂的根数和素数在模四剩余类中的分布；须控制高次幂与区间端点的误差。
brief.en: Combine root counts at prime powers with the distribution of primes modulo four. Control high powers and endpoint errors.

gaps.statement: let w := fun (n p : ℕ) => (((n^2+1).factorization p : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log (p:ℝ); let middle := fun (x : ℕ) => Finset.sum (Finset.Ioc x (2*x)) (fun n => Finset.sum ((n^2+1).primeFactors.filter (fun p => x < p ∧ p^100000 ≤ n^132301)) (w n)); ∃ d : ℝ, 0 < d ∧ ∀ B : ℕ, ∃ x : ℕ, B < x ∧ middle x ≤ (1-d)*(x:ℝ)*Real.log (x:ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 寻求固定 δ>0，使无界多个区间中，x
plain_statement.en: Find a fixed δ>0 and unbounded dyadic scales where middle primes with x

brief.zh: 这是 1.32301 路线的解析瓶颈。逐段写出筛估计与误差，最终余量必须对无界多个尺度有效。
brief.en: This is the analytic bottleneck for 1.32301. Track each sieve range and its error and retain a uniform margin on unbounded scales.

gaps.statement: let w := fun (n p : ℕ) => (((n^2+1).factorization p : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log (p:ℝ); let small := fun (x : ℕ) => Finset.sum (Finset.Ioc x (2*x)) (fun n => Finset.sum ((n^2+1).primeFactors.filter (fun p => p ≤ x)) (w n)); let middle := fun (x : ℕ) => Finset.sum (Finset.Ioc x (2*x)) (fun n => Finset.sum ((n^2+1).primeFactors.filter (fun p => x < p ∧ p^100000 ≤ n^132301)) (w n)); (∀ e : ℝ, 0 < e → ∃ X : ℕ, ∀ x : ℕ, X ≤ x → small x ≤ (1+e)*(x:ℝ)*Real.log (x:ℝ)) → (∃ d : ℝ, 0 < d ∧ ∀ B : ℕ, ∃ x : ℕ, B < x ∧ middle x ≤ (1-d)*(x:ℝ)*Real.log (x:ℝ)) → ∀ B : ℕ, ∃ n p : ℕ, B < n ∧ Nat.Prime p ∧ p ∣ n^2+1 ∧ n^132301 < p^100000

plain_statement.zh: 若小素因子估计与中段固定余量都成立，则无穷多个 n 存在素因子 p 整除 n²+1 且 p¹⁰⁰⁰⁰⁰>n¹³²³⁰¹。
plain_statement.en: Assuming both prime-range estimates, infinitely often n²+1 has a prime factor p with p¹⁰⁰⁰⁰⁰>n¹³²³⁰¹.

brief.zh: 令 ε 小于 δ，比较两段之和与完整对数总量，再抽出剩余素因子。此条件引理独立领取。
brief.en: Choose ε below δ, compare the two contributions with the total, and extract a remaining prime divisor. This transfer is conditional.

plain_statement.en: Common divisors of neighboring quadratic values divide five

brief.en: Track the local factors and mass transfer required for a dyadic largest-prime-factor certificate.

plain_statement.zh: 存在常数 4：对每个 x ≥ 1，中段质量（n 取遍 (x,2x]、p 取遍 n²+1 的素因子且满足 x<p、p^100000≤n^132301，按 v_p(n²+1)·log p 加权求和）不超过 4 倍的 apTheta(x)=Σ log p（p 取遍 ≤(2x)^132301 且 p≡1 (mod 4) 的素数）。
plain_statement.en: For every x ≥ 1, the middle mass — the sum of v_p(n^2+1)·log p over n in (x,2x] and prime divisors p of n^2+1 with x < p and p^100000 ≤ n^132301 — is at most 4 times apTheta(x), the sum of log p over primes p ≤ (2x)^132301 with p ≡ 1 (mod 4).

brief.zh: 把中段质量按素数纤维重排：每个中段素数的根数≤2、重数≤2，故单素数贡献≤4 log p，从而 middle x ≤ 4·apTheta x。这是「粗计数路线无法在 x log x 预算内闭合」的障碍钉死（常数 2 不成立，见反例）。
brief.en: Regroup the middle mass by prime fibres: each middle prime has at most two roots and multiplicity at most two, hence contributes at most 4 log p, so middle x ≤ 4·apTheta x. This pins down the obstruction that crude counting cannot close within an x log x budget (constant 2 is false; see the counterexample).

brief.en: In the original window n≥3, an odd n gives the factor 2. Check both endpoints for n=2k and k∈(⌊x/2⌋,x]. Use this dictionary to pass from the final sieve to the frozen window in n.

gaps.statement:
let f := fun k : ℕ => 4*k^2+1; let block := fun x : ℕ => Finset.Ioc (x/2) x; let primes := fun z : ℕ => (Finset.Icc 3 z).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p); let wheel := fun z : ℕ => ∏ p ∈ primes z, p; let rough := fun x z : ℕ => (block x).filter (fun k => Nat.Coprime (f k) (wheel z)); ∀ x z : ℕ, 2≤x → z≤2*x → (2*x)^2+1≤z^3 →
  (∑ k ∈ (block x).filter (fun k => (f k).Prime), Real.log (f k : ℝ)) =
    ∑ k ∈ rough x z, (1 - (ArithmeticFunction.moebius (f k) : ℝ))/2 * Real.log (f k : ℝ)

plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH and natural extensions · QP-0084 · Use the Möbius sign to count the actual prime values in the terminal range

brief.zh: 终带存活值至多两个素因子，平方情形由 QP-0064 排除。素数值在此窗均大于 2x。半素数的 μ 为 +1，素数的 μ 为 −1。
brief.en: A terminal survivor has at most two prime factors. QP-0064 excludes the square, and every prime value in this window exceeds 2x. A semiprime contributes μ=+1 and a prime μ=−1.

gaps.statement:
let f := fun k : ℕ => 4*k^2+1; let block := fun x : ℕ => Finset.Ioc (x/2) x; let primes := fun z : ℕ => (Finset.Icc 3 z).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p); let wheel := fun z : ℕ => ∏ p ∈ primes z, p; let rough := fun x z : ℕ => (block x).filter (fun k => Nat.Coprime (f k) (wheel z)); ∀ x lo hi : ℕ, 0<x → lo≤hi →
  (rough x lo).card =
    (rough x hi).card + ((block x).filter (fun k => lo < (f k).minFac ∧ (f k).minFac ≤ hi)).card

brief.zh: 对 k>0，4k²+1 是大于一的奇数。逐点使用最小素因子所在的唯一带，包含右边界。此分割可在同一 x 上迭代。
brief.en: For k>0 the value 4k²+1 is odd and greater than one. Assign each point to the unique band of its least factor and include the right endpoint. Iterate the partition at the same x.

gaps.statement:
∀ a b c₀ d₀ c d : ℤ, a*d₀+b*c₀=1 →

  (∀ t : ℤ, a*(c₀+a*t)-b*(d₀-b*t) = (a*c₀-b*d₀)+(a^2+b^2)*t) ∧

brief.en: The initial solution a d₀+b c₀=1 gives coprimality. Check that the integer parameter advances n by p=a²+b² and that the quadratic cofactor has discriminant −4.

gaps.statement:
let f := fun k : ℕ => 4*k^2+1; let block := fun x : ℕ => Finset.Ioc (x/2) x; let primes := fun z : ℕ => (Finset.Icc 3 z).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p); let split := fun z : ℕ => (Finset.Icc 5 z).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p ∧ p%4=1); let wheel := fun z : ℕ => ∏ p ∈ primes z, p; let rough := fun x z : ℕ => (block x).filter (fun k => Nat.Coprime (f k) (wheel z)); let localProd := fun z : ℕ => ∏ p ∈ split z, (1 - 2/(p : ℝ)); (∃ c : ℝ, 0<c ∧ Filter.Tendsto (fun z : ℕ => Real.log (z : ℝ) * localProd z) Filter.atTop (nhds c)) →
∃ U : ℕ, 4≤U ∧ ∃ c : ℝ, 0<c ∧ ∃ X : ℕ, 2≤X ∧ ∀ x : ℕ, X≤x →
  let z := (Finset.range (x+1)).sup (fun t => if t^U≤x then t else 0);
  c*(x : ℝ)/Real.log x ≤ ((rough x z).card : ℝ)

brief.en: Take divisor level x^(3/4) and choose a fixed U so that s=3U/4 exceeds the lower linear sieve cutoff. Check the floor ⌊x^(1/U)⌋ and absorb the total error from QP-0074.

gaps.statement:
let split := fun z : ℕ => (Finset.Icc 5 z).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p ∧ p%4=1); let localProd := fun z : ℕ => ∏ p ∈ split z, (1 - 2/(p : ℝ)); (∀ (Q : ℕ) [NeZero Q] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ Q) (s : ℂ), 0<s.re → s.re<1 → DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ s=0 → s.re=1/2)→
∃ c : ℝ, 0<c ∧ Filter.Tendsto (fun z : ℕ => Real.log (z : ℝ) * localProd z) Filter.atTop (nhds c)

brief.zh: 用 log(1−2/p)+2/p 的绝对可和性。修正积可复用 QP-0075。奇数 p≡3 mod 4 的局部因子等于一，4k²+1 在 2 处无根。
brief.en: Use the absolute summability of log(1−2/p)+2/p. QP-0075 gives the correction product. The inert primes have factor one, and 4k²+1 has no root at 2.

gaps.statement:
let f := fun k : ℕ => 4*k^2+1; let block := fun x : ℕ => Finset.Ioc (x/2) x; let primes := fun z : ℕ => (Finset.Icc 3 z).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p); let wheel := fun z : ℕ => ∏ p ∈ primes z, p; let rough := fun x z : ℕ => (block x).filter (fun k => Nat.Coprime (f k) (wheel z)); let hitCount := fun x d : ℕ => ((block x).filter (fun k => d ∣ f k)).card;
∀ x z : ℕ, ((rough x z).card : ℤ) = ∑ d ∈ (wheel z).divisors, ArithmeticFunction.moebius d * (hitCount x d : ℤ)

brief.en: First restrict the divisors at each point to gcd(4k²+1, W(z)). Then exchange the divisor and window sums. Include the empty wheel and empty residue classes.

brief.en: Write the quotient of the positive solutions as A+B√m with A=muv−ab and B=bu−av. Norm one and quotient greater than one give A≥2 and B≥1. Extract the rational coordinate. The earlier task covers m=2.

∃ C : ℝ, 0<C ∧ ∀ x y : ℕ, 2≤x → 2≤y →

brief.en: For p≤x^(2/3), count roots modulo p² and keep the interval error. Above that cutoff switch to m=(n²+1)/p². There are O(x^(2/3)) cofactors and QP-0082 allows at most one hit per cofactor.

plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH and natural extensions · QP-0080 · Preserve the discriminant and sieve conditions after switching out a first factor

brief.zh: 在实际根 r 上写 k=pt+r。除掉 p 后判别式恒为 −16；与 p 互素的旧筛条件保持等价。此式用在最小因子 p 的内层和。
brief.en: Write k=pt+r at an actual root r. Removing p leaves discriminant −16 and preserves sieve conditions coprime to p. This supplies the inner sum with least factor p.

gaps.statement:
let f := fun k : ℕ => 4*k^2+1; ∀ (d : ℕ) [NeZero d] (p r : ℕ) (u k : ZMod d), Nat.Coprime d p → (p : ZMod d)*u=1 → p ∣ f r →
  let coeff := fun t : ZMod d => 4*(p : ZMod d)*t^2 + 8*(r : ZMod d)*t + (f r / p : ℕ);
  (∑ t : ZMod d, if coeff t = 0 then ZMod.stdAddChar (k*t) else 0) =
    ZMod.stdAddChar (-k*u*(r : ZMod d)) *
       (∑ v : ZMod d, if 4*v^2+1 = 0 then ZMod.stdAddChar (k*u*v) else 0)

plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH and natural extensions · QP-0081 · Transport the complete Fourier coefficients for the switched cofactor sieve

brief.en: Set v=pt+r and retain the inverse u and the translation phase modulo d. First use the unit p to recover 4v²+1=0 from the cofactor zero. QP-0074 supplies the separate interval errors.

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然扩张 · QP-0085 · 把末段大素因子切换为高斯整数的一次方程
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH and natural extensions · QP-0085 · Switch a terminal prime factor to a linear equation over the Gaussian integers

brief.en: Use the two orientations of p=a²+b² to choose a factor of n+i. Expand (n+i)(a−bi)/p and keep the cofactor via the multiplicative norm.

gaps.statement: ∃ C : ℝ, 0<C ∧ ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ x p r : ℕ, N≤x → p.Prime → Nat.nthRoot 5 (x^2) < p → p ≤ 5 * Nat.nthRoot 3 (x^2) → r < p → (4*r^2+1)%p=0 → (((Finset.range (x+1)).filter fun t => let k:=p*t+r; x<2*k ∧ k≤x ∧ (4*k^2+1).minFac=p).card : ℝ) ≤ C*x/(p*Real.log x)

plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH methods and extensions · Upper-sieve the switched cofactor

brief.en: Select a positive summand. The prime divisor of that value has cofactor one.

plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH and natural extensions · QP-0069 · Seek a linear lower bound for quadratic Mangoldt mass on unbounded windows

brief.en: After division by p^k, solve the linear congruence in t using the unit 2r.

gaps.statement: let roots := fun a q : ℕ => (Finset.range q).filter (fun r => q ∣ r^2+a); ∀ S : Finset ℕ, (∀ p ∈ S, Nat.Prime p) → let Q := ∏ p ∈ S, p; (((Finset.range Q).filter (fun n => Nat.Coprime (n^2+1) Q)).card : ℝ) / Q = ∏ p ∈ S, (1-((roots 1 p).card : ℝ)/p)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然扩张 · QP-0016 · 计算有限素数集合的筛存活密度
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH and natural extensions · QP-0016 · Compute the survival density of a finite prime sieve

brief.zh: 逐素数删去实际根数，在 2 处保留因子 1/2。
brief.en: Remove the actual root classes prime by prime, including the factor 1/2 at two.

gaps.statement: let block := fun x : ℕ => Finset.Ioc x (2*x); let roots := fun a q : ℕ => (Finset.range q).filter (fun r => q ∣ r^2+a); let window := fun x p : ℕ => (block x).filter (fun n => p^100000 ≤ n^132301); let countHits := fun a x p : ℕ => ((window x p).filter (fun n => p ∣ n^2+a)).card; ∀ x q : ℕ, 0<q → |(countHits 1 x q : ℝ) - ((window x q).card : ℝ)*((roots 1 q).card : ℝ)/q| ≤ ((roots 1 q).card : ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然扩张 · QP-0017 · 将端点移动的整除误差控制在一个根系内
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH and natural extensions · QP-0017 · Bound the endpoint error in the moving divisibility window

brief.zh: 幂阈值给出连续整数后缀。每个根余类的取整误差至多为一。
brief.en: The power cutoff selects a consecutive suffix. Each root class contributes at most one unit of rounding error.

gaps.statement: let roots := fun a q : ℕ => (Finset.range q).filter (fun r => q ∣ r^2+a); ∀ p : ℕ, Nat.Prime p → (roots 1 p).card = if p=2 then 1 else if p%4=1 then 2 else 0
