plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH and natural extensions · QP-0011 · Count roots at ramified, split and inert primes

brief.zh: 用有限域乘法群的四阶元处理存在性，再以已证的 ± 配对控制全部根。
brief.en: Use an element of order four for existence and the accepted sign-pair lemma for exhaustion.

gaps.statement: let roots := fun a q : ℕ => (Finset.range q).filter (fun r => q ∣ r^2+a); ∀ q : ℕ, 0<q → Squarefree q → (roots 1 q).card = ∏ p ∈ q.primeFactors, (if p=2 then 1 else if p%4=1 then 2 else 0)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然扩张 · QP-0014 · 把互素分解推广到任意无平方因子模数
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH and natural extensions · QP-0014 · Count the roots of every squarefree modulus

brief.zh: 迭代 CRT 双射，q=1 时检查空积。
brief.en: Iterate the CRT equivalence and include the empty product at q=1.

gaps.statement: let block := fun x : ℕ => Finset.Ioc x (2*x); let roots := fun a q : ℕ => (Finset.range q).filter (fun r => q ∣ r^2+a); let primes := fun x : ℕ => (Finset.Ioc x ((2*x)^2+1)).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p ∧ p^100000 ≤ (2*x)^132301); let window := fun x p : ℕ => (block x).filter (fun n => p^100000 ≤ n^132301); let countHits := fun a x p : ℕ => ((window x p).filter (fun n => p ∣ n^2+a)).card; let inc := fun a x : ℕ => ∑ p ∈ primes x, (countHits a x p : ℝ) * Real.log (p : ℝ); let model := fun a x : ℕ => ∑ p ∈ primes x, ((window x p).card : ℝ) * ((roots a p).card : ℝ) / p * Real.log (p : ℝ); let angle := fun p k : ℕ => fun t : ℝ => 2 * Real.pi * k * t / p; let coef := fun a x p k : ℕ => (∑ r ∈ roots a p, ∑ n ∈ window x p, Real.cos (angle p k ((n : ℝ) - r))) / p; let freqs := fun (p : ℕ) (low : Bool) => (Finset.Ico 1 p).filter (fun k => if low then min k (p-k) ≤ Nat.sqrt p else Nat.sqrt p < min k (p-k)); let part := fun (a x p : ℕ) (low : Bool) => (∑ k ∈ freqs p low, coef a x p k) * Real.log (p : ℝ); let modes := fun (a x : ℕ) (low : Bool) => ∑ p ∈ primes x, part a x p low; ∀ x : ℕ, inc 1 x = model 1 x + modes 1 x true + modes 1 x false

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然扩张 · QP-0019 · 用零频、低频和高频精确恢复首次整除质量
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH and natural extensions · QP-0019 · Recover first-incidence mass from the three frequency ranges

brief.zh: 对移动窗中每个 n 及每个根用完全正交，分出 k=0，再按 min(k,p−k) 截开。
brief.en: Apply orthogonality for each window element and root. Extract k=0 and split the rest at min(k,p−k)=⌊√p⌋.

gaps.statement: let block := fun x : ℕ => Finset.Ioc x (2*x); let roots := fun a q : ℕ => (Finset.range q).filter (fun r => q ∣ r^2+a); let psi := fun (q a x : ℕ) => ∑ n ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 x).filter (fun n => n%q=a%q), ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n; ∀ q x : ℕ, 0<q → (∑ n ∈ (block x).filter (fun n => q ∣ n^2+1), ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n) = ∑ r ∈ (roots 1 q).filter (fun r => Nat.Coprime r q), (psi q r (2*x) - psi q r x)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然扩张 · QP-0015 · 把窗口中的 Mangoldt 质量重排为可逆根余类和
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH and natural extensions · QP-0015 · Reindex dyadic Mangoldt mass over the reduced root classes

brief.zh: 用已证的互素引理排除非单位根，再对每个余类扣除左端点的 ψ。
brief.en: Use the accepted coprimality lemma to eliminate nonunits and subtract the left endpoint in each progression.

gaps.statement: let roots := fun a q : ℕ => (Finset.range q).filter (fun r => q ∣ r^2+a); ∀ (q : ℕ) [NeZero q], ∃ e : {r : ℕ // r ∈ roots 1 q} ≃ {u : ZMod q // u^2+1=0}, ∀ r, (e r).1.val = r.1

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然扩张 · QP-0010 · 在标准代表与模环根集之间保留根标签
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH and natural extensions · QP-0010 · Transport labelled roots between representatives and ZMod

brief.zh: 用标准代表的 val 和自然数嵌入构造互逆映射，给傅里叶系数保留根的位置。
brief.en: Build inverse maps with val and the natural cast to retain the location of each root.

gaps.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (f g : ZMod N → ℂ), (∑ k : ZMod N, ZMod.dft f k * star (ZMod.dft g k)) = (N : ℂ) * ∑ n : ZMod N, f n * star (g n)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然扩张 · QP-0043 · 确定未归一化 DFT 的交叉 Parseval 因子
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH and natural extensions · QP-0043 · Normalize cross Parseval for the unnormalized DFT

brief.zh: 展开两个变换并在频率变量上做完全正交。
brief.en: Expand both transforms and apply full orthogonality in the frequency variable.

gaps.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (f : ZMod N → ℂ) (h k : ZMod N), ZMod.dft (fun n => f (n+h)) k = ZMod.stdAddChar (h*k) * ZMod.dft f k

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然扩张 · QP-0042 · 给任意平移量计算有限 Fourier 相位
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH and natural extensions · QP-0042 · Compute the finite Fourier phase of any translation

brief.zh: 使用固定 Mathlib 的负指数 DFT 约定并作平移换元。
brief.en: Translate the summation variable in Mathlib’s negative-exponent DFT.

gaps.statement: ∀ (S : Finset ℕ) (u v : ℕ → ℂ), (∑ k ∈ S, ‖u k+v k‖^2) - (∑ k ∈ S, ‖u k-v k‖^2) = 4*∑ k ∈ S, (u k * star (v k)).re

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然扩张 · QP-0041 · 在一个频段上极化两个不同的复测试
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH and natural extensions · QP-0041 · Polarize two distinct complex tests on a frequency band

brief.zh: 逐项展开平方范数，保留两个测试之间的实交叉项。
brief.en: Expand the squared norms at each frequency and retain the real cross term.

gaps.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (a b : ZMod N) (f : ZMod N → ℂ), let T := fun (g : ZMod N → ℂ) n => g (n+a); let M := fun (g : ZMod N → ℂ) n => ZMod.stdAddChar (b*n)*g n; ∀ n, T (M f) n = ZMod.stdAddChar (a*b)*M (T f) n

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然扩张 · QP-0048 · 确定有限 Heisenberg 平移与调制的交换相位
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH and natural extensions · QP-0048 · Compute the finite Heisenberg translation–modulation phase

brief.zh: 在相同加性特征下计算算子乘积的中心因子。
brief.en: Evaluate both operator products with the same additive character.

gaps.statement: ∀ (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (t h n : ZMod p), ZMod.stdAddChar (t*(n+h)^2) = ZMod.stdAddChar (t*h^2) * ZMod.stdAddChar (2*t*h*n) * ZMod.stdAddChar (t*n^2)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然扩张 · QP-0045 · 求二次相位平移后的线性调制
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH and natural extensions · QP-0045 · Compute the linear modulation of a translated quadratic phase

brief.zh: 展开平方，用加性特征的乘法公式。
brief.en: Expand the square and apply the character law to its three terms.

gaps.statement: ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (a b : ZMod p), p≠2 → a≠0 → ‖∑ n : ZMod p, ZMod.stdAddChar (a*n^2+b*n)‖^2 = (p : ℝ)

plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH and natural extensions · QP-0047 · Evaluate the quadratic Gauss norm at an odd prime

brief.zh: 展开双和，在差变量上运用线性特征正交。
brief.en: Expand the squared norm and use linear-character orthogonality in the difference variable.

gaps.statement: ∀ (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (a n : ZMod p), (∑ t : ZMod p, ZMod.stdAddChar (t*(n^2+a))) = if n^2+a=0 then (p : ℂ) else 0

plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH and natural extensions · QP-0044 · Extract the local quadratic graph by additive characters

brief.zh: 用完全特征和把同余方程嵌入有限 Θ 测试。

gaps.statement: ∀ A P Q M N E e f h : ℝ, 0<A → |(P-Q)/A-4*E|≤h → |P/A-M|≤e → |Q/A-N|≤f → |4*E-(M-N)|≤e+f+h

plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH and natural extensions · QP-0050 · Combine two norm errors and the matching error under one normalization

brief.zh: 将两个 Rallis 值和有限极化的匹配误差分别记账，再用三角不等式。
brief.en: Charge both norm evaluations and the finite matching separately, then use the triangle inequality.

gaps.statement: ∀ (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (a : ZMod p), let f := fun n : ZMod p => if n^2+a=0 then (1 : ℂ) else 0; (∑ k : ZMod p, ‖ZMod.dft f k‖^2) = (p : ℝ) * (((Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod p)).filter (fun n => n^2+a=0)).card : ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然扩张 · QP-0049 · 精确计算完整根掩码的 Fourier 总能量
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH and natural extensions · QP-0049 · Evaluate the total Fourier energy of a root mask

brief.zh: 对根指示函数调用交叉 Parseval 并计算其支撑大小。
brief.en: Use cross Parseval with the root indicator in both slots and count its support.

gaps.statement: ∀ (p q : ℕ) [NeZero p] [NeZero q] (u : ZMod p → ℂ) (v : ZMod q → ℂ) (k : ZMod p) (j : ZMod q), (∑ z : ZMod p × ZMod q, (ZMod.stdAddChar (-(z.1*k))*u z.1) * (ZMod.stdAddChar (-(z.2*j))*v z.2)) = ZMod.dft u k * ZMod.dft v j

plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH and natural extensions · QP-0046 · Factor a pure-tensor pairing at two finite places

brief.zh: 先作有限 Fubini，再将两个位置的和分别识别为 DFT。

gaps.statement: let block := fun x : ℕ => Finset.Ioc x (2*x); let roots := fun a q : ℕ => (Finset.range q).filter (fun r => q ∣ r^2+a); let primes := fun x : ℕ => (Finset.Ioc x ((2*x)^2+1)).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p ∧ p^100000 ≤ (2*x)^132301); let window := fun x p : ℕ => (block x).filter (fun n => p^100000 ≤ n^132301); let angle := fun p k : ℕ => fun t : ℝ => 2 * Real.pi * k * t / p; let phase := fun (p k n : ℕ) => Complex.exp (((angle p k n : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I); let coef := fun a x p k : ℕ => (∑ r ∈ roots a p, ∑ n ∈ window x p, Real.cos (angle p k ((n : ℝ) - r))) / p; let freqs := fun (p : ℕ) (low : Bool) => (Finset.Ico 1 p).filter (fun k => if low then min k (p-k) ≤ Nat.sqrt p else Nat.sqrt p < min k (p-k)); let part := fun (a x p : ℕ) (low : Bool) => (∑ k ∈ freqs p low, coef a x p k) * Real.log (p : ℝ); let modes := fun (a x : ℕ) (low : Bool) => ∑ p ∈ primes x, part a x p low; ∀ x : ℕ, let u := fun p k : ℕ => ∑ n ∈ window x p, phase p k n; let v := fun p k : ℕ => ∑ r ∈ roots 1 p, phase p k r; modes 1 x false = ∑ p ∈ primes x, (∑ k ∈ freqs p false, (‖u p k+v p k‖^2-‖u p k-v p k‖^2)) / (4*(p : ℝ)) * Real.log (p : ℝ)

gaps.statement: let block := fun x : ℕ => Finset.Ioc x (2*x); let budget := fun x : ℕ => (x : ℝ) * Real.log (x : ℝ); let roots := fun a q : ℕ => (Finset.range q).filter (fun r => q ∣ r^2+a); let primes := fun x : ℕ => (Finset.Ioc x ((2*x)^2+1)).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p ∧ p^100000 ≤ (2*x)^132301); let window := fun x p : ℕ => (block x).filter (fun n => p^100000 ≤ n^132301); let angle := fun p k : ℕ => fun t : ℝ => 2 * Real.pi * k * t / p; let coef := fun a x p k : ℕ => (∑ r ∈ roots a p, ∑ n ∈ window x p, Real.cos (angle p k ((n : ℝ) - r))) / p; let freqs := fun (p : ℕ) (low : Bool) => (Finset.Ico 1 p).filter (fun k => if low then min k (p-k) ≤ Nat.sqrt p else Nat.sqrt p < min k (p-k)); let part := fun (a x p : ℕ) (low : Bool) => (∑ k ∈ freqs p low, coef a x p k) * Real.log (p : ℝ); let modes := fun (a x : ℕ) (low : Bool) => ∑ p ∈ primes x, part a x p low; ∀ B : ℕ, ∃ x : ℕ, B<x ∧ modes 1 x false ≤ (19/50 : ℝ)*budget x

固定素数，将同根和反根分开计数；把每个区间内少量解的结论交给中段筛估计。
en: Control repeated middle-prime contributions through root spacing
For each prime, separate equal and opposite roots and pass the resulting interval count to the middle-prime sieve bound.

tasks.zh: 两个二次值的公因子约束
tasks.en: Common divisors of shifted quadratic values

tasks.zh: 消去基点后的整系数公因子界
tasks.en: Eliminate the base point from the shared-divisor bound

tasks.zh: 中段大素数在小于平方的值中只出现一次
tasks.en: A large divisor below the square cutoff has multiplicity one

tasks.zh: 短窗口内同余点不能重复
tasks.en: Inject residues on a short half-open interval

tasks.zh: 每个中段奇素数在短窗口至多命中两次
tasks.en: At most two hits per odd middle prime in a short window

tasks.zh: 存在常数 4：对每个 x ≥ 1，中段质量（n 取遍 (x,2x]、p 取遍 n²+1 的素因子且满足 x<p、p^100000≤n^132301，按 v_p(n²+1)·log p 加权求和）不超过 4 倍的 apTheta(x)=Σ log p（p 取遍 ≤(2x)^132301 且 p≡1 (mod 4) 的素数）。
tasks.en: For every x ≥ 1, the middle mass — the sum of v_p(n^2+1)·log p over n in (x,2x] and prime divisors p of n^2+1 with x < p and p^100000 ≤ n^132301 — is at most 4 times apTheta(x), the sum of log p over primes p ≤ (2x)^132301 with p ≡ 1 (mod 4).

zh: 为中段筛固定局部根证书
在有限域分解二次多项式并证明根表完备；变量 n 遍历所有自然数。
en: Certify local roots for the middle-prime sieve
Factor the quadratic over the prime field and prove completeness of both residue classes.

zh: 中段筛：在指数 1.15 处分开质量
先分离两个互斥素因子带。下带预算要求最终一致，上带允许在无界多个相同尺度上成立。两项预算是研究目标。
en: Split middle-prime mass at exponent 1.15
Split disjoint prime bands. Seek a uniform lower-band budget and a recurrent upper-band budget on compatible scales.

tasks.zh: 中段质量精确分割，包含边界等号
tasks.en: Exact disjoint mass partition including the boundary

tasks.zh: 在所有充分大尺度压低下带到 0.46
tasks.en: Uniform 0.46 budget for the lower band

tasks.zh: 在无界多个尺度压低上带到 0.53
tasks.en: Recurrent 0.53 budget for the upper band

tasks.zh: 一般预算之和小于一时推出原题节省
tasks.en: Transfer compatible budgets with sum below one

tasks.zh: 中段重复素因子的商只能是 2 或 3
tasks.en: A repeated middle prime leaves quotient two or three

tasks.zh: 排除商为 3 的负 Pell 分支
tasks.en: Exclude the quotient-three branch

tasks.zh: 负 Pell 解的下一项至少翻倍
tasks.en: Distinct positive negative-Pell solutions are separated

tasks.zh: 二进区间内最多一个值含有重复中段素因子
tasks.en: At most one argument with a repeated middle prime per dyadic block

tasks.zh: 将中段因子质量精确拆成首次与重复贡献
tasks.en: Split the high-band mass into first and excess valuations

tasks.zh: 单个异常参数的重复因子对数损失
tasks.en: Bound the excess valuation cost of one exceptional argument

tasks.zh: 整个二进区间重复中段因子的对数级总损失
tasks.en: Logarithmic aggregate excess from repeated middle primes

en: High-frequency extension and the 1.32301 bridge

Extract eventual smallness from #2643 and explore moving windows for n²+a and α≤1.325. For the current exponent, prove the two low-mode bounds and combine zero, low, high and excess masses on the same scales.
zh: 高频估计推广与 1.32301 合成
把 #2643 提升为最终一致的小量，并试把移动窗口推广到 n²+a 和 α≤1.325。当前指数路线先补低频的内外两段，再把零频、低频、高频和重复赋值预算在同一尺度合成。

tasks.zh: 当 1≤a≤x 时，固定短窗口 [l,u] 中，n²+a 的大于 x 的不同素因子与整数 n 组成的对数至多是窗口长度的两倍。
tasks.en: For 1≤a≤x, the number of pairs of an integer in the fixed interval and a distinct prime factor >x of n²+a is at most twice the interval length.

tasks.zh: 现有窗口的真实高频和最终小于任意正比例的 x log x。
tasks.en: For the original windows the actual high-mode sum eventually lies below ε x log x for every ε>0.

tasks.zh: 对于每个固定正整数 a 和 1.32301≤U/V≤1.325，证明 n²+a 的相应高频和最终小于任意正比例的 x log x。
tasks.en: For a fixed positive offset and 1.32301≤U/V≤1.325, prove eventual ε-smallness of the corresponding n²+a high modes.

tasks.zh: 由六条冻结命题推出 1.32301 路线的中段节省，固定取 δ=1/100。
tasks.en: Derive the frozen middle-band saving from six exact inputs, using δ=1/100.

en: A natural extension of Levent’s GRH methods for sieving quadratic prime values

Sieve 4k²+1 on the even-parameter part of the sequence. Summed small-divisor errors and the local factors from the mod-four prime sums supply the initial sieve. The final range uses the actual least prime factor, the primality of the cofactor and the Möbius sign. Bounding the losses to first hits remains necessary before claiming prime values.
zh: Levent GRH 的自然推广：近平方素数值的筛法

question.zh: 固定总样本数和两两碰撞数，三个整数桶的容量上限怎样决定三重碰撞的最大值？
question.en: For three integer buckets, how does capacity affect the maximum triple collisions at fixed sample size and pair count?

summary.zh: 第二期研究有限样本的整数极值：逐步放宽单桶容量，找出三重碰撞数最大值的临界位置。第一期的 12 条证明保留。
summary.en: Phase II studies integer extrema and their capacity thresholds. The twelve Phase I lemmas remain in the desk.

background.zh: 连续概率向量的矩已有锐界，六角格点也有角分布理论。本期引入样本整数性和双边容量约束；基础引理与候选原创目标分别列在研究计划中。
background.en: Sharp continuous moment bounds and angular results on hexagonal lattices are baselines. This phase adds integer occupancies and two boundaries. The protocol distinguishes prerequisites from candidate original results.

plain_statement.zh: 三个桶以 m 为中心时，偏差和为零，二阶下降阶乘之和等于 3m(m−1)+2S，其中 S=x²+xy+y²。
plain_statement.en: For zero-sum deviations the pair polynomial is 3m(m−1)+2S.

brief.zh: 消去第三个偏差并展开。
brief.en: Eliminate the third deviation and expand.

plain_statement.zh: 三阶下降阶乘之和等于 3m(m−1)(m−2)+6(m−1)S+3xyz。
plain_statement.en: The triple polynomial is 3m(m−1)(m−2)+6(m−1)S+3xyz.

brief.zh: 利用零和条件，分离范数和乘积。
brief.en: Use the zero sum to separate norm and product.

gaps.statement: ∀ a b c x y z : ℤ, a≤b → b≤c → x≤y → y≤z → a+b+c=0 → x+y+z=0 → a^2+a*b+b^2=x^2+x*y+y^2 → c<z → a*b*c<x*y*z

plain_statement.zh: 固定范数，两个从小到大排序的零和偏差三元组中，最大坐标较大的一组有严格较大的乘积。
plain_statement.en: At fixed norm a larger maximum among sorted zero-sum triples gives a strictly larger product.

brief.zh: 把乘积写成 z³−Sz，并由排序证明 3c²≥S。
brief.en: Factor the cubic difference and derive 3c² ≥ S.

plain_statement.zh: 最大偏差 z 可行，当且仅当容量上界成立且存在满足平方方程、奇偶性及线性不等式的整数 d。
plain_statement.en: A maximum deviation z is feasible exactly when the cap and the stated square, parity and linear conditions hold.

brief.zh: 取 d=y−x；反向利用奇偶性恢复两个整数坐标。
brief.en: Set d=y−x and reconstruct both coordinates by parity.

plain_statement.zh: 在范数 7·4ᵏ 上，已排序零和三元组的最大坐标恰取两个值。
plain_statement.en: On norm 7·4ᵏ the attainable maxima are exactly 2·2ᵏ and 3·2ᵏ.

brief.zh: 证明偶范数使两个坐标均为偶数，再下降到范数 7。
brief.en: Descend by parity to the representations of seven.

gaps.statement: ∀ S : ℕ, 1<S → Squarefree S → (∀ p ∈ S.primeFactors, p%3=1) → ((Finset.Icc (0:ℤ) (2*(S:ℤ))).filter (fun z => 0 < ((Finset.Icc (-(2*(S:ℤ))) (2*(S:ℤ))).filter (fun x => x≤ -x-z ∧ -x-z≤z ∧ x^2+x*(-x-z)+(-x-z)^2=(S:ℤ))).card)).card = 2^S.primeFactors.card

plain_statement.zh: S>1 无平方因子且所有素因子模 3 余 1 时，偏差限制在 [−2S,2S] 的有序三元组恰有 2^ω(S) 种最大坐标。
plain_statement.en: For squarefree S>1 with all prime factors 1 mod 3 there are 2^ω(S) distinct sorted maxima in the stated range.

brief.zh: 统计六角格的范数表示，处理排列轨道与重复根。
brief.en: Count norm representations and quotient by permutations, accounting for repeated coordinates.

gaps.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (a b c x y : ZMod m), a ≠ 0 ∨ b ≠ 0 → (x + b, y - a) ≠ (x, y) ∧ a * (x + b) + b * (y - a) + c = a * x + b * y + c

plain_statement.zh: 在仿射教学模型中，只要两个系数至少有一个非零，对任意输入 (x,y)，一次模加和一次模减就能构造碰撞伙伴 (x+b,y−a)。
plain_statement.en: In the affine teaching model with at least one nonzero coefficient, one modular addition and one modular subtraction give a collision partner (x+b,y−a) for any (x,y).

brief.zh: 直接核验给定构造，把构造伙伴和复算摘要的成本分开。该构造通过两个坐标运算得到伙伴。
brief.en: Verify the specified construction. Count the two coordinate operations for generating a partner separately from digest verification.

gaps.statement: ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (a b c x y u v : ZMod p), a ≠ 0 → b ≠ 0 → a * x + b * y + c = a * u + b * v + c → (x, y) ≠ (u, v) → x ≠ u ∧ y ≠ v

plain_statement.zh: 在素数模数且两个系数均非零的仿射模型里，两份不同输入若摘要相同，就必须同时改变两个坐标。
plain_statement.en: In the affine model over a prime modulus with both coefficients nonzero, any collision between distinct inputs must change both coordinates.

brief.zh: 这是坐标改动数的下界。与直接构造对照，明确这个下界成立的系数和模数条件。
brief.en: This is a lower bound on coordinate changes. Compare it with the direct construction under the stated coefficient and modulus assumptions.

gaps.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (a b c x y : ZMod m), x ≠ y → (y, x) ≠ (x, y) ∧ a * (y + x) ^ 2 + b * (y + x) + c = a * (x + y) ^ 2 + b * (x + y) + c

plain_statement.zh: 对只依赖坐标和的二次教学哈希，若原来的两个坐标不同，交换坐标就构成碰撞，生成伙伴只需重排。
plain_statement.en: For the quadratic teaching hash of the coordinate sum, swapping unequal coordinates creates a collision by reordering alone.

brief.zh: 核验交换法的适用范围。证明对应构造，比较重排与模加减的成本。
brief.en: Verify the swap construction under its stated precondition and compare reordering with modular arithmetic.

plain_statement.zh: 在素数模数下，对只依赖坐标和的二次教学哈希，构造 (x+1,y−1) 可为任何输入得到不同的同摘要伙伴，包括两个坐标相等的输入。
plain_statement.en: Over a prime modulus, (x+1,y−1) is a distinct collision partner for every input of the quadratic teaching hash, including inputs with equal coordinates.

brief.zh: 用一次加和一次减补足交换法的适用范围。比较时分别列出保证覆盖的输入和生成伙伴的运算。
brief.en: Use one addition and one subtraction to extend coverage beyond the swap construction. Report guaranteed input coverage and construction operations separately.

gaps.statement: ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (a b c x y : ZMod p), let result := if x = y then ((x + 1, y - 1), (2 : ℕ)) else ((y, x), 0); result.1 ≠ (x, y) ∧ a * (result.1.1 + result.1.2) ^ 2 + b * (result.1.1 + result.1.2) + c = a * (x + y) ^ 2 + b * (x + y) + c ∧ result.2 ≤ 2 ∧ (result.2 = 0 ↔ x ≠ y)

plain_statement.zh: 二次教学模型中，先判断两个坐标是否相等，再选择交换或平衡平移。所有输入都能找到碰撞伙伴，构造最多两次模加减，坐标不等时为零次。
plain_statement.en: For the quadratic teaching model, choose swap or balanced shift after comparing the coordinates. The construction covers every input and uses at most two modular additions or subtractions, with zero when the coordinates differ.

brief.zh: 比较基线固定做两次模加减。这个成本模型只计构造中的模加减，另需一次坐标比较。按两种分支核验正确性和成本。
brief.en: The baseline always uses two modular additions or subtractions. This cost model counts those operations in the constructor, with one coordinate comparison accounted for separately. Prove each branch's correctness and cost.

gaps.statement: ∀ (n m : ℕ) (h : Fin n → Fin m), let size := fun y : Fin m => (Finset.univ.filter (fun x : Fin n => h x = y)).card; Finset.sum Finset.univ size = n

plain_statement.zh: 任意有限映射的所有输出桶的大小之和等于输入数 n，空桶也计入。
plain_statement.en: For any finite map the sizes of all output buckets, including empty ones, sum to n.

brief.zh: 将输入与由输出编号和原像元素组成的不交并建立双射。
brief.en: Identify the input set with the disjoint union of its fibers indexed by output.

gaps.statement: ∀ (n m : ℕ) (h : Fin n → Fin m), let size := fun y : Fin m => (Finset.univ.filter (fun x : Fin n => h x = y)).card; let pairs := ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)).filter (fun z => z.1 ≠ z.2 ∧ h z.1 = h z.2)).card; pairs = Finset.sum Finset.univ (fun y => size y * (size y - 1))

plain_statement.zh: 不同输入、相同输出的有序对数等于各桶 k(k−1) 之和。
plain_statement.en: The number of ordered pairs of distinct inputs sharing an output equals the sum of k(k−1) over buckets.

brief.zh: 先固定共同输出，再选第一个和第二个输入。明确方向，排除对角线。
brief.en: Fix the common output before selecting the two inputs. Keep both orders and exclude the diagonal.

gaps.statement: ∀ (q : ℕ) (h : Fin (q^2) → Fin q), 2 ≤ q → let size := fun y : Fin q => (Finset.univ.filter (fun x : Fin (q^2) => h x = y)).card; let pairs := ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (q^2) × Fin (q^2))).filter (fun z => z.1 ≠ z.2 ∧ h z.1 = h z.2)).card; q^2*(q-1) ≤ pairs

plain_statement.zh: 从 q² 个输入到 q 个输出的任意映射，至少有 q²(q−1) 个有序碰撞对。
plain_statement.en: Every map from q² inputs to q outputs has at least q²(q−1) ordered collision pairs for q≥2.

brief.zh: 固定总输入数，用平方和不等式或移项，将下界化为各桶与平均大小之差的平方和。
brief.en: With the total fixed, use a sum-of-squares argument around the mean bucket size.

gaps.statement: ∀ (q : ℕ) (h : Fin (q^2) → Fin q), 2 ≤ q → let size := fun y : Fin q => (Finset.univ.filter (fun x : Fin (q^2) => h x = y)).card; let pairs := ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (q^2) × Fin (q^2))).filter (fun z => z.1 ≠ z.2 ∧ h z.1 = h z.2)).card; (pairs = q^2*(q-1) ↔ ∀ y, size y = q)

plain_statement.zh: 有序碰撞对达到下界，当且仅当 q 个输出桶的大小全为 q。
plain_statement.en: The lower bound is attained exactly when every output has q preimages.

brief.zh: 研究平方和取等条件，把每个偏差必须为零写成双向定理。
brief.en: Identify when the sum of squared deviations vanishes and prove both implications.

gaps.statement: ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (a b c : ZMod p), (a ≠ 0 ∨ b ≠ 0) → ∀ v : ZMod p, (Finset.univ.filter (fun z : ZMod p × ZMod p => a*z.1+b*z.2+c = v)).card = p

plain_statement.zh: 在素域上的非恒定仿射教学模型中，每个输出恰有 p 个原像。
plain_statement.en: Every output of a nonconstant affine teaching map over the prime field has exactly p preimages.

brief.zh: 在一个非零系数上解线性方程，建立与另一个自由坐标之间的双射。
brief.en: Solve using a nonzero coefficient and identify the fiber with the remaining free coordinate.

gaps.statement: ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (a b c : ZMod p), 2 < p → a ≠ 0 → let h := fun z : ZMod p × ZMod p => a*(z.1+z.2)^2+b*(z.1+z.2)+c; let size := fun v : ZMod p => (Finset.univ.filter (fun z : ZMod p × ZMod p => h z = v)).card; (∃! v, size v = p) ∧ (∀ v, size v = 0 ∨ size v = p ∨ size v = 2*p)

plain_statement.zh: 对奇素数 p 和非零二次项，教学函数 a(x+y)²+b(x+y)+c 恰有一个大小为 p 的桶，其余桶大小为 0 或 2p。
plain_statement.en: For odd p and nonzero leading coefficient the quadratic sum model has a unique bucket of size p. Other buckets have size zero or 2p.

brief.zh: 先按 x+y 分组，再配方。把每个一元原像对应的 p 对输入一起计数。
brief.en: Group by x+y and complete the square. Each univariate preimage contributes exactly p pairs.

gaps.statement: ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (a b c : ZMod p), 2 < p → a ≠ 0 → let h := fun z : ZMod p × ZMod p => a*(z.1+z.2)^2+b*(z.1+z.2)+c; ((Finset.univ : Finset ((ZMod p × ZMod p) × (ZMod p × ZMod p))).filter (fun z => z.1 ≠ z.2 ∧ h z.1 = h z.2)).card = 2*p^2*(p-1)

plain_statement.zh: 奇素域上的上述二次教学模型恰有 2p²(p−1) 个有序碰撞对，是同规模理论最小值的两倍。
plain_statement.en: The quadratic teaching model over an odd prime field has exactly 2p²(p−1) ordered collision pairs, twice the theoretical minimum.

brief.zh: 由输入总数推出双根桶的个数，再代入有序对恒等式。可独立用二次多项式的纤维对称性验证。
brief.en: Derive the number of two-root buckets from the input total, then apply the ordered-pair identity or count via fiber symmetry.

gaps.statement: ∀ m:ℕ, Nat.choose (m+1) 3=Nat.choose m 3+Nat.choose m 2

plain_statement.zh: 加入一个元素产生的三元组数
plain_statement.en: Triples created by one insertion

brief.zh: 在抽象有限占用模型中计数；从组合恒等式推导多重占用阈值。
brief.en: Count finite occupancy profiles and derive capacity bounds from binomial identities.

gaps.statement: ∀ a b:ℕ, Nat.choose (a+b) 3=Nat.choose a 3+Nat.choose b 3+Nat.choose a 2*b+a*Nat.choose b 2

plain_statement.zh: 合并两桶时的跨桶三元组
plain_statement.en: Cross terms when merging two buckets

brief.zh: 在抽象有限占用模型中计数；从组合恒等式推导多重占用阈值。
brief.en: Count finite occupancy profiles and derive capacity bounds from binomial identities.

gaps.statement: ∀ a b:ℕ, b≤a → Nat.choose a 3+Nat.choose (b+1) 3≤Nat.choose (a+1) 3+Nat.choose b 3

plain_statement.zh: 将一项移向轻桶降低三元组数
plain_statement.en: Balancing move cannot increase triple count

brief.zh: 在抽象有限占用模型中计数；从组合恒等式推导多重占用阈值。
brief.en: Count finite occupancy profiles and derive capacity bounds from binomial identities.

gaps.statement: ∀ (n:ℕ) (b:Fin n→ℕ), ((Finset.univ:Finset (Fin n)).filter (fun i => 3≤b i)).card≤∑ i,Nat.choose (b i) 3

plain_statement.zh: 用三元组总数控制重桶数
plain_statement.en: Triple counts bound the number of heavy buckets

brief.zh: 在抽象有限占用模型中计数；从组合恒等式推导多重占用阈值。
brief.en: Count finite occupancy profiles and derive capacity bounds from binomial identities.

gaps.statement: ∀ a b:ℕ, Nat.choose (a+1) 3+Nat.choose b 3+Nat.choose b 2=Nat.choose a 3+Nat.choose (b+1) 3+Nat.choose a 2

plain_statement.zh: 移动一项的精确代价差
plain_statement.en: Exact triple-count drop for one move

brief.zh: 使用相邻二项系数递推两次。
brief.en: Apply adjacent binomial recurrences twice.

plain_statement.zh: 均衡移动严格降低平方势能
plain_statement.en: Balancing strictly lowers squared occupancy

brief.zh: 用平方势能处理三元组代价打平的移动。
brief.en: Use squared load to order moves even if triple cost is tied.

gaps.statement: ∀ (q k:ℕ) (b:Fin q→ℕ), (∀ i,b i=k ∨ b i=k+1) → (∑ i,b i)=q*k+((Finset.univ:Finset (Fin q)).filter (fun i => b i=k+1)).card

plain_statement.zh: 差至多一时的重桶个数
plain_statement.en: Count fuller buckets in a balanced profile

brief.zh: 分开 k 与 k+1 两种负载。
brief.en: Partition the load vector into its two levels.

zh: 第二期 · 从桶计数到整数证书
先把两两碰撞与三重碰撞写成整系数多项式，再确定哪些容量能使纪录严格上升。
en: Phase II · Counts and certificates
Reduce the counts to integer polynomials and characterize attainable thresholds.

tasks.zh: 二阶计数确定范数
tasks.en: Pair polynomial

tasks.zh: 三阶计数确定目标函数
tasks.en: Triple polynomial

tasks.zh: 最大桶严格排列三重计数
tasks.en: Ordering by largest bucket

tasks.zh: 上下容量约束的整数证书
tasks.en: Certificate for both boundaries

zh: 第二期 · 无限族与容量临界值
先验证一个倍增族，再处理含任意多个不同分裂素因子的范数。受限情形的论文目标见研究计划。
en: Phase II · Infinite families
Calibrate with dilations and then count thresholds on squarefree split shells. See the protocol for the bounded regime.

tasks.zh: 标定族的全部临界值
tasks.en: Thresholds on dilated shells

tasks.zh: 无平方因子范数的临界值数
tasks.en: Counting thresholds on split shells

zh: 统一输入对和输出桶的定义
同一个模型可以因是否计顺序而差一倍。先把不同输入、有序对、空桶都写进形式命题。
en: Fix the counting convention
Settle the conventions for distinct inputs, ordered pairs and empty buckets before comparing models.

tasks.zh: 按输出分桶计数
tasks.en: Partition the input set

tasks.zh: 统一碰撞对的计数口径
tasks.en: Count ordered collision pairs

zh: 求理论最小值与取等条件
在 q² 个输入、q 个输出的尺度上，独立证明碰撞对的下界及达到下界的充要条件。
en: Find the sharp universal minimum
For q² inputs and q outputs, prove the lower bound and characterize all maps that attain it.

tasks.zh: 所有同规模映射的共同下界
tasks.en: Minimum at fixed domain and range

tasks.zh: 何时恰好达到下界
tasks.en: Characterize equality

zh: 比较两个教学模型
计算仿射模型为什么达到下界，以及二次模型的碰撞对为什么恰好多一倍。贡献以精确计数的 Lean 证明核验。
en: Compare two teaching models
Compute why the affine model attains the minimum and why the quadratic model has twice as many pairs. Certify both counts in Lean.

tasks.zh: 仿射模型的精确桶大小
tasks.en: Exact affine fiber sizes

tasks.zh: 二次模型有哪些桶大小
tasks.en: Quadratic bucket spectrum

tasks.zh: 二次模型的碰撞对总数
tasks.en: Exact total for the quadratic model

zh: 有限桶的计数与容量
在抽象有限占用模型中计数；从组合恒等式推导多重占用阈值。
en: Finite-bucket counts and capacity
Count finite occupancy profiles and derive capacity bounds from binomial identities.

tasks.zh: 加入一个元素产生的三元组数
tasks.en: Triples created by one insertion

tasks.zh: 合并两桶时的跨桶三元组
tasks.en: Cross terms when merging two buckets

tasks.zh: 将一项移向轻桶降低三元组数
tasks.en: Balancing move cannot increase triple count

tasks.zh: 用三元组总数控制重桶数
tasks.en: Triple counts bound the number of heavy buckets

zh: 固定总占用下的三元组最小值
研究有限桶的离散极值：证明平衡化过程终止，求精确下界，并区分低占用时的平局。
en: Minimize triple counts at fixed occupancy
Prove termination of balancing, compute the sharp finite-bucket bound and account for ties at low occupancy.

tasks.zh: 移动一项的精确代价差
tasks.en: Exact triple-count drop for one move

tasks.zh: 均衡移动严格降低平方势能
tasks.en: Balancing strictly lowers squared occupancy

tasks.zh: 差至多一时的重桶个数
tasks.en: Count fuller buckets in a balanced profile

tasks.zh: 有限桶的精确三元组下界
tasks.en: Sharp triple-count floor for arbitrary loads

question.en: One person knows the row and another the column. How many bits must they exchange to determine the entry of a Boolean matrix?

summary.zh: r 是矩阵的实数秩，D(M) 是确定性通信复杂度。我们从原项目对 Johnson 乘积层和稀疏列的对数通信上界出发，补齐组合计数与通信协议的形式证明，并寻找新的稀疏列族。一般猜想仍然开放。
summary.en: Here r is the real rank and D(M) is deterministic communication complexity. Build on the project’s logarithmic bounds for Johnson products and sparse columns by formalizing counting and protocols and seeking new sparse families. The general conjecture remains open.

background.zh: 李进文的原论文研究列具有特殊结构的布尔矩阵。18 个 Lean 模块已覆盖部分代数与有限组合引理。本站从论文的纤维计数、协议证明和新列族构造接着做，每条任务单独核验。
background.en: JinWen Li’s manuscript studies Boolean matrices with structured columns. Its 18 Lean modules cover algebraic and finite-combinatorial lemmas. Here each contribution to the fiber counts, protocols and new column constructions is verified separately.

gaps.statement: ∀ (n k t : ℕ) (A : Finset (Fin n)), t ≤ k → let layer := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).powersetCard k; (layer.filter (fun B => (A ∩ B).card = t)).card = Nat.choose A.card t * Nat.choose (n-A.card) (k-t)

plain_statement.zh: 恰有 t≤k 个标记点的 k 元列，其数目等于从标记与未标记坐标中分别选择的方式数之积。
plain_statement.en: Count k-subsets with exactly t marked points for t≤k as a product of two binomial coefficients.

brief.zh: 把列拆成与 A 相交、与 A 的补集相交的两个集合，并给出逆映射。
brief.en: Split a column into its marked and unmarked parts and construct the inverse bijection.

gaps.statement: ∀ A : Finset (Fin 6), A.card = 3 → let L := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 6)).powersetCard 3; (L.filter (fun B => (A ∩ B).card ≠ 1 ∧ (A ∩ B).card ≠ 2)).card = 2 ∧ L.card = 20

plain_statement.zh: 六个坐标中标记三个。20 个三元列里，恰有两个的交集大小落在 {1,2} 之外。
plain_statement.en: Among the twenty triples on six coordinates, exactly two meet a marked triple outside the sizes one and two.

brief.zh: 两个例外是 A 和它的补集。用对称性给任意 A 的证明。
brief.en: Identify the two exceptional columns as A and its complement.

gaps.statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (A : Finset (Fin n)) (a : ℤ), 2 ≤ k → k+2 ≤ n → 2 ≤ A.card → A.card+2 ≤ n → let layer := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).powersetCard k; let esc := layer.filter (fun B => ((A ∩ B).card : ℤ) ≠ a ∧ ((A ∩ B).card : ℤ) ≠ a+1); 2*(min k (n-k))^2*layer.card ≤ 5*n^2*esc.card

plain_statement.zh: 在内部层和内部行上，对任意相邻整数 a、a+1，落在这两个值之外的列占比至少为 (2/5)(min(k,n−k)/n)²。
plain_statement.en: For interior layers and rows, at least (2/5)(min(k,n−k)/n)² of all columns escape any adjacent pair.

brief.zh: 计数任务给出分子。按论文证明衔接六坐标纤维与已形式化的多项式估计。
brief.en: Connect the fiber counts to the six-coordinate argument and the formalized polynomial inequalities.

gaps.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (A : Finset (Fin n)) (a : ℤ) (Y D : Finset (Finset (Fin n))), let adj := fun (A B : Finset (Fin n)) (a : ℤ) => ((A ∩ B).card : ℤ) = a ∨ ((A ∩ B).card : ℤ) = a+1; (Y.filter (fun B => ¬ adj A B a)).card > D.card → ∃ B ∈ Y \ D, ¬ adj A B a

plain_statement.zh: 若检测到某一行的列数严格多于被删列数，则删除后仍能找到见证列。
plain_statement.en: If a row has more detecting columns than the number deleted, at least one witness survives.

brief.zh: 对反设使用有限集包含关系。此引理可用于完整层或另行给定的稀疏样本。
brief.en: Under the contrary assumption all detecting columns lie in the deletion set.

gaps.statement: ∀ u v s t a : ℤ, u ≠ v → s ≠ t → ¬ ((u+s=a ∨ u+s=a+1) ∧ (u+t=a ∨ u+t=a+1) ∧ (v+s=a ∨ v+s=a+1) ∧ (v+t=a ∨ v+t=a+1))

plain_statement.zh: 两个块的整数贡献各自能改变时，四种组合的和不能都落在同一对相邻整数中。
plain_statement.en: When two integer block contributions can each vary, the four sums cannot all lie in one adjacent pair.

brief.zh: 比较四个角的最小值与最大值。它是从单层推广到乘积层的局部障碍。
brief.en: Compare the minimum and maximum of the four corners in a product.

gaps.statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (A : Finset (Fin n)) (a : ℤ), 2 ≤ k → k+2 ≤ n → let layer := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).powersetCard k; let adj := fun (A B : Finset (Fin n)) (a : ℤ) => ((A ∩ B).card : ℤ) = a ∨ ((A ∩ B).card : ℤ) = a+1; (∀ B ∈ layer, adj A B a) → A.card ≤ 1 ∨ n ≤ A.card+1

plain_statement.zh: 若 A 和完整内部层上每个 k 元列的交集大小都落在同一对相邻整数中，则 A 或其补集至多有一个元素。
plain_statement.en: If all k-columns of an interior slice meet A in one adjacent pair of sizes, A or its complement has at most one element.

brief.zh: 使用交集可能取值的整个整数区间；也可从逃逸界的严格正性推出。
brief.en: Use the full integer interval of possible intersections, or positivity of the escape count.

gaps.statement: ∀ (n k m : ℕ) (A : Fin m → Finset (Fin n)) (Y : Finset (Finset (Fin n))) (a : ℤ), 2 ≤ k → k+2 ≤ n → let layer := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).powersetCard k; let adj := fun (A B : Finset (Fin n)) (a : ℤ) => ((A ∩ B).card : ℤ) = a ∨ ((A ∩ B).card : ℤ) = a+1; let detects := fun (Y : Finset (Finset (Fin n))) => ∀ A : Finset (Fin n), 2 ≤ A.card → A.card + 2 ≤ n → ∀ a : ℤ, ∃ B ∈ Y, ¬ adj A B a; let lin := fun (w : Fin n → ℝ) (B : Finset (Fin n)) => Finset.sum B w; let uniqueOn := fun (Y : Finset (Finset (Fin n))) => ∀ (w : Fin n → ℝ) (c : ℝ), (∀ B ∈ Y, lin w B = c) → ∀ B ∈ layer, lin w B = c; Y.Nonempty → Y ⊆ layer → detects Y → uniqueOn Y → (∀ i, ∀ B ∈ Y, adj (A i) B a) → let M : Matrix (Fin m) (↥Y) ℝ := fun i j => (((A i ∩ j.val).card : ℝ) - (a : ℝ)); ∃ send : Fin m → Fin (M.rank+1), ∃ reply : Fin (M.rank+1) → ↥Y → Bool, ∃ out : Fin m → Bool → Bool, ∀ i j, (out i (reply (send i) j) = true ↔ M i j = 1)

plain_statement.zh: 在检测性和仿射唯一性成立的稀疏列族上，Alice 用至多 r+1 种消息发送索引，Bob 回一比特，Alice 正确还原结果；r 为受限矩阵实秩。
plain_statement.en: For detecting, affine-unisolvent columns, encode a correct protocol with r+1 possible first messages and one reply bit, using the restricted real rank r.

brief.zh: 选取秩基并汇集它们用到的坐标。单独处理常数行和补坐标行。
brief.en: Pool coordinates of a row basis, then handle constants and complemented coordinates in the output map.

gaps.statement: ∀ (n k m : ℕ) (A : Fin m → Finset (Fin n)) (Y : Finset (Finset (Fin n))) (a : ℤ), 2 ≤ k → k+2 ≤ n → let layer := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).powersetCard k; let adj := fun (A B : Finset (Fin n)) (a : ℤ) => ((A ∩ B).card : ℤ) = a ∨ ((A ∩ B).card : ℤ) = a+1; let detects := fun (Y : Finset (Finset (Fin n))) => ∀ A : Finset (Fin n), 2 ≤ A.card → A.card + 2 ≤ n → ∀ a : ℤ, ∃ B ∈ Y, ¬ adj A B a; let lin := fun (w : Fin n → ℝ) (B : Finset (Fin n)) => Finset.sum B w; let uniqueOn := fun (Y : Finset (Finset (Fin n))) => ∀ (w : Fin n → ℝ) (c : ℝ), (∀ B ∈ Y, lin w B = c) → ∀ B ∈ layer, lin w B = c; Y.Nonempty → Y ⊆ layer → detects Y → uniqueOn Y → (∀ i, ∀ B ∈ Y, adj (A i) B a) → let M : Matrix (Fin m) (↥Y) ℝ := fun i j => (((A i ∩ j.val).card : ℝ) - (a : ℝ)); ∃ R : Finset (Fin m), ∃ C : Finset (↥Y), ∃ v : ℝ, (∀ i ∈ R, ∀ j ∈ C, M i j = v) ∧ m*Y.card ≤ 4*(M.rank+1)*R.card*C.card

plain_statement.zh: 在同样条件下，找一块全同色子矩形，其大小至少是整张表的 1/[4(r+1)]。
plain_statement.en: Under the same sparse-column hypotheses, extract a monochromatic rectangle of density at least 1/[4(r+1)].

brief.zh: 按坐标与方向分组；对满坐标且恰少一秩的情形，另行统计零行。
brief.en: Group rows by coordinate and orientation and account separately for zero rows in the rank-deficient exceptional case.

gaps.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (A : Finset (Fin n)) (Y : Finset (Finset (Fin n))) (a : ℤ), let adj := fun (A B : Finset (Fin n)) (a : ℤ) => ((A ∩ B).card : ℤ) = a ∨ ((A ∩ B).card : ℤ) = a+1; let varY := fun (A : Finset (Fin n)) => let f := fun B : Finset (Fin n) => ((A ∩ B).card : ℝ); let avg := Finset.sum Y f / (Y.card : ℝ); Finset.sum Y (fun B => (f B - avg)^2) / (Y.card : ℝ); Y.Nonempty → (∀ B ∈ Y, adj A B a) → varY A ≤ 1/4

plain_statement.zh: 在任意非空有限列族上，如果交集大小只取相邻两个整数，均匀抽一列得到的方差至多是 1/4。
plain_statement.en: Intersection sizes supported on two consecutive integers have variance at most 1/4 under uniform sampling from any nonempty finite column family.

brief.zh: 把取较大值的频率记为 q，先证明此处的有限和等于 q(1−q)。
brief.en: Count the columns at the larger value and derive the finite-sum identity q(1−q).

gaps.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (Y : Finset (Finset (Fin n))) (l : ℝ), 4 ≤ n → Y.Nonempty → let adj := fun (A B : Finset (Fin n)) (a : ℤ) => ((A ∩ B).card : ℤ) = a ∨ ((A ∩ B).card : ℤ) = a+1; let detects := fun (Y : Finset (Finset (Fin n))) => ∀ A : Finset (Fin n), 2 ≤ A.card → A.card + 2 ≤ n → ∀ a : ℤ, ∃ B ∈ Y, ¬ adj A B a; let varY := fun (A : Finset (Fin n)) => let f := fun B : Finset (Fin n) => ((A ∩ B).card : ℝ); let avg := Finset.sum Y f / (Y.card : ℝ); Finset.sum Y (fun B => (f B - avg)^2) / (Y.card : ℝ); (n:ℝ)/(8*((n:ℝ)-2)) < l → (∀ A : Finset (Fin n), l*(A.card:ℝ)*((n:ℝ)-(A.card:ℝ))/(n:ℝ) ≤ varY A) → detects Y

plain_statement.zh: 若交集方差具有指定的统一下界，且系数严格超过 n/[8(n−2)]，则 Y 对每个内部行和每对相邻整数都有逃逸见证。
plain_statement.en: The uniform intersection-variance inequality with coefficient strictly above n/[8(n−2)] forces detection of every interior row and adjacent pair.

brief.zh: 比较内部行的 m(n−m) 与 2(n−2)，再接两值方差上界。取得该方差下界是另一步。
brief.en: Use m(n−m)≥2(n−2) for interior rows and combine it with the two-value variance bound.

gaps.statement: ∀ (n d l : ℕ) (Y : Finset (Finset (Fin n))) (A : Finset (Fin n)), (∀ i : Fin n, (Y.filter (fun B => i ∈ B)).card = d) → (∀ i j : Fin n, i ≠ j → (Y.filter (fun B => i ∈ B ∧ j ∈ B)).card = l) → Finset.sum Y (fun B => (A ∩ B).card ^ 2) = d*A.card + l*A.card*(A.card-1)

plain_statement.zh: 若每个点出现 d 次、每对不同点共同出现 l 次，则交集大小平方和有一个只依赖 |A|、d、l 的精确公式。
plain_statement.en: Compute the sum of squared intersection sizes when point and distinct-pair incidences are constant.

brief.zh: 展开平方计有序点对，对角线和非对角线分别求和。这一步可用来计算设计列的方差。
brief.en: Expand the square as ordered pairs. Count diagonal and off-diagonal terms separately.

plain_statement.zh: Sylvester–Hadamard 参数 n=2ᵗ−1、k=2ᵗ⁻¹−1 在 t≥3 时严格越过论文的设计谱阈值。
plain_statement.en: For t≥3 the Sylvester–Hadamard design parameters strictly meet the paper’s spectral threshold.

brief.zh: 写成 2 的幂再比较整数多项式。该算术任务是核验显式构造的一步。
brief.en: Reduce to a polynomial inequality in a power of two. The task certifies the numerical threshold.

gaps.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (Y : Finset (Finset (Fin n))) (i j : Fin n), 4 ≤ n → i ≠ j → let adj := fun (A B : Finset (Fin n)) (a : ℤ) => ((A ∩ B).card : ℤ) = a ∨ ((A ∩ B).card : ℤ) = a+1; let detects := fun (Y : Finset (Finset (Fin n))) => ∀ A : Finset (Fin n), 2 ≤ A.card → A.card + 2 ≤ n → ∀ a : ℤ, ∃ B ∈ Y, ¬ adj A B a; (∀ B ∈ Y, ¬ (i ∈ B ∧ j ∈ B)) → ¬ detects Y

plain_statement.zh: 当 n≥4 时，列族中若没有任何一列同时包含某对不同坐标，这个列族就无法检测所有内部行。
plain_statement.en: For n≥4, missing even one pair of distinct coordinates prevents a family from detecting all interior rows.

brief.zh: 把这一对坐标本身用作标记行，检查它能产生的交集大小。
brief.en: Take the uncovered pair as the marked row and examine all its intersection sizes.

gaps.statement: ∀ k : ℕ, 2 ≤ k → let n := 3*k+1; let layer := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).powersetCard k; let shift := fun (S : Finset (Fin n)) (t : Fin n) => S.image (fun i => i+t); let orbit := fun (S : Finset (Fin n)) => (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).image (shift S); let I := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).filter (fun i => i.val < k); let lin := fun (w : Fin n → ℝ) (B : Finset (Fin n)) => Finset.sum B w; let uniqueOn := fun (Y : Finset (Finset (Fin n))) => ∀ (w : Fin n → ℝ) (c : ℝ), (∀ B ∈ Y, lin w B = c) → ∀ B ∈ layer, lin w B = c; uniqueOn (orbit I)

plain_statement.zh: 在 n=3k+1 上，若一个仿射函数在长度 k 的所有循环区间上为零，则它在完整的 k 元层上也为零。
plain_statement.en: At n=3k+1, vanishing on all translates of a length-k interval forces an affine function to vanish on the entire weight-k layer.

brief.zh: 相邻区间作差推出相距 k 的权重相同，再用 gcd(k,3k+1)=1。
brief.en: Subtract neighboring interval sums and use the coprimality of k and 3k+1.

gaps.statement: ∀ (n k C : ℕ) (seed : Fin C → Finset (Fin n)), let shift := fun (S : Finset (Fin n)) (t : Fin n) => S.image (fun i => i+t); let orbit := fun (S : Finset (Fin n)) => (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).image (shift S); (∀ i, (seed i).card=k) → let Y := Finset.univ.biUnion (fun i => orbit (seed i)); Y.card ≤ C*n ∧ ∀ B ∈ Y, B.card=k

plain_statement.zh: C 个 k 元种子的全部循环平移至多给出 Cn 列，且每列仍有 k 个坐标。
plain_statement.en: All translates of C weight-k seeds give at most Cn columns, each still of weight k.

brief.zh: 平移是置换。对每个轨道计上界，再对并集计数，允许重复列。
brief.en: Translate by a permutation and bound the union by the sum of the orbit sizes.

gaps.statement: ∃ C K : ℕ, ∀ k : ℕ, K ≤ k → 2 ≤ k → let n := 3*k+1; let adj := fun (A B : Finset (Fin n)) (a : ℤ) => ((A ∩ B).card : ℤ) = a ∨ ((A ∩ B).card : ℤ) = a+1; let detects := fun (Y : Finset (Finset (Fin n))) => ∀ A : Finset (Fin n), 2 ≤ A.card → A.card + 2 ≤ n → ∀ a : ℤ, ∃ B ∈ Y, ¬ adj A B a; let shift := fun (S : Finset (Fin n)) (t : Fin n) => S.image (fun i => i+t); let orbit := fun (S : Finset (Fin n)) => (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).image (shift S); let I := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).filter (fun i => i.val < k); ∃ seed : Fin C → Finset (Fin n), (∀ i, (seed i).card=k) ∧ detects (orbit I ∪ Finset.univ.biUnion (fun i => orbit (seed i)))

plain_statement.zh: 开放目标：在所有充分大的 n=3k+1 上，给循环区间添加至多固定 C 个 k 元种子的平移轨道，检测全部内部行。
plain_statement.en: Open target: for every sufficiently large n=3k+1, augment cyclic intervals by a fixed number C of seed orbits to detect every interior row.

brief.zh: 要用同一个 C 覆盖无界多个尺度。可从有公式的种子入手，证明覆盖所有行；此命题本身只要求存在性。
brief.en: Seek seed formulas, then prove coverage uniformly in k. The frozen proposition asks for existence with one constant C.

gaps.statement: ∀ (m n:ℕ) (A:Fin m→Fin n→Bool) (I U:Finset (Fin m)) (J V:Finset (Fin n)) (b:Bool), U⊆I → V⊆J → (∀ i∈I,∀ j∈J,A i j=b) → ∀ i∈U,∀ j∈V,A i j=b

plain_statement.zh: 单色矩形对子行列封闭
plain_statement.en: Monochromatic rectangles survive restriction

brief.zh: 跟踪子矩形的面积和覆盖数，用于单色矩形到确定性协议的归约。
brief.en: Track subrectangle area and cover size in the monochromatic-rectangle to protocol reduction.

gaps.statement: ∀ (m n:ℕ) (A:Fin m→Fin n→Bool) (I U:Finset (Fin m)) (J V:Finset (Fin n)), (∀ i∈I,∀ j∈J,A i j=true) → (∀ i∈U,∀ j∈V,A i j=false) → Disjoint I U ∨ Disjoint J V

plain_statement.zh: 异色矩形至少一侧不相交
plain_statement.en: Opposite colors force disjointness on one axis

brief.zh: 跟踪子矩形的面积和覆盖数，用于单色矩形到确定性协议的归约。
brief.en: Track subrectangle area and cover size in the monochromatic-rectangle to protocol reduction.

gaps.statement: ∀ (m n:ℕ) (A:Fin m→Fin n→Bool) (I U:Finset (Fin m)) (J:Finset (Fin n)) (b:Bool), (∀ i∈I,∀ j∈J,A i j=b) → (∀ i∈U,∀ j∈J,A i j=b) → ∀ i∈I∪U,∀ j∈J,A i j=b

plain_statement.zh: 相同行型允许合并单色行集合
plain_statement.en: Merge row sets with the same monochromatic columns

brief.zh: 跟踪子矩形的面积和覆盖数，用于单色矩形到确定性协议的归约。
brief.en: Track subrectangle area and cover size in the monochromatic-rectangle to protocol reduction.

gaps.statement: ∀ (m n k:ℕ) (I:Fin k→Finset (Fin m)) (J:Fin k→Finset (Fin n)), (∀ i j,∃ h,i∈I h ∧ j∈J h) → m*n≤∑ h,(I h).card*(J h).card

plain_statement.zh: 任意矩形覆盖的面积和控制矩阵面积
plain_statement.en: Area lower bound on a rectangle cover

brief.zh: 跟踪子矩形的面积和覆盖数，用于单色矩形到确定性协议的归约。
brief.en: Track subrectangle area and cover size in the monochromatic-rectangle to protocol reduction.

gaps.statement: ∀ (m n : ℕ) (A : Fin m → Fin n → Bool) (R : Finset (Fin m)) (C : Finset (Fin n)), let bad := fun i => C.filter (fun j => A i j=false); (∑ i ∈ R,(bad i).card)=∑ j ∈ C,(R.filter (fun i => A i j=false)).card

plain_statement.zh: 按行或按列得到相同的反色数
plain_statement.en: Double-count opposite entries by rows and columns

brief.zh: 对 R×C 中反色点作两次纤维计数。
brief.en: Count the false entries of the product by its two projections.

gaps.statement: ∀ (m n : ℕ) (A : Fin m → Fin n → Bool) (R : Finset (Fin m)) (C : Finset (Fin n)), let bad := fun i => C.filter (fun j => A i j=false); ∀ t:ℕ,(t+1)*(R.filter (fun i => t<(bad i).card)).card≤∑ i ∈ R,(bad i).card

plain_statement.zh: 截去高错误行的数量预算
plain_statement.en: Bound the number of high-error rows

brief.zh: 对阈值以上的每行至少计入 t+1 个错误。
brief.en: Charge at least t+1 entries to each removed row.

gaps.statement: ∀ (m n : ℕ) (A : Fin m → Fin n → Bool) (R : Finset (Fin m)) (C : Finset (Fin n)), let bad := fun i => C.filter (fun j => A i j=false); let D:=R.biUnion bad; C.card≤(C \ D).card+(∑ i ∈ R,(bad i).card)

plain_statement.zh: 保留指定行时共同好列的下界
plain_statement.en: Lower bound common good columns for selected rows

brief.zh: 用并集界控制需要删除的列。
brief.en: Bound the union of forbidden columns.

gaps.statement: ∀ (m n : ℕ) (A : Fin m → Fin n → Bool) (R : Finset (Fin m)) (C : Finset (Fin n)), let bad := fun i => C.filter (fun j => A i j=false); ∀ k:ℕ,k≤R.card → ∃ U:Finset (Fin m), U⊆R ∧ U.card=k ∧ R.card*(∑ i ∈ U,(bad i).card)≤k*(∑ i ∈ R,(bad i).card)

plain_statement.zh: 选择总错误量较小的指定数量行
plain_statement.en: Select a prescribed number of rows with low total error

brief.zh: 对所有 k 行子集平均，或按行的错误数排序。
brief.en: Average over all k-row subsets or sort by row error.

gaps.statement: ∀ (m n : ℕ) (A : Fin m → Fin n → Bool) (R : Finset (Fin m)) (C : Finset (Fin n)), let bad := fun i => C.filter (fun j => A i j=false); ∀ k d:ℕ,0<R.card → k≤R.card → k*(∑ i ∈ R,(bad i).card)≤d*R.card → ∃ U:Finset (Fin m), ∃ V:Finset (Fin n), U⊆R ∧ V⊆C ∧ U.card=k ∧ C.card≤V.card+d ∧ ∀ i∈U,∀ j∈V,A i j=true

plain_statement.zh: 由总错误预算构造定量单色矩形

plain_statement.zh: 任意两层大小的互补坐标矩形证书
plain_statement.en: Complementary-block rectangle certificate for arbitrary layers

brief.zh: 把两层的计数与集合不交性分别证明，再专门化到尚未完成的矩形。 对应父题：L-log-rank-cert-8-8。
brief.en: Use the cardinality of each powerset layer and containment in complementary blocks. Parent: L-log-rank-cert-8-8.

gaps.statement: ∀ n r c s : ℕ, r ≤ s → s < n → c ≤ n-(s+1) → let F := fun t => Nat.choose t r * Nat.choose (n-t) c; (s+1-r)*(n-s)*F (s+1) = (s+1)*(n-s-c)*F s

plain_statement.zh: 移动一个坐标时矩形面积的精确递推
plain_statement.en: Exact rectangle-area recurrence under one coordinate transfer

brief.zh: 用相邻二项式系数递推，交叉相乘避免自然数除法。 对应父题：L-log-rank-cert-8-8。
brief.en: Use adjacent binomial recurrences and cross-multiply to avoid rounded division. Parent: L-log-rank-cert-8-8.

gaps.statement: ∀ n r c s : ℕ, r ≤ s → s < n → c ≤ n-(s+1) → let F := fun t => Nat.choose t r * Nat.choose (n-t) c; (F s  ≤  F (s+1) ↔ (s+1)*c  ≤  r*(n-s))

plain_statement.zh: 分配坐标给行层能否增大矩形
plain_statement.en: Determine when moving a coordinate increases area

brief.zh: 利用可行区内的面积正性消去递推中的面积，比较交叉乘积。 对应父题：L-log-rank-cert-8-8。
brief.en: Cancel the positive feasible area in the recurrence and compare the cross-products. Parent: L-log-rank-cert-8-8.

gaps.statement: ∀ k : ℕ, 6 ≤ k → let n := 3*k+1; let S := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).filter (fun i => i.val ≤ k-2 ∨ i.val = 2*k-3); let shift := fun (t : Fin n) => S.image (fun i => i+t); S.card = k ∧ ∀ A : Finset (Fin n), (A.card = 2 ∨ A.card = 3 ∨ Aᶜ.card = 2 ∨ Aᶜ.card = 3) → ∀ a : ℤ, ∃ t : Fin n, ¬ (((A ∩ shift t).card : ℤ) = a ∨ ((A ∩ shift t).card : ℤ) = a+1)

plain_statement.zh: 当 k≥6、n=3k+1 时，集合 S={0,…,k−2}∪{2k−3} 恰含 k 个坐标。若一行或其补集的大小为 2 或 3，则 S 的循环平移与该行的交集大小不可能全落在任意指定的两个相邻整数中。
plain_statement.en: For k≥6 and n=3k+1, the k-set S={0,…,k−2}∪{2k−3} has a translation orbit that detects every row of size 2 or 3 and every complement of such a row.

brief.zh: 种子的差覆盖所有非零循环位移，所以任意两点可被同一平移覆盖。每个点只出现在 k 个平移中，至多三个点时还有平移与整行不交。对补集使用交集大小之和等于 k。
brief.en: The seed realizes every nonzero cyclic difference, so some translate contains any chosen pair. At most 3k translations meet a row with at most three points. Complementary intersection sizes sum to k.

gaps.statement: ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ k : ℕ, K ≤ k → 2 ≤ k → let n := 3*k+1; let layer := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).powersetCard k; let adj := fun (A B : Finset (Fin n)) (a : ℤ) => ((A ∩ B).card : ℤ) = a ∨ ((A ∩ B).card : ℤ) = a+1; let detects := fun (Y : Finset (Finset (Fin n))) => ∀ A : Finset (Fin n), 2 ≤ A.card → A.card + 2 ≤ n → ∀ a : ℤ, ∃ B ∈ Y, ¬ adj A B a; let lin := fun (w : Fin n → ℝ) (B : Finset (Fin n)) => Finset.sum B w; let uniqueOn := fun (Y : Finset (Finset (Fin n))) => ∀ (w : Fin n → ℝ) (c : ℝ), (∀ B ∈ Y, lin w B = c) → ∀ B ∈ layer, lin w B = c; ∃ Y : Finset (Finset (Fin n)), Y.Nonempty ∧ Y ⊆ layer ∧ Y.card = n ∧ detects Y ∧ uniqueOn Y ∧ ∀ (m : ℕ) (A : Fin m → Finset (Fin n)) (a : ℤ), (∀ i, ∀ B ∈ Y, adj (A i) B a) → let M : Matrix (Fin m) (↥Y) ℝ := fun i j => (((A i ∩ j.val).card : ℝ) - (a : ℝ)); ∃ send : Fin m → Fin (M.rank+1), ∃ reply : Fin (M.rank+1) → ↥Y → Bool, ∃ out : Fin m → Bool → Bool, ∀ i j, (out i (reply (send i) j) = true ↔ M i j = 1)

plain_statement.zh: 猜想：恰用 n 列同时实现全行检测、仿射唯一性和按受限矩阵秩计费的协议
plain_statement.en: Conjecture: exactly n columns suffice for detection, affine uniqueness and a rank-sized protocol

brief.zh: 仿射维数给出 n 列下界。难点是同一组恰好 n 列同时检测所有内部行；只构造仿射基或只完成协议推导都不足够。
brief.en: Find a minimal affine basis that simultaneously detects every interior row. Apply the proved protocol only after both properties hold.

gaps.statement: ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ k : ℕ, K ≤ k → 2 ≤ k → let n := 3*k+1; let adj := fun (A B : Finset (Fin n)) (a : ℤ) => ((A ∩ B).card : ℤ) = a ∨ ((A ∩ B).card : ℤ) = a+1; let detects := fun (Y : Finset (Finset (Fin n))) => ∀ A : Finset (Fin n), 2 ≤ A.card → A.card + 2 ≤ n → ∀ a : ℤ, ∃ B ∈ Y, ¬ adj A B a; let shift := fun (S : Finset (Fin n)) (t : Fin n) => S.image (fun i => i+t); let orbit := fun (S : Finset (Fin n)) => (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).image (shift S); let I := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).filter (fun i => i.val < k); ∃ S : Finset (Fin n), S.card = k ∧ detects (orbit I ∪ orbit S)

plain_statement.zh: 猜想：一个循环区间和一个种子的平移即可检测全部内部行
plain_statement.en: Conjecture: an interval orbit and one seed orbit detect all interior rows

brief.zh: 已证构造用至多 8010 个轨道。目标是两个轨道、同一批列覆盖全部行。可搜索小参数；证伪须给出任意阈值以上的障碍。
brief.en: Reduce 8010 orbits to two without weakening the detection quantifiers. A refutation needs arbitrarily large counterexamples.

gaps.statement: ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (m n : ℕ) (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ), 0 < m → 0 < n → (∀ i j, M i j = 0 ∨ M i j = 1) → 1 ≤ M.rank → ∃ (A : Finset (Fin m)) (B : Finset (Fin n)) (v : ℝ), (∀ i ∈ A, ∀ j ∈ B, M i j = v) ∧ (m : ℝ) * n ≤ (A.card : ℝ) * B.card * Real.rpow 2 (C * Real.rpow (M.rank : ℝ) (49999 / 100000 : ℝ))

plain_statement.zh: 猜想：任意正实秩布尔矩阵都有密度至少 2^(−C r^0.49999) 的单色矩形
plain_statement.en: Conjecture: every positive-rank Boolean matrix has a monochromatic rectangle of density at least 2^(−C r^0.49999)

brief.zh: Cogentic 的指数是 0.499995。本题保持任意矩阵与统一常数，要求将指数降至 0.49999。审计偏置稳定矩阵归约中造成指数损失的步骤；减小乘法常数不足以得证。
brief.en: Audit the exponent losses in the biased stable matrix reduction (Theorem 3.1). Improve the exponent uniformly for all Boolean matrices; a smaller prefactor alone is insufficient.

zh: 从层上的计数到锐常数
列是 n 个坐标中恰好选 k 个的子集。先按交集大小数列，再把论文的 2/5 概率界写成整数不等式。
en: Count the slice and recover the sharp constant
Columns are k-subsets of n coordinates. Count by intersection size, then turn the paper’s sharp 2/5 probability bound into an integer inequality.

tasks.zh: 按交集大小分组
tasks.en: Count an intersection fiber

tasks.zh: 核对六坐标取等情形
tasks.en: Check the six-coordinate equality

tasks.zh: 复现 2/5 逃逸界
tasks.en: Recover the sharp escape bound

tasks.zh: 删列后保留见证
tasks.en: Preserve a witness after deletion

zh: 从两值限制到通信协议
先刻画允许的行，再把坐标查询和取补编成双方的消息。协议任务以稀疏矩阵自身的实数秩计费。
en: Turn two-level structure into a protocol
Classify admissible rows and turn coordinate queries into messages. Measure communication against the real rank of the restricted matrix.

tasks.zh: 排除两个同时变化的块
tasks.en: Rule out two varying blocks

tasks.zh: 刻画完整层上的行
tasks.en: Classify full-slice rows

tasks.zh: 按实际秩编码消息
tasks.en: Encode a rank-sensitive protocol

tasks.zh: 提取单色矩形
tasks.en: Extract a monochromatic rectangle

zh: 用方差筛选稀疏列
在样本列上直接求和。把论文的方差阈值翻译成有限集可使用的检测定理，并复核设计族的参数。
en: Use variance to certify sparse columns
Sum over a finite family of sample columns. Translate the variance threshold into a detection theorem and verify the design parameters.

tasks.zh: 两值分布的方差上界
tasks.en: Bound two-value variance

tasks.zh: 把谱余量接到检测性
tasks.en: Turn a variance gap into detection

tasks.zh: 从点对重数计算二阶矩
tasks.en: Count the design second moment

tasks.zh: 核验 Hadamard 中央层参数
tasks.en: Check the Hadamard spectral margin

zh: 探索三分之一密度的新列族
在 n=3k+1 上试一条更具体的路线：用循环区间确定仿射函数，再补少量平移轨道检测所有内部行。最后一题是候选研究目标。
en: Explore new columns at one-third density
At n=3k+1, try cyclic intervals for affine uniqueness and a bounded number of additional translation orbits for detection. The last task is a proposed research target.

tasks.zh: 识别漏掉点对的构造
tasks.en: Rule out an uncovered pair

tasks.zh: 循环区间确定仿射函数
tasks.en: Prove cyclic interval uniqueness

tasks.zh: 给平移族核算列数
tasks.en: Bound the column budget

tasks.zh: 构造线性规模的检测族
tasks.en: Seek a linear cyclic detector family

tasks.zh: 当 k≥6、n=3k+1 时，集合 S={0,…,k−2}∪{2k−3} 恰含 k 个坐标。若一行或其补集的大小为 2 或 3，则 S 的循环平移与该行的交集大小不可能全落在任意指定的两个相邻整数中。
tasks.en: For k≥6 and n=3k+1, the k-set S={0,…,k−2}∪{2k−3} has a translation orbit that detects every row of size 2 or 3 and every complement of such a row.

tasks.zh: 猜想：恰用 n 列同时实现全行检测、仿射唯一性和按受限矩阵秩计费的协议
tasks.en: Conjecture: exactly n columns suffice for detection, affine uniqueness and a rank-sized protocol

tasks.zh: 猜想：一个循环区间和一个种子的平移即可检测全部内部行
tasks.en: Conjecture: an interval orbit and one seed orbit detect all interior rows

zh: 单色矩形的收缩和覆盖
跟踪子矩形的面积和覆盖数，用于单色矩形到确定性协议的归约。
en: Restriction and coverage of monochromatic rectangles
Track subrectangle area and cover size in the monochromatic-rectangle to protocol reduction.

tasks.zh: 单色矩形对子行列封闭
tasks.en: Monochromatic rectangles survive restriction

tasks.zh: 异色矩形至少一侧不相交
tasks.en: Opposite colors force disjointness on one axis

tasks.zh: 相同行型允许合并单色行集合
tasks.en: Merge row sets with the same monochromatic columns

tasks.zh: 任意矩形覆盖的面积和控制矩阵面积
tasks.en: Area lower bound on a rectangle cover

zh: 从稀疏反色项中抽出单色矩形
给出可直接接到谱估计的有限计数接口，记录删行、删列的损失；谱路线仍需提供足够大的低错误子矩阵。
en: Extract monochromatic rectangles from sparse opposite entries
Expose the exact row and column costs of purification; spectral arguments must still supply a large low-error submatrix.

tasks.zh: 按行或按列得到相同的反色数
tasks.en: Double-count opposite entries by rows and columns

tasks.zh: 截去高错误行的数量预算
tasks.en: Bound the number of high-error rows

tasks.zh: 保留指定行时共同好列的下界
tasks.en: Lower bound common good columns for selected rows

tasks.zh: 选择总错误量较小的指定数量行
tasks.en: Select a prescribed number of rows with low total error

tasks.zh: 由总错误预算构造定量单色矩形
tasks.en: Extract a quantitative monochromatic rectangle from total error

zh: 构造交集矩阵的分层单色矩形
按坐标集及其补集取定阶子集，量化矩形面积，作为一般提取界的构造基准。
en: Construct layer rectangles in intersection matrices
Use fixed-size subsets of complementary coordinate blocks and compute the exact area.

question.zh: 望月新一未能供应推论3.12的Lean证明。Joshi试图供应一个证明，但按照论文字面量为假。Joshi对abc猜想的证明到底能否被修补，亦或者从一开始就是一场幻梦？
question.en: Shinichi Mochizuki did not provide a Lean proof of Corollary 3.12. Joshi attempted to give a proof, but the statement as written in the paper is false. Can Joshi’s proof of the abc conjecture be repaired, or was it an illusion from the start?

summary.zh: 从张量 Haar 归一、29 进见证和迹下降开始，检验同一包络的上下界能否给出统一高度估计。
summary.en: Start with tensor Haar normalization, 29-adic witnesses and trace descent, and test whether both bounds on one hull can yield a uniform height estimate.

background.zh: 依据 Edison Mai 的 Joshi III 审计与 Joshi II–IV 原文。修复必须在实际允许的像上兼容算术标记、权重与无穷处误差。Levent 的 Θ 方法提供指定 Fourier 测试和迹对偶的研究方向。
background.en: Following Edison Mai’s audit of Joshi III and Joshi II–IV, seek compatible labels, weights and archimedean errors on the actual allowed image. Levent’s theta methods motivate prescribed Fourier tests and trace duality.

brief.en: This checks the numerical contradiction between 1/5 and 1/25. Use JA-0002, JA-0004 and the local lattice construction to verify the identification and the weights.

gaps.statement: ∀ (m n : ℕ) (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℚ) (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℚ), (Matrix.kronecker A B).det = A.det^n * B.det^m

brief.zh: 在积指标基中写矩阵，跟踪每个局部行列式的相对维数幂。

plain_statement.en: New route · Printed comparisons and Haar volume · JA-0003 · Verify the two rational tangent directions at the bad reduction

brief.zh: 在节点原点取 y²+xy−x³ 的最低次齐次项。
brief.en: Take the lowest homogeneous part of y²+xy−x³ at the origin.

gaps.statement: ∀ (d e : ℕ) (x y : ℝ), 0 < d → 0 < e → 0 < x → 0 < y → Real.log (x^e*y^d)/((d:ℝ)*e) = Real.log x/d + Real.log y/e

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 原文反例与 Haar 体积 · JA-0007 · 求两个槽的次数归一对数体积
plain_statement.en: New route · Printed comparisons and Haar volume · JA-0007 · Compute degree-normalized logarithmic volume in two slots

brief.zh: 将 x,y 取为局部范数的绝对值，展开乘积及幂的对数。
brief.en: Take x and y to be the absolute values of the local norms and expand the logarithm.

gaps.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (a : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (m V : ℝ), 0 < m → (∀ i, 0 < a i ∧ a i < 1) → -|V|/m < -∑ i, Real.log (a i)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 原文反例与 Haar 体积 · JA-0001 · 对非空坏处集检验印出的对数不等式
plain_statement.en: New route · Printed comparisons and Haar volume · JA-0001 · Test the printed sign on a nonempty set of bad places

brief.zh: 逐项 log aᵢ<0，左端由绝对值控制。V 表示对数体积。
brief.en: Sum log aᵢ<0 over all places. The absolute value bounds the left side for any real log-volume V.

gaps.statement: ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (E F : Type) [Field E] [Field F] [Algebra (Padic p) E] [Algebra (Padic p) F] (x : E) (y : F), TensorProduct.tmul (Padic p) ((p:Padic p) • x) y = TensorProduct.tmul (Padic p) x ((p:Padic p) • y)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 原文反例与 Haar 体积 · JA-0004 · 在 p 进张量内把标量移过槽位
plain_statement.en: New route · Printed comparisons and Haar volume · JA-0004 · Move a scalar across the two slots of a p-adic tensor

brief.zh: 在同一底域上使用张量的平衡关系，固定两个槽的标量规范。
brief.en: Use the balancing relation over the common base field with identical scalar normalizations.

gaps.statement: ∀ (m n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → Fin m) (w : Fin n → ℝ) (d f : Fin m → ℝ), (∀ i, ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).filter (fun j => v j=i)).sum w = d i) → (∑ j, w j*f (v j)) = ∑ i, d i*f i

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 原文反例与 Haar 体积 · JA-0008 · 在局部次数塔下运输带权平均
plain_statement.en: New route · Printed comparisons and Haar volume · JA-0008 · Transport the weighted average down a tower of places

gaps.statement: ∀ (p n : ℕ), p.Prime → 2 ≤ n → let c : ℕ := if p=2 then 4 else p; multiplicity p n < (n-1)*multiplicity p c

brief.en: Use (p−1)vₚ(n)≤n−1. The choice c=4 gives strictness at p=2.

gaps.statement: ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime], let c : Padic p := if p=2 then 4 else (p:Padic p); let tau := fun (x : Padic p) => (∑' k : ℕ, (-1:Padic p)^k*(c*x)^(k+1)/((k+1:ℕ):Padic p))/c; ∀ x : Padic p, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 → ‖tau x‖ = ‖x‖

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 缩放对数与 Theta 值 · JA-0010 · 证明实际 p 进缩放对数级数保持整元范数
plain_statement.en: New route · Scaled logarithms and theta values · JA-0010 · Show the actual scaled p-adic log preserves the norm on integral elements

gaps.statement: ∀ (p l : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (z : ZMod p), p ≠ 2 → Odd l → z^l=1 → z+z⁻¹ ≠ 0

gaps.statement: ∀ (K : Type) [NontriviallyNormedField K] [CompleteSpace K] [IsUltrametricDist K], let theta := fun (q u : K) => ∑' n : ℤ, q^(n*(n+1)/2) * u^(2*n+1); ∀ q u : K, u ≠ 0 → q ≠ 0 → theta q u⁻¹ = theta q u

plain_statement.en: New route · Scaled logarithms and theta values · JA-0014 · Reindex the convergent bilateral theta series

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 缩放对数与 Theta 值 · JA-0012 · 证明指标 −1 是唯一最小项
plain_statement.en: New route · Scaled logarithms and theta values · JA-0012 · Prove the unique minimum occurs at index minus one

brief.en: Use the signs of the successive differences on either side of −1.

gaps.statement: ∀ (K : Type) [NontriviallyNormedField K] [CompleteSpace K] [IsUltrametricDist K], let theta := fun (q u : K) => ∑' n : ℤ, q^(n*(n+1)/2) * u^(2*n+1); ∀ (r z : K) (l j : ℕ), 0 < ‖r‖ → ‖r‖ < 1 → ‖z‖=1 → ‖z+z⁻¹‖=1 → 0 < j → j < l → ‖theta (r^(2*l)) z / theta (r^(2*l)) (r^j*z)‖ = ‖r‖^j

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 缩放对数与 Theta 值 · JA-0015 · 从实际双边级数求单标签比值的范数
plain_statement.en: New route · Scaled logarithms and theta values · JA-0015 · Evaluate the norm of the one-label ratio of actual theta series

brief.zh: 证明两尾趋零；分子有两首项，分母在 −1 唯一取最大范数。
brief.en: Show convergence in both tails. The numerator has two leading terms and the denominator has a unique norm maximum at −1.

gaps.statement: let g := fun (u : ZMod 29) => (![u,0,0] : Fin 3 → ZMod 29); let S := {v | ∃ u : ZMod 29, u^14=1 ∧ v=g u}; Submodule.span (ZMod 29) S = Submodule.span (ZMod 29) ({g 1} : Set (Fin 3 → ZMod 29))

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 29 进生成与反例族 · JA-0020 · 十四个根分支只生出模 29 一条直线
plain_statement.en: New route · 29-adic generation and counterfamilies · JA-0020 · Show the fourteen root branches span just one residual line

brief.en: Every branch is on the first coordinate axis, which contains the branch at 1.

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 29 进生成与反例族 · JA-0027 · 任取三个见证在十四维剩余商仍缺至少 29¹¹ 倍
plain_statement.en: New route · 29-adic generation and counterfamilies · JA-0027 · Bound the index of any three witnesses in the fourteen-dimensional residual quotient

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 29 进生成与反例族 · JA-0026 · 判定深 Tate 参数何时把底格压进 29W
plain_statement.en: New route · 29-adic generation and counterfamilies · JA-0026 · Check when a deep Tate parameter places the reference lattice in 29W

brief.en: Compare the orders of 29rₜ and rₜ⁴ in uniformizer units for rₜ=29ᵗπ.

gaps.statement: letI : Fact (Nat.Prime 29) := ⟨by decide⟩; ∀ (K : Type) [NontriviallyNormedField K] [NormedAlgebra (Padic 29) K] [CompleteSpace K] [IsUltrametricDist K] [CharZero K], let theta := fun (q u : K) => ∑' n : ℤ, q^(n*(n+1)/2) * u^(2*n+1); let embed := fun (a : PadicInt 29) => algebraMap (Padic 29) K (a:Padic 29); let t := fun (x : K) => (∑' k : ℕ, (-1:K)^k*((29:K)*x)^(k+1)/((k+1:ℕ):K))/(29:K); ∀ (r z : K), r^14=(29:K) → 0 < ‖r‖ → ‖r‖<1 → z^7=1 → ‖z‖=1 → ‖1+z^2‖=1 → (∀ n : ℕ, 0<n → ‖(n:K)‖ = ‖r‖^(14*multiplicity 29 n)) → (∀ u : K, ‖u‖ ≤ 1 → ∃ a : PadicInt 29, ‖u-embed a‖ ≤ ‖r‖) → let ξ := theta (r^14) z / theta (r^14) (r^2*z); let u := theta (r^14) (r*z) / theta (r^14) (r^2*z); ∀ x : K, ‖x‖ ≤ ‖r‖ → ∃ a b c : PadicInt 29, ‖x - (embed a*t r + embed b*t ξ + embed c*t u)‖ ≤ ‖r‖^4

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 29 进生成与反例族 · JA-0028 · 在指定 29 进局部模型中用实际 Θ 级数生成一次幂格
plain_statement.en: New route · 29-adic generation and counterfamilies · JA-0028 · Generate the first-power lattice in the specified 29-adic model

brief.zh: 按一、二、三阶消元，余项落到 π⁴。此局部结论使用显式剩余类假设；实际 ATS 标签下的允许像成员资格是独立输入。
brief.en: Eliminate the coefficients of degrees one, two and three. The remainder lies in π⁴. The residue hypothesis is explicit. Membership in the allowed image at an ATS label is a separate input.

gaps.statement: ∀ (K : Type) [NontriviallyNormedField K] [CompleteSpace K] [IsUltrametricDist K] [CharZero K] (r : K), r^14=(29:K) → 0 < ‖r‖ → ‖r‖<1 → (∀ n : ℕ, 0<n → ‖(n:K)‖ = ‖r‖^(14*multiplicity 29 n)) → ∀ x : K, ‖x‖ ≤ ‖r‖ → ‖(∑' k : ℕ, (-1:K)^k*((29:K)*x)^(k+1)/((k+1:ℕ):K))/(29:K)-x‖ ≤ ‖r‖^4

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 29 进生成与反例族 · JA-0024 · 证明缩放 29 进对数保持模 π⁴ 的喷射
plain_statement.en: New route · 29-adic generation and counterfamilies · JA-0024 · Show the scaled 29-adic log preserves the jet modulo π⁴

brief.zh: 写出第二项起各项的阶，计入被 29 整除的分母，再对尾和用强三角不等式。
brief.en: Bound every term after the first, including denominators divisible by 29, and use the ultrametric bound for the tail.

gaps.statement: ∀ (K : Type) [NontriviallyNormedField K] [CompleteSpace K] [IsUltrametricDist K] [CharZero K], let theta := fun (q u : K) => ∑' n : ℤ, q^(n*(n+1)/2) * u^(2*n+1); ∀ (r z : K), r^14=(29:K) → 0 < ‖r‖ → ‖r‖ < 1 → z^7=1 → ‖z‖=1 → ‖1+z^2‖=1 → ‖theta (r^14) (r*z) / theta (r^14) (r^2*z) - (r+z^2*r^3)‖ ≤ ‖r‖^4

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 29 进生成与反例族 · JA-0022 · 从真正 Theta 商算出三阶系数 ζ²
plain_statement.en: New route · 29-adic generation and counterfamilies · JA-0022 · Compute the cubic coefficient ζ² from the actual theta quotient

brief.zh: 抽出分母首个负幂，先算分子、分母单位部分，再作截断除法。
brief.en: Factor out the leading negative power in the denominator and divide the truncated unit parts.

gaps.statement: ∀ (p f n m : ℕ), p.Prime → n ≤ m → (p^f)^n * p^(f*(m-n)) = (p^f)^m

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 29 进生成与反例族 · JA-0018 · 数出主理想两层之间的精确指数
plain_statement.en: New route · 29-adic generation and counterfamilies · JA-0018 · Count the exact index between powers of the uniformizer

brief.zh: 每个连续商有 pᶠ 个元素，乘指数。代入 f=1、n=1、m=4 得三个剩余域方向。
brief.en: Each successive quotient has pᶠ elements. Substitute f=1, n=1 and m=4 for the three residue layers.
