plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 29 进生成与反例族 · JA-0019 · 固定有效的模 29 七次单位根及两个主元
plain_statement.en: New route · 29-adic generation and counterfamilies · JA-0019 · Fix a seventh root modulo 29 and certify both pivots

brief.zh: 直接模幂验证，并保留两个非零主元供消元。
brief.en: Use modular powers and retain the two nonzero pivots for elimination.

gaps.statement: ∀ (K : Type) [NontriviallyNormedField K] [CompleteSpace K] [IsUltrametricDist K] [CharZero K], let theta := fun (q u : K) => ∑' n : ℤ, q^(n*(n+1)/2) * u^(2*n+1); ∀ (r z : K), r^14=(29:K) → 0 < ‖r‖ → ‖r‖ < 1 → z^7=1 → ‖z‖=1 → ‖1+z^2‖=1 → ‖theta (r^14) z / theta (r^14) (r^2*z) - (1+z^2)*r^2‖ ≤ ‖r‖^4

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 29 进生成与反例族 · JA-0023 · 求单个 ξ₂ 在模 π⁴ 下的二阶项
plain_statement.en: New route · 29-adic generation and counterfamilies · JA-0023 · Compute the quadratic jet of ξ₂ modulo π⁴

brief.zh: 分子常数为 z+z⁻¹，分母主项为 r⁻²z⁻¹；分开估计两条尾。
brief.en: The leading terms are z+z⁻¹ and r⁻²z⁻¹. Bound the two tails separately.

gaps.statement: let z : ZMod 29 := 7; let v : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ZMod 29 := ![![1,0,0],![0,1+z^2,0],![1,0,z^2]]; Submodule.span (ZMod 29) (Set.range v) = ⊤

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 29 进生成与反例族 · JA-0021 · 用三个指定余类生成整个三维商格
plain_statement.en: New route · 29-adic generation and counterfamilies · JA-0021 · Span the three-dimensional residue quotient with the prescribed jets

brief.zh: 从末行减去首行，再用两个非零主元恢复标准基。
brief.en: Subtract the first row from the third and use the two unit pivots to recover the standard basis.

gaps.statement: ∀ (G : Type) [AddCommGroup G] (C L : AddSubgroup G), L ≤ C → (∀ x : G, ∃ y ∈ C, x-y ∈ L) → C=⊤

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 29 进生成与反例族 · JA-0025 · 把商格满生成提升回含底格的加法包络
plain_statement.en: New route · 29-adic generation and counterfamilies · JA-0025 · Lift spanning in the quotient back to an additive hull containing the base lattice

brief.zh: 取商格每一个类的代表并在 C 内补回 L；用于三个实际见证同标签时。
brief.en: Choose a representative in C and restore the element of L. Apply this when the actual three witnesses share a label.

gaps.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (w q r h : Fin n → ℝ), (∀ i, 0 ≤ w i ∧ -q i-h i ≤ r i) → -(∑ i, w i*q i)-(∑ i, w i*h i) ≤ ∑ i, w i*r i

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 迹、不同理想与 Fourier 缺额 · JA-0039 · 按次数累加有限处的实际缺额
plain_statement.en: New route · Trace, different and Fourier deficit · JA-0039 · Aggregate actual finite-place deficits with degree weights

brief.zh: 先固定同一组处和次数权重，再加入无穷处误差。
brief.en: Fix the marked places and degree weights before adding the archimedean contribution.

gaps.statement: ∀ (p n : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (H : Submodule (ZMod p) (Fin n → ZMod p)), Nat.card H.dualAnnihilator = Nat.card ((Fin n → ZMod p) ⧸ H)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 迹、不同理想与 Fourier 缺额 · JA-0033 · 以对偶零化子基数计算缺方向的指数
plain_statement.en: New route · Trace, different and Fourier deficit · JA-0033 · Count missing directions by the cardinality of the dual annihilator

brief.zh: 用商空间的对偶与 H 的零化子的同构，再按有限维计算基数。
brief.en: Identify the annihilator with the dual of the quotient and count the finite vector spaces.

gaps.statement: ∀ (p n : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (H : Submodule (ZMod p) (Fin n → ZMod p)) [Fintype H] (χ : (Fin n → ZMod p) → ℂ) (b : Fin n → ZMod p), (∀ x y, χ (x+y)=χ x*χ y) → (∃ h : H, χ h.val ≠ 1) → (∑ h : H, χ (b+h.val)) = 0

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 迹、不同理想与 Fourier 缺额 · JA-0034 · 用平移证明非平凡字符的陪集和为零
plain_statement.en: New route · Trace, different and Fourier deficit · JA-0034 · Cancel the sum of a nontrivial character over a coset

brief.zh: 沿已检出的方向平移陪集；求和不变，非平凡相位迫使总和为零。
brief.en: Translate the coset by a detected direction. The sum is unchanged and is multiplied by a nontrivial phase.

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 迹、不同理想与 Fourier 缺额 · JA-0030 · 界定逆不同校正后的逐处取整代价
plain_statement.en: New route · Trace, different and Fourier deficit · JA-0030 · Bound the local rounding cost after inverse-different correction

brief.zh: 先移除 d，再将指数提高到上取整；额外代价严格小于一层。
brief.en: Remove d before rounding upward. The additional cost is strictly less than one layer.

gaps.statement: ∀ (p n : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (S : Set (Fin n → ZMod p)) (M : ℕ), Nat.card {f : Module.Dual (ZMod p) (Fin n → ZMod p) // ∀ v ∈ S, f v=0} ≤ M → Nat.card ((Fin n → ZMod p) ⧸ Submodule.span (ZMod p) S) ≤ M

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 迹、不同理想与 Fourier 缺额 · JA-0038 · 把指定测试字符的检测率转为指数上界
plain_statement.en: New route · Trace, different and Fourier deficit · JA-0038 · Turn detection by prescribed characters into an index bound

brief.zh: 先把零概率事件确定为零化子，输入须由同标签的允许见证 S 计算。
brief.en: Identify undetected tests with the annihilator. Compute the input using admissible witnesses S from the same label.

gaps.statement: ∀ N : ℕ, let x := (N:ℝ); let lo := -(3*x+3)*Real.log 337; let hi := (-4*(3*x+15/7)+3*(6/7)+1)*Real.log 337; lo-hi=(9*x+2)*Real.log 337 ∧ hi<lo

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 迹、不同理想与 Fourier 缺额 · JA-0032 · 在固定 337 处算出逐元组上界和整格的缺额
plain_statement.en: New route · Trace, different and Fourier deficit · JA-0032 · Compute the growing mismatch of the tuple bound and lattice at 337

brief.zh: 用 q=337^(42N+30)、e=7、不同指数 6。在三槽 j=2 模型内展开全部常数。
brief.en: Use q=337^(42N+30), e=7 and different exponent 6. Expand the constants for j=2 in the three-slot model.

gaps.statement: ∀ (p n : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (S : Set (Fin n → ZMod p)), Submodule.span (ZMod p) S = ⊤ ↔ ∀ f : Module.Dual (ZMod p) (Fin n → ZMod p), f ≠ 0 → ∃ v ∈ S, f v ≠ 0

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 迹、不同理想与 Fourier 缺额 · JA-0037 · 以每个非零泛函的见证刻画满生成
plain_statement.en: New route · Trace, different and Fourier deficit · JA-0037 · Characterize generation by detecting every nonzero linear functional

brief.zh: 若生成空间真小，从商空间取非零泛函。反向在标准基上使用线性。
brief.en: For a proper span take a nonzero functional on the quotient. For the converse use linearity on the span.

gaps.statement: ∀ (w v ρ : ℝ) (d : ℕ), 0 < w → 0 < ρ → ρ ≤ 1 → 0 < d → ρ*w ≤ v → (Real.log w + Real.log ρ)/d ≤ Real.log v/d

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 迹、不同理想与 Fourier 缺额 · JA-0036 · 从一般可测区域的相对测度恢复体积下界
plain_statement.en: New route · Trace, different and Fourier deficit · JA-0036 · Recover a volume floor from the density of a measurable region

brief.zh: 用 ρ=μ(C∩W)/μ(W)；此输入对一般区域不要求封闭于加法。
brief.en: Use ρ=μ(C∩W)/μ(W). The measured region may be any measurable set.

gaps.statement: let A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℚ := !![0,5;1,0]; A.trace=0 ∧ A.det ≠ 0

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 迹、不同理想与 Fourier 缺额 · JA-0031 · 用非零迹零元素区分单点与整层迹
plain_statement.en: New route · Trace, different and Fourier deficit · JA-0031 · Separate the trace of a point from the trace of its lattice

brief.zh: 取基 1,√5，写出乘以 √5 的矩阵。单点取迹可完全抵消。
brief.en: Use the basis 1,√5 for multiplication by √5. The trace of one nonzero element can vanish.

gaps.statement: ∀ (w v : ℝ) (d i : ℕ), 0 < w → 0 < d → 0 < i → w/i ≤ v → Real.log w/d-Real.log i/d ≤ Real.log v/d

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 迹、不同理想与 Fourier 缺额 · JA-0035 · 由残余指数给出 Haar 对数下界
plain_statement.en: New route · Trace, different and Fourier deficit · JA-0035 · Convert the residual index into a logarithmic Haar bound

brief.zh: 用 W 中每个陪集等测度，将测度至少 w/i 的实际区域取对数。
brief.en: Cosets inside W have equal mass. Take logarithms of the lower bound w/i for the measured region.

gaps.statement: ∀ (n d e t : ℤ), 0 < e → (∀ a : ℤ, a ≤ t ↔ -d ≤ n-e*a) → t = (n+d)/e

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 迹、不同理想与 Fourier 缺额 · JA-0029 · 由逆不同理想的包含判据导出迹理想指数
plain_statement.en: New route · Trace, different and Fourier deficit · JA-0029 · Recover the trace-ideal exponent from the inverse-different containment test

brief.zh: 以 Tr(Pⁿ)⊆pᵃ 的充要条件刻画整层迹格；e>0 时整数除法即下取整。
brief.en: Characterize the trace lattice by containment in each base ideal. Positive e makes integer division floor division.

gaps.statement: ∀ (G : Type) [AddCommGroup G] [Fintype G] (H : AddSubgroup G) [Fintype H] (b : G) (χ : AddChar G ℂ) [Decidable (∀ h : H, χ h.val=1)], (∑ h : H, χ (b+h.val)) = if (∀ h : H, χ h.val=1) then (Nat.card H:ℂ)*χ b else 0

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 指定 Kummer 像与 Θ 测试 · JA-0043 · 计算指定剩余陪集指示函数的 Fourier 系数
plain_statement.en: New route · Marked Kummer images and theta tests · JA-0043 · Evaluate the Fourier coefficient of a prescribed residual coset

brief.zh: 在陪集上提取 χ(b)，再用有限群字符正交。这个测试保留陪集代表给出的相位。
brief.en: Factor out χ(b) and apply finite character orthogonality. The test retains the phase of the chosen coset representative.

gaps.statement: ∀ (G : Type) [AddCommGroup G] [Fintype G] (H : AddSubgroup G), Nat.card {χ : AddChar G ℂ // ∀ h : H, χ h.val=1} = H.index

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 指定 Kummer 像与 Θ 测试 · JA-0044 · 在含高阶挠元的任意有限加法商上量出缺额
plain_statement.en: New route · Marked Kummer images and theta tests · JA-0044 · Count the deficit in finite additive quotients with higher torsion

brief.zh: 将零化字符与 G/H 的复加性字符双射，用有限阿贝尔对偶处理非初等 p 群。
brief.en: Identify annihilating characters with the complex characters of G/H and use finite abelian duality for non-elementary p-groups.

gaps.statement: ∀ (p k : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime], Odd p → ∀ x y : PadicInt p, let u := fun (z : PadicInt p) => 1+(p:Padic p)*(z:Padic p); (∃ v : Padic p, v^(p^k)=u x/u y) ↔ ‖(x:Padic p)-y‖ ≤ (1/(p:ℝ))^k

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 指定 Kummer 像与 Θ 测试 · JA-0041 · 在奇 p 处判别两个主单位的有限层 Kummer 类相等
plain_statement.en: New route · Marked Kummer images and theta tests · JA-0041 · Detect equality of finite-level Kummer classes of principal units at odd p

brief.zh: 在 Qₚ 的 1+pZₚ 上用 log/exp；若完整乘法群中有根，先消掉剩余域单位。
brief.en: Use log and exp on 1+pZₚ. For a root in the full multiplicative group first remove its residue-field unit.

gaps.statement: let z : ZMod 29 := 7; let v : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ZMod 29 := ![![1,0,0],![0,1+z^2,0],![1,0,z^2]]; ∀ (I : Type) (allowed : I → Set (Fin 3 → ZMod 29)) (i : I), (∀ j, v j ∈ allowed i) → Submodule.span (ZMod 29) (allowed i)=⊤

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 指定 Kummer 像与 Θ 测试 · JA-0042 · 由已给出的同标签三个成员资格推出满生成
plain_statement.en: New route · Marked Kummer images and theta tests · JA-0042 · Deduce full span from the three given memberships at one label

brief.zh: 线性代数引理。三个向量的同标签成员资格均为前提。实际 ATS/Kummer 映射中能否取得这些见证需要独立证明。
brief.en: Use the three membership assumptions at the same label to prove full span. Constructing these witnesses in the actual ATS/Kummer image requires a separate proof.

gaps.statement: ∀ (K F : Type) [NontriviallyNormedField K] [NontriviallyNormedField F] [CompleteSpace K] [CompleteSpace F] (e : K ≃+* F), Continuous e → Continuous e.symm → ∀ q u : K, e (∑' n : ℤ, q^(n*(n+1)/2)*u^(2*n+1)) = ∑' n : ℤ, (e q)^(n*(n+1)/2)*(e u)^(2*n+1)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 指定 Kummer 像与 Θ 测试 · JA-0040 · 沿双连续标记同构运输 Theta 级数
plain_statement.en: New route · Marked Kummer images and theta tests · JA-0040 · Transport the theta series along a bicontinuous marking

brief.zh: 先沿同一个保双向连续标记运输整个双边级数，再以域同构的乘除相容运输比值。
brief.en: Transport the bilateral series along one bicontinuous marking, then use compatibility with field division to transport the quotient.

gaps.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (S : Finset (ZMod N)), let u := fun x : ZMod N => if x ∈ S then (1:ℂ) else 0; (∑ k : ZMod N, ‖ZMod.dft u k‖^2)/(N:ℝ)^2 = (S.card:ℝ)/N

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 指定 Kummer 像与 Θ 测试 · JA-0045 · 从给定局部 Θ 测试精确恢复可测余类的占比
plain_statement.en: New route · Marked Kummer images and theta tests · JA-0045 · Recover the density of a specified union of residue classes from its Fourier test

brief.zh: 对指定像的指示函数使用同一计数 Haar 测度，平方和给出占比；向实际 ATS 运输时需固定这个 S。
brief.en: Use counting Haar measure on the prescribed image. Parseval yields its density, which must be transported for this S in the ATS model.

gaps.statement: ∀ (a b M : ℕ) (S : Finset ℕ), 0<a → 0<b → Nat.Coprime a b → (∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime ∧ Odd p ∧ multiplicity p (a*b*(a+b)) ≤ M) → S.sum (fun p => (multiplicity p (16*a^2*b^2*(a+b)^2):ℝ)*Real.log p) ≤ 2*(M:ℝ)*S.sum (fun p => Real.log p)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 同一包络与局部 Szpiro · JA-0055 · 给已知重数上界的奇素数集合计算局部判别式界
plain_statement.en: New route · Common hull and local Szpiro · JA-0055 · Bound the local discriminant sum for odd primes with a given multiplicity bound

brief.zh: 对已有 vₚ(abc)≤M 的每个奇素数，用 vₚ(Δ)=2vₚ(abc) 后求和。任务中的 M 是输入。
brief.en: Use vₚ(Δ)=2vₚ(abc) at each odd prime and sum the bounds. The hypothesis supplies M.

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 同一包络与局部 Szpiro · JA-0049 · 从一次幂格下界导出对应的 Szpiro 系数
plain_statement.en: New route · Common hull and local Szpiro · JA-0049 · Derive the Szpiro coefficient with a first-power lattice floor

brief.zh: 因式分解 A−1，比较两种见证时保持 Q、U、δ 的规范。
brief.en: Factor A−1 and keep the same normalizations of Q, U and δ when comparing witnesses.

gaps.statement: ∀ a b : ℕ, let E : WeierstrassCurve ℚ := ⟨0,(b:ℚ)-a,0,-(a:ℚ)*b,0⟩; E.Δ = 16*(a:ℚ)^2*(b:ℚ)^2*((a:ℚ)+b)^2

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 同一包络与局部 Szpiro · JA-0052 · 对有理 Frey 方程计算整模型判别式
plain_statement.en: New route · Common hull and local Szpiro · JA-0052 · Compute the integral discriminant of the rational Frey model

brief.zh: 将 y²=x(x−a)(x+b) 的系数代入 Weierstrass 判别式，保留 2 处的因子 16。
brief.en: Insert the coefficients of y²=x(x−a)(x+b) in the invariants and retain the factor 16 at two.

gaps.statement: ∀ p N : ℕ, p.Prime → Odd p → 0 < N → multiplicity p (16*(p^N)^2*(p^N+1)^2) = 2*N

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 同一包络与局部 Szpiro · JA-0053 · 在固定奇素数计算 pᴺ,1,pᴺ+1 的判别式阶
plain_statement.en: New route · Common hull and local Szpiro · JA-0053 · Compute the discriminant order at the fixed odd prime of the Frey family

brief.zh: p 不整除 pᴺ+1，亦不整除 16；该式只计 p。
brief.en: The prime divides neither pᴺ+1 nor 16. Compute only its contribution.

gaps.statement: ∀ a b p : ℕ, 0<a → 0<b → Nat.Coprime a b → p.Prime → Odd p → p ∣ a*b*(a+b) → ¬ p ∣ 16*(a^2+a*b+b^2)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 同一包络与局部 Szpiro · JA-0054 · 在奇坏处检验 Frey 模型 c₄ 为单位
plain_statement.en: New route · Common hull and local Szpiro · JA-0054 · Test that c₄ is a unit at each odd bad place of a Frey model

brief.zh: 依 p 整除 a、b、a+b 分情况；该模型的 c₄=16(a²+ab+b²)。
brief.en: Split by divisibility of a, b or a+b. Here c₄=16(a²+ab+b²).

gaps.statement: ∀ l Q : ℝ, 7 ≤ l → (l*(l+1)/12-1)*Q ≤ (l+5)/4*Real.log Real.pi → 2*l*Q ≤ 126/11*Real.log Real.pi

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 同一包络与局部 Szpiro · JA-0051 · 在所有 ℓ≥7 上界定参考区域的许可阈值
plain_statement.en: New route · Common hull and local Szpiro · JA-0051 · Bound the allowable reference-region threshold for every ℓ≥7

brief.zh: 先求 6ℓ(ℓ+5)/((ℓ−3)(ℓ+4)) 的上界，最大值取于 7。
brief.en: Bound 6ℓ(ℓ+5)/((ℓ−3)(ℓ+4)); its maximum on this range is at seven.

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 同一包络与局部 Szpiro · JA-0048 · 从同一 R 导出线性下界方案的 Szpiro 系数
plain_statement.en: New route · Common hull and local Szpiro · JA-0048 · Derive the linear-witness Szpiro coefficient on one hull

brief.zh: 相减时必须使用同一 R；化简 A−b=(ℓ−3)(ℓ+1)/12。
brief.en: Subtract inequalities for the identical R and factor A−b=(ℓ−3)(ℓ+1)/12.

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 同一包络与局部 Szpiro · JA-0050 · 量出线性方案相对一次幂方案的精确损失
plain_statement.en: New route · Common hull and local Szpiro · JA-0050 · Measure the exact loss of linear weights against first-power weights

brief.zh: 消去共有因子，保留与辅助素数 ℓ 的依赖。
brief.en: Cancel common factors while retaining dependence on the auxiliary prime.

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 同一包络与局部 Szpiro · JA-0046 · 求标签上线性权重的平均
plain_statement.en: New route · Common hull and local Szpiro · JA-0046 · Average the linear weights over the labels

brief.zh: 使用等差数列求和，再换 ℓ=2m+1。
brief.en: Sum the arithmetic progression and substitute ℓ=2m+1.

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 同一包络与局部 Szpiro · JA-0047 · 求参考区域平方权重的平均
plain_statement.en: New route · Common hull and local Szpiro · JA-0047 · Average the square weights of the reference region

brief.zh: 使用连续平方和，先除以正的标签数 m。
brief.en: Use the consecutive square sum and divide by the positive label count.

gaps.statement: let rad := fun (n : ℕ) => n.primeFactors.prod id; ∀ (a b : ℕ) (S : Finset ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ), 0<a → 0<b → S ⊆ (2*a*b*(a+b)).primeFactors → (∀ p ∈ S, 0≤u p ∧ u p≤1) → S.sum (fun p => u p*Real.log p) ≤ Real.log (rad (a*b*(a+b)))+Real.log 2

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 同一包络与局部 Szpiro · JA-0056 · 把 Frey 坏处的整层取整代价控制在全局根基内
plain_statement.en: New route · Common hull and local Szpiro · JA-0056 · Bound whole-lattice rounding at Frey bad places by the global radical

brief.zh: 用 S 中的素数互异和每处取整最多一层，再将素数 2 单列。
brief.en: Use distinct prime support and at most one rounding layer at each place. Account for two separately.

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 全局高度与 abc · JA-0062 · 为每个 ε 选择统一合适大小的辅助素数
plain_statement.en: New route · Global heights and abc · JA-0062 · Select the size of an auxiliary prime uniformly for each ε

brief.zh: 用素数无界和有理函数趋零。具体曲线上的可用性须由算术高度上界承担。
brief.en: Use unbounded primes and decay of the rational function. The height estimate must account for admissibility on actual curves.

gaps.statement: let rad := fun (n : ℕ) => n.primeFactors.prod id; let h := fun (a b : ℕ) => Real.log ((a:ℝ)+b); let r := fun (a b : ℕ) => Real.log (rad (a*b*(a+b))); ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ a b : ℕ, 0<a → 0<b → Nat.Coprime a b → h a b ≤ (1+ε)*r a b+C

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 全局高度与 abc · JA-0065 · 对每个 ε 证明统一的有理 abc 不等式
plain_statement.en: New route · Global heights and abc · JA-0065 · Prove a uniform rational abc inequality for every ε

brief.zh: 常数只依赖 ε，每一互素正整数对都需满足同一界。
brief.en: The constant depends only on ε and must work for every coprime pair of positive integers.

gaps.statement: let h := fun (a b : ℕ) => Real.log ((a:ℝ)+b); ∀ a b : ℕ, 0 < a → 0 < b → 2*h a b + Real.log 12 ≤ Real.log (16*((a:ℝ)^2+a*b+(b:ℝ)^2))

brief.zh: 用 4(a²+ab+b²)−3(a+b)²=(a−b)²，再取对数。

gaps.statement: let rad := fun (n : ℕ) => n.primeFactors.prod id; let r := fun (a b : ℕ) => Real.log (rad (a*b*(a+b))); ∀ (l : ℕ) (K : ℝ) (Q R U δ A : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ), 7 ≤ l → let k := 4*(l:ℝ)/(((l:ℝ)-3)*(l+1)); let H := fun (a b : ℕ) => Real.log (16*((a:ℝ)^2+a*b+(b:ℝ)^2))/2; (∀ a b : ℕ, 0<a → 0<b → Nat.Coprime a b → -(((l:ℝ)+1)/4)*Q a b-δ a b ≤ R a b ∧ R a b ≤ -((l:ℝ)*(l+1)/12)*Q a b+U a b ∧ H a b ≤ 2*l*Q a b/6+A a b ∧ A a b + k*(U a b+δ a b) ≤ (1+k)*r a b+K) → ∀ a b : ℕ, 0<a → 0<b → Nat.Coprime a b → H a b ≤ (1+k)*r a b+K

brief.zh: 这是对实值函数的消元。应用于 Joshi 对象时须构造同一个标记包络，并另证两端体积界、高度比较和统一根基预算。
brief.en: Eliminate the real-valued functions using the four inequalities. An application to Joshi data requires a common marked hull and separate proofs of both volume bounds, the height comparison and the uniform radical budget.

gaps.statement: let rad := fun (n : ℕ) => n.primeFactors.prod id; let r := fun (a b : ℕ) => Real.log (rad (a*b*(a+b))); ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ a b : ℕ, 0<a → 0<b → Nat.Coprime a b → Real.log (16*((a:ℝ)^2+a*b+(b:ℝ)^2))/2 ≤ (15/8 : ℝ)*r a b+K

brief.zh: 该开放界等价于指数 15/8 的具体弱 abc 界，并经 JA-0064 蕴含 JA-0059。常数必须统一于全部互素正整数对。
brief.en: This open bound is equivalent to the fixed exponent 15/8 and implies JA-0059 via JA-0064. Use one constant for all coprime positive pairs.

gaps.statement: (let rad := fun (n : ℕ) => n.primeFactors.prod id; let r := fun (a b : ℕ) => Real.log (rad (a*b*(a+b))); ∀ l : ℕ, l.Prime → 7 ≤ l → ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ a b : ℕ, 0<a → 0<b → Nat.Coprime a b → Real.log (16*((a:ℝ)^2+a*b+(b:ℝ)^2))/2 ≤ (1+4*(l:ℝ)/(((l:ℝ)-3)*(l+1)))*r a b+K) → (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ l : ℕ, l.Prime ∧ 7 ≤ l ∧ 4*(l:ℝ)/(((l:ℝ)-3)*(l+1)) ≤ ε) → (let h := fun (a b : ℕ) => Real.log ((a:ℝ)+b); ∀ a b : ℕ, 0 < a → 0 < b → 2*h a b + Real.log 12 ≤ Real.log (16*((a:ℝ)^2+a*b+(b:ℝ)^2))) → (let rad := fun (n : ℕ) => n.primeFactors.prod id; let h := fun (a b : ℕ) => Real.log ((a:ℝ)+b); let r := fun (a b : ℕ) => Real.log (rad (a*b*(a+b))); ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ a b : ℕ, 0<a → 0<b → Nat.Coprime a b → h a b ≤ (1+ε)*r a b+C)

gaps.statement: let rad := fun (n : ℕ) => n.primeFactors.prod id; let h := fun (a b : ℕ) => Real.log ((a:ℝ)+b); let r := fun (a b : ℕ) => Real.log (rad (a*b*(a+b))); ∃ B C : ℝ, 1 < B ∧ ∀ a b : ℕ, 0<a → 0<b → Nat.Coprime a b → h a b ≤ B*r a b+C
